es.body:
El alcance mundial de Black Coffee

Nkosinathi Innocent Maphumulo, universalmente conocido como Black Coffee, es una figura fundamental en el panorama mundial de la música electrónica, procedente de Durban (Sudáfrica). Se le atribuye el mérito de ser pionero y elevar el afro house desde sus orígenes regionales hasta la prominencia internacional, estableciendo un sonido característico caracterizado por ritmos profundos y conmovedores, intrincadas capas de percusión y una profunda resonancia emocional. Como fundador visionario de Soulistic Music, su ilustre trayectoria profesional le ha llevado a encabezar constantemente importantes festivales en todo el mundo y a conseguir codiciadas residencias en lugares emblemáticos como Hï Ibiza, consolidando su estatus como artista ganador de un Grammy y verdadero innovador dentro del género. Con más de un millón y medio de seguidores en Spotify, su influencia se extiende por todos los continentes, uniendo con eficacia los sonidos tradicionales africanos con la producción electrónica contemporánea de vanguardia.

Arquitecturas Afro House

El estilo musical de Black Coffee navega con maestría por los ricos paisajes del afro house, el afro tech y el deep house, construyendo viajes sonoros inmersivos que priorizan el groove, la profundidad emocional y una progresión hipnótica. Sus técnicas de producción incorporan con frecuencia instrumentación orgánica, a menudo con percusión tradicional africana y samples vocales conmovedores, todo ello meticulosamente superpuesto sobre una base constante y dinámica de cuatro a la pista. Este enfoque crea una atmósfera profundamente energética y meditativa a la vez. Aunque no hay ningún lanzamiento reciente de 2025, su extensa discografía incluye álbumes significativos como el aclamado "Subconsciously" de 2021 y el igualmente impactante "For My Dear Friend V" DJ Mix del mismo año, ambos mostrando su sonido evolutivo y refinado. Temas como "The Rapture Pt.III", "Drive (feat. Delilah Montagu) - Edit" y "Trippy Yeah" siguen siendo populares en sus sesiones, demostrando constantemente su capacidad única para crear himnos de club duraderos que resuenan en todo el mundo.

Artistas de apoyo y selectores globales

Junto a Black Coffee, en este evento de clausura, hay un elenco de artistas muy respetados cuyas carreras abarcan sellos influyentes, producciones vanguardistas y actuaciones aclamadas internacionalmente. Andrea Oliva, que lleva mucho tiempo en la escena underground del house y el techno, es conocido por sus dinámicos sets en ANTS, Circoloco y festivales como Tomorrowland, en los que combina la energía percusiva con ritmos llenos de groove. Jimi Jules, célebre por sus lanzamientos en Innervisions y su estilo de producción que traspasa fronteras, aporta un enfoque profundo y experimental formado por su herencia suizo-caribeña y sus colaboraciones con Dixon y Âme. Joezi, reconocido por éxitos afro house como "Let Me Love You" y su sonido melódico y vocal, sigue ascendiendo a nivel mundial con actuaciones en Europa, África y Sudamérica. Luciano, fundador de Cadenza y pionero del minimal techno con influencias latinas, añade su característico flow hipnótico y orgánico, un enfoque que ha dado forma a la música electrónica moderna en Ibiza y más allá. Completa el cartel Stoffela, un versátil DJ y productor de afro-house cuya cálida percusión, texturas atmosféricas y constante ascenso en lineups internacionales lo convierten en un complemento natural para esta noche comisariada. Juntos, estos artistas crean una poderosa narrativa musical que amplía y eleva la experiencia en torno al set de Black Coffee.

Ritmos selváticos en Zamna Cenote

Esta esperada actuación en Zamna Tulum promete una experiencia excepcionalmente envolvente, con Black Coffee preparado para ofrecer una clase magistral de su característico sonido afro house en medio de la selva y el cenote. Los asistentes pueden anticipar una progresión meticulosamente elaborada que suele comenzar con grooves profundos y resonantes, aumentando gradualmente en intensidad a través de intrincados breakdowns percusivos y florituras melódicas expansivas. La incomparable belleza natural de Zamna Tulum, caracterizada por su exuberante vegetación y el impresionante y tranquilo cenote, proporciona un excepcional y orgánico telón de fondo que complementa a la perfección los conmovedores y expansivos paisajes sonoros de Black Coffee, mejorando significativamente la calidad envolvente de su actuación. La reputación del lugar como anfitrión de festivales de música electrónica de varios días y de presentaciones de artistas de alto nivel garantiza un público que está profundamente en sintonía con la narrativa matizada y de viaje que Black Coffee construye a través de su música.

Entradas y logística en Tulum

Dado el inmenso atractivo mundial del artista y el estatus establecido de Zamna como uno de los principales destinos de música electrónica en México, asegurar las entradas con antelación no sólo es recomendable, sino muy aconsejable para garantizar la entrada. en.body:
HUGEL

HUGEL has established himself as a pivotal force in the global electronic music landscape, widely recognized as an instigator of the Latin House movement. His dynamic career trajectory has seen him achieve multi-gold and platinum selling status across numerous territories, accumulating over 1 billion streams across platforms. His signature sound, characterized by infectious Latin rhythms, robust house grooves, and often sun-drenched melodic elements, frequently propels his tracks to the number one spot on Beatport, solidifying his presence in top-tier venues and credible events worldwide. With a significant following of over 636,190 on Spotify, HUGEL continues to shape the contemporary dance music narrative with his distinctive productions and energetic DJ sets.

Latin House & Afro House Dynamics

HUGEL's musical style navigates the vibrant intersections of Latin house, Afro house, and techengue, constructing sets that are both rhythmically complex and irresistibly danceable, typically operating within the 120-125 BPM range. His productions often feature driving four-to-the-floor kicks underpinned by syncopated percussion, soulful vocal samples, and catchy melodic hooks, as heard in globally recognized tracks like "I Adore You (feat. Daecolm)" and the foundational "Morenita." Recent 2025 releases, including the singles "Two Aladins," "Loosen Up (Acoustic Version)," and "Caje," further explore these percussive territories with refined production techniques, showcasing his continued innovation within the genre. His consistent ability to craft Beatport chart-toppers and amass over a billion streams underscores his mastery in delivering energetic, globally appealing dancefloor anthems that resonate from beach clubs to festival mainstages.

Cosmic Realms at Papaya Playa

This performance at Papaya Playa Project on January 7th, 2026, promises a journey through the "cosmic realms" that define HUGEL's sound, perfectly aligning with PPP's unique blend of natural beauty and vibrant energy. Expect HUGEL to deliver a high-energy set, likely building from deep, Afro-infused rhythms in the early hours to peak-time Latin house anthems, designed to ignite dance moves under the Tulum stars. Supporting acts Aaron Sevilla, Juany Bravo, Sam Blacky, and Cezar Aragon will set the stage, crafting an eclectic warm-up that complements the beachfront setting.

Entry & Timings

Doors for this event at Papaya Playa Project open at 3:00 PM, with the final entry permitted at 12:50 AM, allowing ample time to experience the full lineup. General admission tickets, which include immersive art experiences, start at $3,300 MXN. Given the venue's reputation as one of Tulum's most upscale destinations and HUGEL's global appeal, securing tickets in advance is strongly recommended to guarantee entry to this highly anticipated event.

es.body:
HUGEL

HUGEL se ha establecido como una fuerza pivotal en el panorama global de la música electrónica, ampliamente reconocido como uno de los instigadores del movimiento Latin House. Su dinámica trayectoria profesional lo ha llevado a alcanzar múltiples estatus de ventas oro y platino en numerosos territorios, acumulando más de 1 mil millones de reproducciones en plataformas. Su sonido distintivo, caracterizado por ritmos latinos contagiosos, sólidos grooves de house y, a menudo, elementos melódicos bañados por el sol, frecuentemente impulsa sus pistas al número uno en Beatport, consolidando su presencia en lugares de primer nivel y eventos creíbles a nivel mundial. Con un seguimiento significativo de más de 636,190 en Spotify, HUGEL continúa dando forma al relato contemporáneo de la música de baile con sus producciones distintivas y energéticos sets de DJ.

Dinámicas de Latin House & Afro House

El estilo musical de HUGEL navega por las vibrantes intersecciones del Latin house, Afro house y techengue, construyendo sets que son tanto rítmicamente complejos como irresistiblemente bailables, operando típicamente dentro del rango de 120-125 BPM. Sus producciones a menudo presentan potentes patadas four-to-the-floor respaldadas por percusiones sincopadas, muestras vocales llenas de alma y ganchos melódicos pegajosos, como se escucha en pistas reconocidas globalmente como "I Adore You (feat. Daecolm)" y la fundacional "Morenita". Los lanzamientos recientes de 2025, incluyendo los sencillos "Two Aladins", "Loosen Up (Acoustic Version)" y "Caje", exploran aún más estos territorios percusivos con técnicas de producción refinadas, mostrando su continua innovación dentro del género. Su capacidad constante para crear éxitos en Beatport y acumular más de mil millones de reproducciones subraya su maestría en entregar himnos de baile energéticos y globalmente atractivos que resuenan desde los clubes de playa hasta los escenarios principales de festivales.

Reinos Cósmicos en Papaya Playa

Esta actuación en Papaya Playa Project el 7 de enero de 2026, promete un viaje a través de los "reinos cósmicos" que definen el sonido de HUGEL, alineándose perfectamente con la mezcla única de belleza natural y energía vibrante de PPP. Espera que HUGEL entregue un set de alta energía, probablemente partiendo de ritmos profundos, infundidos en Afro en las primeras horas, hasta himnos de Latin house en el momento cumbre, diseñados para encender los movimientos de baile bajo las estrellas de Tulum. Los actos de apoyo Aaron Sevilla, Juany Bravo, Sam Blacky y Cezar Aragon prepararán el escenario, creando una calurosa bienvenida que complementa el entorno frente a la playa.

Entrada & Horarios

Las puertas para este evento en Papaya Playa Project se abren a las 3:00 PM, con la última entrada permitida a las 12:50 AM, brindando amplio tiempo para experimentar la alineación completa. Los boletos de admisión general, que incluyen experiencias artísticas inmersivas, tienen un precio de $3,300 MXN. Dada la reputación del lugar como uno de los destinos más exclusivos de Tulum y el atractivo global de HUGEL, se aconseja llegar temprano y se recomienda encarecidamente asegurar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a este evento tan esperado.

en.body:
Diplo: Global Architect of Sound

Philadelphia-based artist Thomas Wesley Pentz, globally recognized as Diplo, stands as a formidable figure in electronic music, boasting a career spanning two decades. Emerging from the foundational Hollertronix club night he co-founded with DJ Low Budget, Diplo has consistently pushed genre boundaries, establishing himself as a prolific producer, DJ, and songwriter. His influential Mad Decent label and the non-profit Heaps Decent reflect a commitment to championing diverse artists and sounds from across the globe, solidifying his position as a tastemaker and innovator.

Eclectic Rhythms and Crossover Innovations

Diplo's musical style is characterized by its genre fluidity, navigating seamlessly from the syncopated rhythms of moombahton and the heavy basslines of trap to pop anthems and country-electronic fusions under his Thomas Wesley moniker. While his discography includes a vast array of projects like the 2024 "LABRINTH, SIA, DIPLO PRESENT... LSD (REMIXES)" album and the "Diplo Presents Thomas Wesley: The Mixtape" from the same year, his influence is perhaps best quantified by his nearly 2.8 million Spotify followers and tracks like the Grammy-winning "Where Are Ü Now (with Justin Bieber)," co-produced as Jack Ü.

New Cycles at Papaya Playa Project

For this performance at Papaya Playa Project, attendees can anticipate a journey that aligns with the event's theme of "introspection, appreciation, and purification." Given Diplo's diverse catalog and the venue's reputation for organic house and world music, his set could explore his more melodic and globally influenced productions, potentially weaving in elements from his Thomas Wesley project or deeper cuts from his Mad Decent imprint. While specific supporting acts are yet to be announced, local Tulum talent will likely provide a warm-up, setting a foundational groove. The open-air, beachfront ambiance of Papaya Playa Project, known for its emphasis on natural soundscapes, will undoubtedly complement Diplo's ability to construct a compelling narrative through sound.

Entry & Event Essentials

Doors for this evening at Papaya Playa Project open at 6:30 pm, with the last entry permitted at 12:50 am. General admission tickets, which include the musical journey, welcome drink, live music, and immersive art experiences, are priced at $3,850 MXN. It's important to note that dinner is not included with this ticket type. The suggested dress code is Dinner-Casual. Given Diplo's international appeal and Papaya Playa Project's sought-after location, securing tickets in advance is strongly recommended to ensure entry.

Âme, Echonomist, Trikk, & Vite: A New Year's Sonic Journey

Vagalume's New Year's Eve 2026 edition, "The Temple of the New Sun," presents a meticulously curated lineup for its discerning audience. ÂME DJ, a foundational name from the Innervisions camp, sets the tone with their distinctive take on melodic house and techno. Joining them are ECHONOMIST, celebrated for his contributions to the progressive house and melodic techno sound often heard on labels like Afterlife, and TRIKK, whose releases on Innervisions and Hotflush are recognized for their driving, percussive house structures. The night's comprehensive sonic journey is completed by VITE, promising a seamless transition through the evening's electronic soundscape.

Vagalume's Annual Curatorial Statement

Vagalume Tulum has established itself as a premier destination within Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene, renowned for bridging high-end leisure with world-class sonic experiences. "The Temple of the New Sun" represents their annual New Year's Eve flagship event, showcasing Vagalume's consistent commitment to artistic curation over fleeting trends. This series has evolved into a significant cultural touchstone, drawing an international audience seeking expertly programmed lineups and a sophisticated party atmosphere. It underscores Vagalume's role in defining Tulum's upscale nightlife landscape.

Vagalume Tulum: A Beachfront Soundscape

Situated directly on the Hotel Zone's pristine beachfront, Vagalume Tulum offers an unparalleled setting for electronic music events. The venue's design, characterized by its open-air structure and natural elements, provides an expansive yet intimate dancefloor directly on the sand, enhancing the connection between the music and its tropical surroundings. Known for hosting sunset sessions and high-energy beach parties, Vagalume leverages its sophisticated sound system to project melodic techno and progressive house across its luxurious grounds, accommodating a substantial crowd of electronic music enthusiasts.

Essential Details for the New Year's Eve Unveiling

Access to Vagalume's New Year's Eve celebration begins at 9:00 PM for general admission, though guests opting for the dinner experience should arrive by 7:00 PM for seating. Tickets for this esteemed event begin at $1,100 MXN, with various packages including dinner and bottle service available for reservation. Given the high demand and anticipated heavy traffic in the Hotel Zone, early arrival is strongly recommended. Attendees are encouraged to observe a formal beach attire dress code, reflecting the event's upscale celebratory nature, and advanced ticket purchase is advisable to secure entry.

en.body:
Hernán Cattáneo: The Maestro's Tulum Return

Born in Buenos Aires, Hernán Cattáneo has ascended to a foundational role within the global progressive house movement, earning him the moniker "El Maestro." His career trajectory, spanning over three decades, is defined by an unwavering commitment to crafting hypnotic and emotionally charged soundscapes. Beyond commanding stages at iconic festivals like Tomorrowland and Burning Man, Cattáneo has cultivated his own esteemed imprint, Sudbeat, which serves as a beacon for the genre's evolving sound.

Progressive House Architectures

Cattáneo's musical style navigates the nuanced territories of progressive house, organic house, and melodic techno, typically constructing sets within the 120-125 BPM range. His productions, characterized by intricate layering and a focus on expansive sonic narratives, explore deep melodic textures and driving percussive elements. While no 2025 releases are yet announced, his 2024 album, "Environments," showcased his continued dedication to sophisticated, evolving sound design. Popular tracks like "London To Buenos Aires" and his remix of Soda Stereo's "En la Ciudad de la Furia" exemplify his ability to infuse deep grooves with evocative melodies, contributing to his significant global presence.

Vagalume's Sunset Progression

This performance at Vagalume Tulum promises a quintessential Hernán Cattáneo journey, unfolding from the late afternoon into the early morning hours. The open-air beach club setting of Vagalume, known for its transformation from daytime serenity to nighttime energy, provides an ideal backdrop for his extended narrative sets. Supporting acts VITE + MIGANOVA and RENÊ B2B MIUL will lay the groundwork, warming the sound system—known for its robust low-end response—for Cattáneo's masterclass.

Tickets & Entry Protocol

The event at Vagalume runs from 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering free access before 7:00 PM for early arrivals. Beyond that, tickets are structured in tiers, with the Second Release currently available at $880 MXN. Given Vagalume's popularity as Tulum's premier beach club and Cattáneo's draw, the venue is expected to reach capacity during peak hours, typically after 9:00 PM. Advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended to secure entry and avoid higher door prices, ensuring participation in this anticipated electronic gathering.

en.body:
Oliver Koletzki

Berlin-based producer and DJ Oliver Koletzki has carved out a significant niche in electronic music, establishing himself as a purveyor of melodic and organic sounds that traverse minimal techno and house. Emerging from the German capital's vibrant scene, Koletzki first gained attention in 2005, subsequently founding Stil vor Talent, a label that has become synonymous with a distinct, emotionally resonant strain of electronic music. His extensive career, rooted in early musical explorations with a Commodore 64 and classical instrument training, reflects a trajectory from underground innovator to a globally recognized artist with nearly 365,000 Spotify followers.

Melodic Architectures & Rhythmic Depth

Koletzki's musical style is characterized by its intricate melodic narratives and driving, yet often subtle, rhythmic structures. Operating typically within the 118-125 BPM range, his productions frequently explore the intersection of organic house and minimal techno, employing warm analog textures alongside crisp, digital percussion. His latest album, "20 Years of Stil vor Talent," released in August 2025, showcases his enduring influence and evolving sound, building on the acclaimed "Trip to Sanity" (2023) and "Made of Wood" (2021). Tracks like "Spiritual but Not Religious" and "Bones" exemplify his ability to construct expansive soundscapes, while "No Man No Cry - Jimmy Sax Version" highlights his collaborative versatility.

Full Moon Convergence at Papaya Playa

This performance at Papaya Playa Project promises a convergence of Koletzki's signature sound with Tulum's unique natural ambiance, specifically tailored for the venue's "Full Moon" gathering. Known for sets that build gradually from deep, percussive grooves to more uplifting, melodic climaxes, Koletzki is expected to leverage Papaya Playa's open-air, beachfront setting. His organic house sensibilities will undoubtedly complement the venue's eco-conscious ethos and "soulful sounds" programming, enhancing the moonlit celebration. The lineup features Oliver Koletzki as the headliner, with additional supporting acts yet to be announced, ensuring a night of curated sonic progression.

Event Access & Experience

The Full Moon event at Papaya Playa Project opens its doors at 7 PM, with last entry permitted at 12:50 AM. General admission tickets are priced at $1,430 MXN. For those seeking an enhanced evening, VIP tables are available, inclusive of bottle service, a dedicated dinner or credit for food and drinks, a welcome drink, and access to live music and immersive art experiences. Oliver Koletzki

El productor y DJ con base en Berlín, Oliver Koletzki, ha creado un nicho significativo en la música electrónica, estableciéndose como un proveedor de sonidos melódicos y orgánicos que atraviesan el techno minimalista y el house. Surgiendo de la vibrante escena de la capital alemana, Koletzki captó la atención por primera vez en 2005, fundando posteriormente Stil vor Talent, un sello que se ha convertido en sinónimo de una cepa distintiva y emocionalmente resonante de música electrónica. Su extensa carrera, arraigada en exploraciones musicales tempranas con un Commodore 64 y entrenamiento en instrumentos clásicos, refleja una trayectoria desde innovador underground hasta artista reconocido globalmente con casi 365,000 seguidores en Spotify.

Arquitecturas Melódicas y Profundidad Rítmica

El estilo musical de Koletzki se caracteriza por sus intrincadas narrativas melódicas y estructuras rítmicas impulsivas, aunque a menudo sutiles. Operando típicamente dentro del rango de 118-125 BPM, sus producciones exploran frecuentemente la intersección de house orgánico y techno minimalista, empleando texturas analógicas cálidas junto con percusión digital nítida. Su último álbum, "20 Years of Stil vor Talent", lanzado en agosto de 2025, muestra su influencia perdurable y sonido en evolución, construyendo sobre el aclamado "Trip to Sanity" (2023) y "Made of Wood" (2021). Temas como "Spiritual but Not Religious" y "Bones" ejemplifican su habilidad para construir paisajes sonoros expansivos, mientras que "No Man No Cry - Versión de Jimmy Sax" destaca su versatilidad colaborativa.

Convergencia de Luna Llena en Papaya Playa

Esta actuación en Papaya Playa Project promete una convergencia del sonido característico de Koletzki con el ambiente natural único de Tulum, específicamente diseñado para la reunión de "Luna Llena" del lugar. Conocido por sets que se construyen gradualmente desde ritmos profundos y percusivos hasta clímax más elevados y melódicos, se espera que Koletzki aproveche el escenario al aire libre y frente a la playa de Papaya Playa. Su sensibilidad hacia el house orgánico complementará sin duda el ethos ecológico del lugar y la programación de "sonidos con alma", realzando la celebración bajo la luz de la luna. La alineación presenta a Oliver Koletzki como el acto principal, con actos de apoyo adicionales aún por anunciarse, asegurando una noche de progresión sonora curada.

Acceso y Experiencia del Evento

El evento de Luna Llena en Papaya Playa Project abre sus puertas a las 7 PM, con la última entrada permitida a las 12:50 AM. Los boletos de entrada general tienen un precio de $1,430 MXN. Para aquellos que buscan una noche mejorada, hay mesas VIP disponibles, que incluyen servicio de botella, una cena dedicada o crédito para alimentos y bebidas, una bebida de bienvenida y acceso a música en vivo y experiencias de arte inmersivo. Dada la reputación del lugar como destino premium y el calibre del artista principal, se aconseja llegar temprano, particularmente para los invitados interesados en las ofertas culinarias y en asegurar un lugar privilegiado para la jornada musical.
es.description: Oliver Koletzki, directamente desde Berlín, trae su distintivo sonido de house orgánico y techno minimalista. Conocido por el éxito de Cocoon 'Der Muckenschwarm', nos ofrece ritmos refinados.
es.name: Oliver Koletzki

en.body:
Curated Electronic Journey for Dia De Los Muertos

This edition of Bells in the City promises a meticulously curated electronic journey While the full lineup remains unannounced, the event is set to deliver a multi-sensory experience rooted in house music. The selection of artists will contribute to an environment where electronic rhythms converge with artistic interventions and dance performances, creating an engaging atmosphere for dancers.

Bells in the City's Cultural Celebrations

Bells in the City has established itself as a significant fixture in Tulum's electronic music landscape, known for crafting distinct atmospheres for each of its events. This series consistently brings together both emerging and recognized talents, contributing to a vibrant scene that values a unique party experience. Their Dia De Los Muertos Celebration stands as a testament to this ethos, integrating deep-rooted cultural traditions with contemporary electronic music. The series aims to transcend a typical party, transforming it into a journey that blends festivity with artistic expression and communal gathering.

Mia Tulum's Beachfront Canvas

The celebration unfolds at Mia Tulum, a quintessential beachfront club renowned for its iconic wooden tunnel entrance and expansive open-air setting. Dancing with feet in the sand and feeling the ocean breeze is central to the Mia experience, especially under the moonlight. The venue's design provides a natural canvas for the visual art and artistic interventions that accompany the music, enhancing the "Sand, Beach & The Moon" ambiance. Mia Tulum offers a relaxed yet energetic environment, perfectly suited for the multi-sensory spectacle Bells in the City creates.

Tickets and Entry Details

Bells in the City – Dia De Los Muertos Celebration takes place on Saturday, November 1, 2025, from 5 PM to 1 AM. General access tickets begin at $345 MXN for Early Bird, with Tier 1 at $575 MXN and Final Tier at $920 MXN. Tulum residents can access a free guest list until 7 PM by presenting their INE. It is important to note that all ticket sales are final, with no refunds for cancellations or no-shows, and prices include a 15% service charge.
en.description: Bells in the City – Dia De Los Muertos Celebration presents six incredible DJs and producers. Enjoy house music for a multi-sensory sound experience and festive culture.
en.name: Bells in the City

en.body:
This Día de los Muertos, Obsidiana Tulum comes alive for a special rooftop celebration with Boris Cerka, blending rhythm, ritual, and sound into one unforgettable night.

Located in downtown Tulum, Obsidiana has quickly become one of the city’s most talked-about rooftops — known for its intimate atmosphere, quality sound, and weekend lineups featuring some of the best DJs in town.

Boris Cerka, a Tulum-based DJ and curator behind Tulum Bible, brings his signature sound rooted in Afro House, filled with organic percussion and tribal energy. As the night builds, expect him to transition into Melodic House and Techno, closing the evening with deep emotion and driving rhythm — a style that reflects his evolving sets across Tulum’s top venues.

Surrounded by candlelight, marigold accents, and the spirit of Día de los Muertos, the rooftop will turn into a space of celebration, dance, and connection. Whether you’re a local or visiting for the holiday, this event captures the essence of Tulum nightlife — where music meets culture under the open sky.
en.description: On the rooftop of Obsidiana in downtown Tulum, Boris Cerka ignites a Día de los Muertos-inspired dance night with afro house and melodic techno.
en.name: Dia De Muertos /w Boris Cerka

es.body:
Este Día de los Muertos, Obsidiana Tulum cobra vida para una celebración especial en la azotea con Boris Cerka, mezclando ritmo, ritual y sonido en una noche inolvidable.

Ubicada en el centro de Tulum, Obsidiana se ha convertido rápidamente en una de las azoteas más habladas de la ciudad, conocida por su ambiente íntimo, sonido de calidad y alineaciones de fin de semana con algunos de los mejores DJs de la ciudad.

Boris Cerka, un DJ con sede en Tulum y curador detrás de Tulum Bible, trae su sonido característico arraigado en Afro House, lleno de percusión orgánica y energía tribal. A medida que la noche se construye, espere que haga la transición al House Melódico y al Techno, cerrando la noche con profunda emoción y ritmo de conducción, un estilo que refleje sus sets en evolución en los principales lugares de Tulum.

Rodeada de velas, acentos de marigold y el espíritu del Día de los Muertos, la azotea se convertirá en un espacio de celebración, baile y conexión. Ya sea que sea un local o de visita por las vacaciones, este evento captura la esencia de la vida nocturna de Tulum, donde la música se encuentra con la cultura a cielo abierto.
es.description: En la azotea de Obsidiana en el centro de Tulum, Boris Cerka enciende una noche de baile inspirada en el Día de los Muertos con afro house y techno melódico.
es.name: Dia De Muertos /w Boris Cerka

en.body:
TIM GREEN & UKIYO: A Sonic Convergence

This edition of Under the Moonlight at Papaya Playa Project presents a compelling lineup featuring veteran producer Tim Green alongside the emergent Ukiyo. Tim Green, a long-standing figure in the global house scene and a key artist on Dirtybird, is renowned for his signature deep, groovy house, characterized by sophisticated rhythms and a tech-edged funk that builds energy through organic progression. His presence ensures a journey through meticulously selected sounds. Complementing this, Ukiyo brings a fresh perspective to melodic house and techno, crafting immersive sonic landscapes through ethereal melodies and driving, world-inspired rhythms. Together, these artists promise a carefully curated journey through house music's deeper, more soulful dimensions, reflecting the series' commitment to sonic exploration.

Papaya Playa Project's Curatorial Vision

Under the Moonlight, presented by Papaya Playa Project, stands as a testament to Tulum's evolving electronic music landscape. As part of PPP's broader commitment to merging local culture with cutting-edge global sounds, this series embodies a dedication to deep, soulful house music within a conscious environment. It represents a consistent platform for artists who bridge underground credibility with expansive, dancefloor-oriented productions, building on PPP's established history of hosting significant musical events. The series fosters a vibrant community of discerning listeners, consistently delivering carefully curated experiences under the Tulum sky that resonate with the region's unique spirit.

Beachfront Rhythms at Papaya Playa Project

Situated along Tulum's extensive coastline, Papaya Playa Project offers a distinctive backdrop for Under the Moonlight. The open-air beach club, known for its sustainable luxury and harmony with nature, invites attendees to dance directly on the sand, with the ocean's rhythm merging seamlessly with the electronic soundscapes. This unique design fosters an intimate, grounded atmosphere, where the natural elements—from the stars illuminating the night sky to the sand underfoot—become integral to the collective sonic and physical movement. The venue's thoughtful integration with its surroundings enhances the deeper, more introspective qualities of the music presented.

Entry and Evening Logistics

General admission for Under the Moonlight commences at 7:00 PM, with last entry strictly at 12:50 AM, ensuring a focused dancefloor experience. Ticket prices for the musical journey begin at $2,420 MXN, offering access to the performances and immersive art experiences that define this series. A casual dress code is suggested for general admission attendees, while those with dinner reservations can opt for a dinner-casual approach. Advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended, as availability is often limited for this sought-after Saturday gathering, particularly as the event date approaches.
en.description: Tim Green and Ukiyo bring soulful, groovy house Under the Moonlight. Dance to carefully curated music under the stars.
en.name: Under the Moonlight

es.body:
TIM GREEN & UKIYO: Una convergencia sónica

Esta edición de Under the Moonlight en Papaya Playa Project presenta una atractiva alineación que incluye al veterano productor Tim Green junto al emergente Ukiyo. Tim Green, una figura de larga trayectoria en la escena house mundial y un artista clave en Dirtybird, es conocido por su deep house característico y groovy, caracterizado por ritmos sofisticados y un funk con ribetes tech que construye energía a través de la progresión orgánica. Su presencia garantiza un viaje a través de sonidos meticulosamente seleccionados. Como complemento, Ukiyo aporta una nueva perspectiva al house melódico y al techno, creando paisajes sonoros envolventes a través de melodías etéreas y ritmos inspirados en el mundo. Juntos, estos artistas prometen un viaje cuidadosamente seleccionado a través de las dimensiones más profundas y conmovedoras de la música house, reflejando el compromiso de la serie con la exploración sónica.

La visión curatorial de Papaya Playa Project

Under the Moonlight, presentado por Papaya Playa Project, es un testimonio de la evolución del panorama de la música electrónica en Tulum. Como parte del compromiso más amplio de PPP de fusionar la cultura local con sonidos globales de vanguardia, esta serie encarna una dedicación a la música house profunda y conmovedora dentro de un entorno consciente. Representa una plataforma coherente para artistas que unen la credibilidad underground con producciones expansivas y orientadas a la pista de baile, basándose en la consolidada historia de PPP como anfitrión de importantes eventos musicales. La serie fomenta una vibrante comunidad de oyentes exigentes, ofreciendo constantemente experiencias cuidadosamente comisariadas bajo el cielo de Tulum que resuenan con el espíritu único de la región.

Ritmos frente al mar en el Proyecto Papaya Playa

Situado a lo largo de la extensa costa de Tulum, Papaya Playa Project ofrece un telón de fondo distintivo para Under the Moonlight. El club de playa al aire libre, conocido por su lujo sostenible y su armonía con la naturaleza, invita a los asistentes a bailar directamente sobre la arena, con el ritmo del océano fundiéndose a la perfección con los paisajes sonoros electrónicos. Este diseño único fomenta una atmósfera íntima y enraizada, donde los elementos naturales -desde las estrellas que iluminan el cielo nocturno hasta la arena bajo los pies- se convierten en parte integrante del movimiento sonoro y físico colectivo. La cuidada integración del lugar con su entorno realza las cualidades más profundas e introspectivas de la música presentada.

Entrada y logística de la velada

La entrada general para Under the Moonlight comienza a las 19:00 y la última a las 12:50, lo que garantiza una experiencia centrada en la pista de baile. Los precios de los boletos para el viaje musical comienzan en $2,420 MXN, ofreciendo acceso a las actuaciones y experiencias artísticas inmersivas que definen esta serie. Se sugiere un código de vestimenta casual para los asistentes de admisión general, mientras que aquellos con reservaciones para la cena pueden optar por un enfoque cena-casual. Se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de entradas, ya que la disponibilidad suele ser limitada para este codiciado encuentro de los sábados, especialmente a medida que se acerca la fecha del evento.
es.description: Tim Green y Ukiyo traen el soul y el groovy house bajo la luz de la luna. Baile bajo las estrellas con música cuidadosamente seleccionada.
es.name: Under the Moonlight

en.body:
Ibán Mendoza, Marco Norma & Berni: A Surrealist Soundscape

This edition of Gala Ibiza at Vagalume showcases a meticulously curated lineup featuring Ibán Mendoza, Marco Norma, and Berni, each contributing to the series' distinctive avant-garde electronic sound. As the visionary behind Gala, Ibán Mendoza's presence ensures the evening's musical journey aligns with the event's core identity, pushing boundaries within house and melodic techno. Marco Norma and Berni complement this direction, promising a session rich in rhythmic complexity and forward-thinking sonic textures, transforming the dance floor into a dynamic canvas for artistic expression.

Gala Ibiza: From White Isle to Riviera Maya

Born on the iconic White Isle, Gala Ibiza has evolved from a celebrated seasonal residency into a formidable international party series, bringing its unique artistic vision to global stages. Returning to Vagalume Tulum for its second consecutive year, the event, orchestrated by Ibán Mendoza, stands as a testament to its enduring appeal and curatorial strength. Gala distinguishes itself through a profound connection to surrealism, presenting a masterful fusion of artistic and musical elements that elevate the traditional club experience into a full-sensory immersion within Tulum's vibrant electronic music landscape.

Vagalume's Transformative Beachfront

Vagalume Tulum provides the perfect backdrop for Gala Ibiza's artistic endeavors, a premium beach club that seamlessly shifts from daytime tranquility to nighttime effervescence. Situated in Tulum's hotel zone with stunning Caribbean beachfront views, the venue’s high-end atmosphere and open-air design enhance the series' "total immersion" concept. Here, the cutting-edge electronic music, typically spanning deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno, resonates across a space designed to accommodate both energetic dancefloors and intimate corners, all while performances unfold around the crowd.

Essential Details for Entry

Gala Ibiza commences at 19:00, continuing until 1:00, offering an evening-to-late-night progression. The suggested dress code is "Tulum Style," encouraging a blend of bohemian elegance and comfortable club wear suitable for the beachfront setting. Tickets for this esteemed event series begin at $550 MXN for early bird access, with prices escalating through subsequent releases. Given Vagalume's popularity and Gala Ibiza's reputation, securing advanced tickets is highly recommended to ensure entry to this sought-after gathering.
en.description: IBÁN MENDOZA, MARCO NORMA, and BERNI deliver cutting-edge electronic music with surreal visuals and live performances for Gala Ibiza's vibrant night.
en.name: Gala Ibiza

es.body:
Ibán Mendoza, Marco Norma y Berni: Un paisaje sonoro surrealista

Esta edición de Gala Ibiza en Vagalume presenta un cartel meticulosamente comisariado con Ibán Mendoza, Marco Norma y Berni, cada uno contribuyendo al distintivo sonido electrónico vanguardista de la serie. Como visionario detrás de Gala, la presencia de Ibán Mendoza asegura que el viaje musical de la noche se alinee con la identidad central del evento, empujando los límites dentro del house y el techno melódico. Marco Norma y Berni complementan esta dirección, prometiendo una sesión rica en complejidad rítmica y texturas sónicas de vanguardia, transformando la pista de baile en un lienzo dinámico para la expresión artística.

Gala Ibiza: De la Isla Blanca a la Riviera Maya

Nacida en la emblemática Isla Blanca, Gala Ibiza ha pasado de ser una célebre residencia de temporada a una formidable serie de fiestas internacionales, llevando su visión artística única a escenarios de todo el mundo. En su regreso a Vagalume Tulum por segundo año consecutivo, el evento, orquestado por Ibán Mendoza, se erige como testamento de su perdurable atractivo y fuerza curatorial. Gala se distingue por una profunda conexión con el surrealismo, presentando una fusión magistral de elementos artísticos y musicales que elevan la experiencia tradicional del club a una inmersión sensorial completa dentro del vibrante paisaje de la música electrónica de Tulum.

La transformación de Vagalume frente al mar

Vagalume Tulum proporciona el telón de fondo perfecto para los esfuerzos artísticos de Gala Ibiza, un club de playa de primera calidad que cambia a la perfección de la tranquilidad diurna a la efervescencia nocturna. Situado en la zona hotelera de Tulum, con impresionantes vistas de la playa caribeña, el ambiente de alta gama del local y su diseño al aire libre realzan el concepto de "inmersión total" de la serie. Aquí, la música electrónica de vanguardia, que suele abarcar deep house, progressive house y techno melódico, resuena en un espacio diseñado para albergar tanto enérgicas pistas de baile como rincones íntimos, todo ello mientras las actuaciones se desarrollan alrededor del público.

Detalles esenciales para la entrada

Gala Ibiza comienza a las 19:00 y continúa hasta la 1:00, ofreciendo una progresión de la tarde a la noche. El código de vestimenta sugerido es el "estilo Tulum", que fomenta una mezcla de elegancia bohemia y ropa de club cómoda adecuada para el entorno frente a la playa. Los boletos para esta estimada serie de eventos comienzan en $550 MXN para el acceso anticipado, con precios que escalan a través de lanzamientos posteriores. Dada la popularidad de Vagalume y la reputación de Gala Ibiza, es muy recomendable conseguir entradas anticipadas para asegurar la entrada a este codiciado encuentro.
es.description: IBÁN MENDOZA, MARCO NORMA y BERNI ofrecen música electrónica de vanguardia con visuales surrealistas y actuaciones en directo para la vibrante noche de Gala Ibiza.
es.name: Gala Ibiza

en.body:
We’re Back — Same Energy, New Season!

We return to Tulumania for a Saturday session of fun music, tasty food and amazing vibe.  Once again, there’s no cover and no minimum consumption — all sunbeds are available on a first-come, first-serve basis, so come early and find your favorite spot by the beach.

A Fresh Chapter of Brunch in Tulum

After an amazing run last season with artists like Chris Luno, Rockin Moroccin, Palais Vert, and many others we’re excited to bring Tu Brunch to different venues across Tulum — each with its own unique character and charm. The goal is simple: keep every brunch fresh, spontaneous, and full of surprises, so no two are ever the same.

Beachside Vibes at Tulumania (Previously Akiin)

Recently refurbished and perfectly located by the sea, Tulumania sets the stage for our first brunch of the season. Tulumania’s new look combines modern comfort with its natural beauty, offering everything you need for a perfect Saturday by the beach. Expect delicious food, refreshing cocktails, and the best house music from local and international artists.
en.description: Tu Brunch is back this Saturday at Tulumania with Channel Freed, Luciana and Tucci. No cover, no minimum consumption—just good music, beach vibes and great energy. Free tickets available now.
en.name: Tu Brunch /w Channel Freed

es.body:
Estamos de vuelta - ¡Misma energía, nueva temporada!

Volvemos a Tulumania para una sesión de sábado de música divertida, comida sabrosa y un ambiente increíble. Una vez más, no hay cover ni consumo mínimo - todas las tumbonas están disponibles por orden de llegada, así que ven temprano y encuentra tu lugar favorito en la playa.

Un nuevo capítulo del brunch en Tulum

Después de una carrera increíble la temporada pasada con artistas como Chris Luno, Rockin Moroccin, Palais Vert, y muchos otros estamos muy contentos de traer Tu Brunch a diferentes lugares a través de Tulum - cada uno con su propio carácter único y encanto. El objetivo es simple: mantener cada brunch fresco, espontáneo y lleno de sorpresas, por lo que nunca hay dos iguales.

Beachside Vibes en Tulumania (antes Akiin)

Recientemente reformado y perfectamente situado junto al mar, Tulumania es el escenario de nuestro primer brunch de la temporada. El nuevo aspecto de Tulumania combina el confort moderno con su belleza natural, ofreciendo todo lo necesario para un sábado perfecto en la playa. Te espera comida deliciosa, cócteles refrescantes y la mejor música house de artistas locales e internacionales.
es.description: Tu Brunch vuelve este sábado a Tulumania con Channel Freed, Luciana y Tucci. No hay cover, no hay consumo mínimo-sólo buena música, vibras de playa y gran energía. Entradas gratis disponibles ahora.
es.name: Tu Brunch /w Channel Freed

en.body:
GIORGIO & JULIO, ROMO, and FLORENCIA VIGNA Command Vagalume

This edition of Dominik showcases a curated selection of artists poised to guide the dancefloor through a spectrum of organic house and melodic techno. GIORGIO & JULIO, known for their collaborative synergy, are expected to deliver sets rich with intricate percussion and flowing progressive elements. ROMO steps into the booth bringing a distinct energy, often characterized by driving basslines and atmospheric textures that resonate with Tulum's underground sensibilities. Completing the lineup, FLORENCIA VIGNA will contribute her unique perspective, weaving together sounds that encourage genuine connection and movement within the beachfront setting.

Dominik: Tulum's Confluence of Sound and Spirit

Dominik stands as a pivotal event series within Tulum's electronic music landscape, born from a desire to foster authentic human connection amidst the vibrant energy of the Riviera Maya. Emerging from Tulum itself, the series bridges the local community with international visitors, establishing a space where pretense is shed in favor of shared musical experience. It represents a distinctive blend of the natural jungle environment with sophisticated underground rhythms, offering a consistent platform for artists whose work aligns with a more introspective, yet energetic, sonic narrative within the region.

Vagalume Tulum: Where Rhythm Meets the Coast

The series finds its home at Vagalume Tulum, a premier beach club renowned for its energetic parties and scenic location in the hotel zone. This venue provides an ideal backdrop for Dominik, transitioning seamlessly from a sophisticated daytime setting to a lively nighttime hub. With beachfront views of the Caribbean Sea, the open-air design and natural elements of Vagalume enhance the sonic journey, allowing the music to interact with the ocean breeze and the stars. The space is particularly suited for the nuanced soundscapes of deep house and melodic techno, creating an intimate yet expansive dance environment.

Event Details and Entry Information

Dominik commences at 19:00, continuing until 01:00, offering an extended evening of music and communal spirit. Entry to this session starts with Early Bird Tickets at $605 MXN, with subsequent releases priced at $880 MXN and $1,210 MXN. Attendees are encouraged to embrace the "Tulum Style" dress code, favoring comfortable, bohemian-inspired attire suitable for a beach club setting. For those seeking a more exclusive arrangement, VIP tables with bottle service are available, providing an elevated viewing and social experience.
en.description: Dominik brings GIORGIO & JULIO, ROMO, and FLORENCIA VIGNA. Organic jungle rhythms and underground beats ignite a space for true connection.
en.name: Dominik

es.body:
GIORGIO & JULIO, ROMO y FLORENCIA VIGNA Command Vagalume

Esta edición de Dominik presenta una selección de artistas preparados para guiar a la pista de baile a través de un espectro de house orgánico y techno melódico. Se espera que GIORGIO & JULIO, conocidos por su sinergia colaborativa, ofrezcan sets ricos en percusión intrincada y elementos progresivos fluidos. ROMO entra en la cabina con una energía distinta, a menudo caracterizada por líneas de bajo y texturas atmosféricas que resuenan con la sensibilidad underground de Tulum. Completando el cartel, FLORENCIA VIGNA contribuirá con su perspectiva única, entretejiendo sonidos que fomentan la conexión genuina y el movimiento dentro del entorno frente a la playa.

Dominik: La confluencia del sonido y el espíritu de Tulum

Dominik se erige como una serie de eventos fundamentales dentro del panorama de la música electrónica de Tulum, nacida del deseo de fomentar una auténtica conexión humana en medio de la vibrante energía de la Riviera Maya. Surgida del propio Tulum, la serie tiende un puente entre la comunidad local y los visitantes internacionales, estableciendo un espacio en el que la pretensión se despoja en favor de la experiencia musical compartida. Representa una mezcla distintiva del entorno natural de la selva con sofisticados ritmos subterráneos, ofreciendo una plataforma consistente para artistas cuyo trabajo se alinea con una narrativa sonora más introspectiva, aunque enérgica, dentro de la región.

Vagalume Tulum: Donde el ritmo se encuentra con la costa

La serie tiene su sede en Vagalume Tulum, un club de playa de primera categoría famoso por sus enérgicas fiestas y su pintoresca ubicación en la zona hotelera. Este lugar ofrece un telón de fondo ideal para Dominik, pasando sin problemas de un sofisticado ambiente diurno a un animado centro nocturno. Con vistas al mar Caribe en primera línea de playa, el diseño al aire libre y los elementos naturales de Vagalume realzan el viaje sonoro, permitiendo que la música interactúe con la brisa marina y las estrellas. El espacio es especialmente adecuado para los matizados paisajes sonoros del deep house y el techno melódico, creando un ambiente de baile íntimo pero expansivo.

Detalles del evento e información sobre la entrada

Dominik comienza a las 19:00 y continúa hasta la 01:00, ofreciendo una larga velada de música y espíritu comunitario. La entrada a esta sesión comienza con Early Bird Tickets a $605 MXN, con ediciones posteriores a $880 MXN y $1,210 MXN. Se anima a los asistentes a adoptar el código de vestimenta "Tulum Style", favoreciendo un atuendo cómodo, de inspiración bohemia, adecuado para un entorno de club de playa. Para aquellos que buscan un arreglo más exclusivo, las mesas VIP con servicio de botella están disponibles, proporcionando una experiencia social y de visualización elevada.

en.body:
Mr Belt & Wezol's Global House Trajectory

Hailing from the vibrant Dutch electronic music scene, the duo Mr Belt & Wezol have carved out a distinctive niche with their high-energy, vocal-driven approach to house music. They rose to prominence by skillfully constructing tracks that bridge the gap between classic house sensibilities and contemporary future house dynamics, quickly establishing a dedicated global following. Their career trajectory is marked by a consistent output of infectious anthems that have seen them command stages worldwide, from major festivals to intimate club nights, solidifying their position as purveyors of accessible yet meticulously produced dancefloor material. Their sound often explores catchy melodic hooks paired with driving rhythms, making them a fixture in many club rotations.

Groove-Centric House Architectures

Mr Belt & Wezol's sound navigates the intersection of mainstream house and more nuanced electronic textures, characterized by driving four-to-the-floor kicks, infectious basslines, and expertly placed vocal hooks. Their production techniques lean into crisp percussion and bright, melodic synth work, often re-imagining classic motifs with a modern sheen while maintaining a fresh perspective. This year has seen the duo explore new sonic avenues with recent singles like "Ain't Nobody" (September 2025), "Starry Eyed Surprise" (October 2025), and "Dopamine (feat. Malou)" (October 2025). Their extensive catalog, including popular tracks such as "It's Not Right But It's Okay," "Homeless," and "I Feel Love," continues to resonate with a broad audience, evidenced by their nearly 201,297 Spotify followers and consistent streaming presence.

Late Night Grooves at Bonbonniere Tulum

Attendees can anticipate Mr Belt & Wezol to deliver a high-octane set at Bonbonniere Tulum, commencing at 10 PM and extending late into the night. Their performance is expected to construct a dynamic journey from driving house rhythms to vocal-heavy future house anthems, keeping the energy consistently elevated throughout. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and open-air design, featuring a retractable roof that reveals the starlit sky, provide an ideal backdrop for their vibrant and energetic sound. The venue's lively dance floor and sophisticated ambiance will perfectly complement the duo's stylistic approach, ensuring a commanding presence on the decks for an extended period, tailored to the Tulum nightlife.

Entry & Dress Code Enforcement

Entry to Mr Belt & Wezol's highly anticipated performance at Bonbonniere Tulum begins promptly at 10 PM. Starting ticket prices are set at $1,000 MXN. Adherence to the venue's strictly enforced formal dress code is mandatory, prohibiting beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, or sport shorts. Given Bonbonniere's reputation as Tulum's premier late-night destination, prospective attendees are strongly advised to secure tickets in advance to guarantee entry and avoid disappointment at this popular event.
en.description: Acclaimed by over 200k Spotify followers, Mr Belt & Wezol deliver their signature future house sound, bringing high-energy house beats.
en.name: Mr Belt & Wezol

en.body:
The Ritual's Musical Journey

Joel Kim sets the initial tone during the immersive dinner, guiding guests through the welcoming ritual with curated music from 18:30 to 20:00. As the evening transitions to "The Awakening" party, Francisco Allendes takes the lead on the cenote dancefloor, known for his dynamic sets. He is supported by a warm-up from Rameff b2b Nyto, who will build the energy for the main celebration. This progressive DJ lineup is integral to the event's shift from a sensory dining experience to a full celebration, culminating in the countdown to 2026.

Vesica Tulum's Jungle Sanctuary

VESICA Tulum provides a unique spot for this New Year's Eve celebration, functioning as a cenote sanctuary where natural elements are central to the experience. The venue integrates gastronomy, wellness, and music within its jungle setting. Guests will find themselves on a cenote dancefloor, with access to various lounges and hidden rest areas, all designed to harmonize with the surrounding nature and enhance the transformative ritual.

Planning Your New Year's Eve Ritual

NYE at Vesica Tulum commences on December 31st, 2025, at 18:30, continuing until 04:00. Guests are encouraged to adhere to an elegant dress code with jungle inspiration, favoring white, black, gold, beige, or olive green. Packages range from the full Dinner + Ritual + Party + Open Bar at $5,400 MXN plus service fee, to Party + Open Bar access for $3,400 MXN plus service fee. VIP Lounge Areas are also available starting from $20,000 MXN. All attendees must be 18+ with valid ID.

en.name: NYE at Vesica: the Ritual of New Beginnings

es.body:
Anticipando a los arquitectos sónicos

La Nochevieja en Vesica Cenote: El Ritual de los Nuevos Comienzos contará con un cartel de DJ progresivos. Esta selección sugiere un viaje a través del espectro de la música electrónica, con la expectativa de artistas que puedan pasar sin problemas de la experiencia ritual de la cena a una vibrante celebración de Nochevieja. Dado que Vesica se centra en la armonía con la naturaleza y las experiencias transformadoras, es probable que la selección se incline por el house orgánico, melódico o ritmos tribales profundos que resuenen con el ambiente selvático.

El ethos ritualista de Vesica

Nochevieja en Vesica Tulum: The Ritual of New Beginnings se erige como una oferta significativa dentro del vibrante panorama de la música electrónica de Tulum.p Vesica, como organización, defiende un enfoque holístico, posicionando sus eventos no sólo como fiestas, sino como reuniones ceremoniales diseñadas para la introspección y la renovación. Este evento anual de Nochevieja encarna un profundo significado cultural, invitando a los participantes a honrar los ciclos y abrazar los nuevos comienzos a través de una velada cuidadosamente estructurada que combina la exploración culinaria con potentes actuaciones en directo y música electrónica. Representa una faceta distintiva de la escena de Tulum, que va más allá de la típica vida nocturna para fomentar una conexión más profunda.

Acústica del Santuario del Cenote

El local de Vesica Tulum ofrece un entorno verdaderamente único para este ritual de Nochevieja, centrado en torno a su santuario natural del cenote. La arquitectura armoniza con la selva circundante, creando un ambiente al aire libre donde el sonido se dispersa de forma natural, pero mantiene una presencia convincente. La pista de baile, situada junto al cenote, proporciona una conexión elemental con la tierra, mientras que los salones circundantes y las zonas de descanso ocultas ofrecen un respiro dentro del exuberante paisaje. Este diseño deliberado mejora la experiencia sonora general, permitiendo un sonido rico y resonante que complementa la naturaleza orgánica y progresiva de la música electrónica presentada.

Navegando por la transición de Nochevieja

La noche en Vesica Tulum comienza temprano el 31 de diciembre de 2025, con una cena de inmersión de 18:30 a 23:00, seguido por el ritual principal a las 23:00, la transición a la fiesta de 23:30 hasta las 04:00. La entrada general para la parte de la fiesta comienza a las 23:30. La entrada general para la parte de la fiesta comienza en 1.320 MXN, con paquetes completos como "Fiesta + Barra libre" disponible desde 3.400 MXN, y "Cena + Ritual + Fiesta + Barra libre" a 5.400 MXN. Se anima a los invitados a seguir un código de vestimenta elegante, inspirado en la jungla, en blanco, negro, dorado, beige o verde oliva. Dada la popularidad del evento y la naturaleza festiva de la víspera de Año Nuevo, se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de entradas.

es.name: NYE at Vesica: the Ritual of New Beginnings

en.body:
Maceo Plex

Located deep within the circuitry of a mechanical alien host known as Maetrik, the complex entity known as Maceo Plex emerged, driven by a need for feeling and interplanetary expression. This artistic persona quickly carved a distinctive niche within electronic music, becoming synonymous with a sound that expertly navigates the realms of melodic techno, minimal techno, and tech house. With a career trajectory defined by sophisticated productions and compelling DJ sets, Maceo Plex has established himself as a prominent figure, known for his intricate sound design and thoughtful composition.

Melodic Techno Architect

Maceo Plex constructs a soundscape that blends the hypnotic repetition of minimal techno with the driving energy of tech house, often imbued with a profound melodic sensibility. His production techniques emphasize detailed synthesis and robust basslines, crafting tracks that are both dancefloor-ready and deeply layered. While his latest album, '93, released in 2023, continues to define his evolving sound, earlier works like "Solitary Daze" and his influential remix of "Sordid Affair" showcase his mastery of atmosphere and groove. With over 380,436 Spotify followers, his consistent output across albums such as Mutant Series (2019) and Solar (2017) ensures his presence across electronic music platforms.

Vagalume Sessions Under Tulum's Stars

This performance at Vagalume Tulum promises to be a journey through Maceo Plex's expansive sonic universe, likely commencing with deeper tech house rhythms before progressively building into his signature melodic techno peaks. The Vagalume beach club, known for its energetic parties and high-end atmosphere in Tulum's hotel zone, provides an ideal backdrop for his intricate sound. Supporting acts VITE + MIGANOVA, RENÊ, MIUL, and NEGRINM will set the stage with their complementary selections, preparing the audience for Maceo Plex's extended set within the venue's vibrant, beachfront environment.

Tickets & Tulum Style

Entry for this Vagalume Sessions event starts with Early Bird Tickets at $880 MXN, progressing through First, Second, and Last Release tiers. The event runs from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, with Maceo Plex expected to command the decks during the prime evening hours, culminating in a late-night crescendo. A "Tulum Style" dress code is encouraged, reflecting the venue's premium aesthetic. VIP tables with bottle service are available for those seeking an elevated experience. Advanced purchase is highly recommended to secure access to this anticipated electronic extravaganza.

Situada en lo más profundo de los circuitos de un huésped alienígena mecánico conocido como Maetrik, la compleja entidad conocida como Maceo Plex surgió impulsada por una necesidad de sentimiento y expresión interplanetaria. Con una trayectoria profesional definida por sofisticadas producciones y convincentes sesiones de DJ, Maceo Plex se ha consolidado como una figura prominente, conocida por su intrincado diseño sonoro y su meditada composición.

Arquitecto del techno melódico

Maceo Plex construye un paisaje sonoro que mezcla la repetición hipnótica del techno minimalista con la energía impulsora del tech house, a menudo imbuida de una profunda sensibilidad melódica. Sus técnicas de producción hacen hincapié en la síntesis detallada y las líneas de bajo robustas, creando pistas que están listas para la pista de baile y a la vez profundamente estratificadas. Aunque su último álbum, '93, publicado en 2023, sigue definiendo su sonido en evolución, trabajos anteriores como "Solitary Daze" y su influyente remezcla de "Sordid Affair" muestran su dominio de la atmósfera y el groove. Con más de 380.436 seguidores en Spotify, su producción constante a través de álbumes como Mutant Series (2019) y Solar (2017) asegura su presencia en todas las plataformas de música electrónica.

Sesiones de Vagalume bajo las estrellas de Tulum

Esta actuación en Vagalume Tulum promete ser un viaje a través del universo sónico expansivo de Maceo Plex, probablemente comenzando con ritmos tech house más profundos antes de construir progresivamente hacia sus picos de techno melódico característicos. El club de playa Vagalume, conocido por sus enérgicas fiestas y su ambiente de alta gama en la zona hotelera de Tulum, ofrece un telón de fondo ideal para su intrincado sonido. Los teloneros VITE + MIGANOVA, RENÊ, MIUL, y NEGRINM prepararán el escenario con sus selecciones complementarias, preparando al público para el extenso set de Maceo Plex dentro del vibrante ambiente frente al mar del lugar.

Entradas y estilo Tulum

La entrada para este evento de Vagalume Sessions comienza con los boletos Early Bird a $880 MXN, pasando por los niveles First, Second y Last Release. El evento se llevará a cabo de 1:00 PM a 1:00 AM, con Maceo Plex al mando de los platos durante las horas de la tarde, culminando en un crescendo nocturno. Se recomienda un código de vestimenta "estilo Tulum", que refleje la estética de primera calidad del lugar. Hay mesas VIP con servicio de botella disponibles para aquellos que busquen una experiencia superior. Se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada para asegurarse el acceso a esta esperada extravagancia electrónica.

en.body:
EMMANUEL SATIE, JONATHAN KASPAR & More Define Cocoon Tulum's Soundscape

This edition of Cocoon x Sinner at Vagalume showcases a meticulously curated lineup featuring EMMANUEL SATIE, JONATHAN KASPAR, VITE + MIGANOVA, THE WAY OF THINKING, CORCUERA, and RENÊ. EMMANUEL SATIE is recognized for his sophisticated take on melodic house and techno, often weaving intricate narratives through his selections. JONATHAN KASPAR brings a more driving and rhythmic energy, known for crafting dynamic journeys on the dancefloor. VITE + MIGANOVA contribute a powerful duo dynamic, while THE WAY OF THINKING, CORCUERA, and RENÊ round out the programming with their distinct interpretations of house and progressive sounds. Together, these artists are poised to deliver a cohesive yet diverse electronic soundscape, guiding attendees through an extended day-to-night celebration true to Cocoon’s globally respected curatorial vision.

Cocoon's Enduring Legacy and Tulum's Sinner Partnership

Cocoon, the iconic electronic music institution founded by Sven Väth, has long been a global beacon for cutting-edge events, evolving from its Frankfurt origins to legendary Ibiza residencies. The organization's ethos centers on fostering a profound sense of community and the uninhibited freedom found within the music. For this special January 2026 event, Cocoon extends its influential reach into Mexico's vibrant electronic scene through its partnership with Sinner. This collaboration represents a potent fusion of Cocoon's established curatorial vision—guided by those who define "the Cocoon sound"—with Sinner's local insight, collectively building a platform that consistently showcases a forward-thinking approach to electronic music in Tulum.

Vagalume Tulum: From Caribbean Serenity to Nightlife Pulse

Nestled within Tulum's sought-after Hotel Zone, Vagalume Tulum provides a quintessential beachfront setting for this extended day-to-night affair. The premium beach club is celebrated for its seamless transition from a serene daytime lounge, offering breathtaking Caribbean views and refined dining, to an energetic nighttime destination. Its open-air architecture and direct proximity to the ocean create an unparalleled atmosphere where electronic rhythms perfectly complement the natural surroundings. Vagalume's reputation for hosting both international and local DJs ensures a high-quality production backdrop, making it a prime location for an immersive celebration under the sun and stars.

Essential Details for the Tulum Gathering

The Cocoon x Sinner event is slated for January 17, 2026, commencing at 13:00 HRS and extending 1am into the night. Attendees are invited to embrace the event's distinct aesthetic with a recommended "All Black / Sexy Attire" dress code. For those desiring an elevated experience, VIP tables complete with bottle service are available; interested parties can find more information by sending a WhatsApp message to +52 4421092488. General admission tickets for this highly anticipated event are expected to start at $880 MXN, and given the series' global reputation and local appeal, securing tickets in advance is strongly advised.

Anticipating the Curated Roster

The Mixmag Caribbean Sessions at Vagalume promises a finely tuned selection of electronic artists to set the tone for this new chapter in Tulum. While the full lineup for the January 11, 2026, session remains unannounced, the series carries Mixmag's global reputation for showcasing influential figures and rising talents within the realms of house, progressive house, and melodic techno. Attendees can expect a roster carefully chosen to complement Tulum's vibrant energy, delivering sets that align with Vagalume's signature sound profile. The anticipation builds for an assembly of DJs poised to define the rhythm of this edition.

Mixmag's Enduring Legacy in Electronic Music

Originating in 1983 as a pioneering British print magazine, Mixmag has evolved into a formidable global entity in electronic dance music culture. Beyond its acclaimed publications, the organization is renowned for its influential dance events, including the iconic 'The Lab' series, which began in 2012. This expansion into live experiences, now with the Mixmag Caribbean Sessions, solidifies its role as a curatorial force, bringing its deep understanding of the scene to new destinations. The series in Tulum represents a significant extension of Mixmag's commitment to fostering electronic music communities worldwide.

Vagalume's Beachfront Sanctuary

The Mixmag Caribbean Sessions finds its home at Vagalume Tulum, a premier beach club known for its seamless transition from sun-drenched relaxation to high-energy nightlife. Situated in Tulum's vibrant hotel zone, the venue offers breathtaking beachfront views and a sophisticated ambiance. Its open-air setting, with sand underfoot, provides an organic canvas perfectly suited for the immersive soundscapes of electronic music, particularly the deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno styles typically featured. Vagalume's design fosters an intimate yet expansive atmosphere, enhancing the connection between sound, nature, and the collective experience.

Planning Your Tulum Session

The inaugural Mixmag Caribbean Session on January 11, 2026, kicks off a series of five dates, running from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM. Entry to this sought-after event begins at $880 MXN for early bird tickets, with prices escalating through subsequent releases. Guests are encouraged to embrace the "Tulum Style" dress code, reflecting the destination's bohemian yet chic aesthetic. Given Vagalume's popularity and Mixmag's global draw, securing tickets in advance is highly advisable for those looking to be part of this significant electronic music gathering.

es.body:
Anticipando el Curated Roster

Las Mixmag Caribbean Sessions en Vagalume prometen una cuidada selección de artistas electrónicos que marcarán el tono de este nuevo capítulo en Tulum. Aunque el cartel completo para la sesión del 11 de enero de 2026 aún no se ha anunciado, la serie lleva la reputación mundial de Mixmag de mostrar figuras influyentes y talentos en ascenso dentro de los reinos del house, house progresivo y techno melódico. Los asistentes pueden esperar una lista cuidadosamente elegida para complementar la vibrante energía de Tulum, ofreciendo sets que se alinean con el perfil de sonido característico de Vagalume. La expectación por ver a los DJs dispuestos a definir el ritmo de esta edición es cada vez mayor.

El legado perdurable de Mixmag en la música electrónica

Mixmag, que nació en 1983 como una pionera revista impresa británica, ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en una formidable entidad mundial de la cultura de la música electrónica de baile. Más allá de sus aclamadas publicaciones, la organización es conocida por sus influyentes eventos dance, incluida la icónica serie "The Lab", que comenzó en 2012. Esta expansión a experiencias en vivo, ahora con las Mixmag Caribbean Sessions, solidifica su papel como fuerza curatorial, llevando su profundo conocimiento de la escena a nuevos destinos. La serie en Tulum representa una extensión significativa del compromiso de Mixmag para fomentar las comunidades de música electrónica en todo el mundo.

Santuario frente al mar de Vagalume

Las Mixmag Caribbean Sessions se celebran en Vagalume Tulum, un club de playa de primera categoría conocido por su perfecta transición entre la relajación bañada por el sol y la vida nocturna llena de energía. Situado en la vibrante zona hotelera de Tulum, el local ofrece impresionantes vistas de la playa y un ambiente sofisticado. Su entorno al aire libre, con arena bajo los pies, ofrece un lienzo orgánico perfectamente adecuado para los envolventes paisajes sonoros de la música electrónica, en particular los estilos deep house, progressive house y techno melódico que se suelen ofrecer. El diseño de Vagalume fomenta un ambiente íntimo pero expansivo, mejorando la conexión entre el sonido, la naturaleza y la experiencia colectiva.

Planifica tu sesión en Tulum

La Mixmag Caribbean Session inaugural, el 11 de enero de 2026, da comienzo a una serie de cinco fechas, de 13:00 a 1:00 horas. La entrada a este codiciado evento comienza en $ 880 MXN para los boletos de aves tempranas, con precios escalando a través de lanzamientos posteriores. Se anima a los invitados a adoptar el código de vestimenta "Tulum Style", que refleja la estética bohemia y chic del destino. Dada la popularidad de Vagalume y la atracción global de Mixmag, es altamente recomendable asegurar boletos con anticipación para aquellos que buscan ser parte de este importante encuentro de música electrónica.
es.description: Mix Mag trae el ritmo caribeño y el alma electrónica a Tulum. Anticipa un cartel de artistas que unirán sonido, naturaleza y comunidad.
es.name: Mix Mag

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Sinner’s opening season party ignites Vagalume with a carefully curated lineup. VITE + MIGANOVA, the series’ creators, set the tone with their signature blend of house music designed for sun-soaked afternoons and escalating energy as night descends. Holder, known for his appearances with Mayan Warrior, brings a deeper, driving sound, while Omikami and Negrinm round out the sonic landscape with their contributions to the Tulum circuit. This edition promises a seamless transition from beachside bliss to after-dark revelry.

Tulum's Weekly Ritual

Now in its fourth season, Sinner has solidified its position as a Tulum institution. Conceived by VITE and Miganova, the party series distinguishes itself with a boutique approach, prioritizing a cohesive blend of music, aesthetics, and overall atmosphere. Sinner aims to elevate the senses, becoming a weekly ritual for those seeking a sophisticated and seductive escape within Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene. It’s a space where international visitors and locals alike converge to lose themselves in the music and the moment.

Beachfront Atmosphere

Vagalume Tulum, nestled in the hotel zone, provides the perfect backdrop for Sinner’s immersive experience. During the day, the beach club offers a tranquil escape, but as the sun dips below the horizon, Vagalume transforms into an energetic hub. The venue’s beachfront location, combined with its sophisticated design, creates an atmosphere of barefoot elegance, inviting guests to dance the night away under the stars.

Tables & Tickets

Sinner Opening Season Party at Vagalume kicks off on December 6th at 3:00 PM and continues until 1:00 AM. General admission tickets start at $605 MXN. Secure a table for bottle service by contacting +52 4421092488. Given Sinner's popularity, advance ticket purchases and table reservations are highly recommended to guarantee entry.
en.description: Sinner's curated lineup delivers seductive Tulum vibes! Expect a night where music, aesthetics & atmosphere intertwine.
en.name: Sinner Opening Season Party

en.body:
AWA, BADAOUI, and the Somos Tulum Collective

The lineup for this edition of Somos Tulum II reads like a who's-who of the Tulum circuit, showcasing the diverse sounds currently emanating from the Yucatan Peninsula. AWA brings a blend of deep house and melodic techno, while BADAOUI leans toward the more progressive and ethereal end of the spectrum. The remaining artists, including Gianfranco Corradi, Julioo, Leo Leonski, Miguel, RoMo, Tiago Dima, and Vales.

Vesica's Immersive Embrace

Cenote Vesica offers a unique backdrop for Somos Tulum, blending the raw energy of the jungle with the tranquil beauty of a natural cenote. The open-air dance floor allows for a seamless connection with nature, while the surrounding vegetation creates an intimate and immersive experience. The natural acoustics of the cenote amplify the music, creating an unforgettable sonic experience for attendees.

Tickets & Timing

Somos Tulum II kicks off at 9:00 AM on December 27th and runs until 10:00 PM, offering a full day of music and art. Tickets start at $400 MXN for local residents with valid ID, with early bird tickets available for $715 MXN.
en.description: AWA, BADAOUI, and Gianfranco Corradi headline Somos Tulum Ii, with local artists bringing vibrant rhythms to Vesica's cenote.
