en.body:
The Night Ahead

Gypsy Disco inside Gitano Jungle promises a vibrant Friday night, blending modern Mexican dining with a high-energy dance party. As the evening progresses, world-class DJs provide the soundtrack, complemented by exclusive GITANO cabaret performances and the shimmering spectacle of the signature disco ball. This edition sets the stage for a night where the rhythms of organic house meet the pulsing energy of a Tulum night.

Tulum's Weekly Ritual

Gypsy Disco has become a cornerstone of Tulum's nightlife, a weekly gathering that embodies the area's bohemian spirit and love for music. More than just a party, it's a ritual that bridges the gap between the culinary and the musical, offering a seamless transition from a candlelit dinner to a vibrant dance floor under the jungle canopy. The Gypsy Disco series provides a space for music lovers to converge and celebrate the energy of Tulum.

Dining Under the Palms

Gitano Jungle offers a unique setting, transforming from a restaurant into an energetic dance floor as the night unfolds. The architecture blends seamlessly with the natural surroundings, creating an immersive experience where the boundaries between inside and outside blur. The venue's design, complete with a canopy overhead, creates an intimate atmosphere that enhances the music and adds to the overall allure.

Tables & Tickets

Dinner seating begins at 6 PM, with tables reserved throughout the night. Tickets start at $880 MXN and are available for purchase in advance, highly recommended to secure your spot. As Gypsy Disco reaches its peak later in the evening, bottle service brings the party directly to your table.
en.description: Artists and DJs ignite Gypsy Disco's dance floor! Expect exclusive GITANO cabaret performances and shimmering disco vibes under the Tulum sky.
en.name: Gypsy Disco

es.body:
La noche que viene

Gypsy Disco dentro de Gitano Jungle promete una vibrante noche de viernes, mezclando la moderna comida mexicana con una fiesta de baile de alta energía. A medida que avanza la noche, la banda sonora la ponen DJs de talla mundial, complementados por actuaciones de cabaret exclusivas de GITANO y el resplandeciente espectáculo de la característica bola de discoteca. Esta edición prepara el escenario para una noche en la que los ritmos del house orgánico se encuentran con la palpitante energía de una noche en Tulum.

El ritual semanal de Tulum

Gypsy Disco se ha convertido en una piedra angular de la vida nocturna de Tulum, una reunión semanal que encarna el espíritu bohemio de la zona y el amor por la música. Más que una fiesta, es un ritual que tiende un puente entre lo culinario y lo musical, ofreciendo una transición perfecta de una cena a la luz de las velas a una vibrante pista de baile bajo el dosel de la selva. La serie Gypsy Disco ofrece un espacio para que los amantes de la música converjan y celebren la energía de Tulum.

Cenar bajo las palmeras

Gitano Jungle ofrece un entorno único, transformándose de un restaurante a una enérgica pista de baile a medida que transcurre la noche. La arquitectura se funde a la perfección con el entorno natural, creando una experiencia envolvente en la que los límites entre el interior y el exterior se difuminan. El diseño del local, con un toldo encima, crea un ambiente íntimo que realza la música y aumenta el encanto general.

Mesas y entradas

La cena comienza a las 6 PM, con mesas reservadas durante toda la noche. Los boletos cuestan a partir de $880 MXN y están disponibles para su compra por adelantado, muy recomendable para asegurar su lugar. Como Gypsy Disco llega a su apogeo más tarde en la noche, el servicio de botella trae la fiesta directamente a su mesa.
es.description: ¡Artistas y DJ encienden la pista de baile de Gypsy Disco! Espere actuaciones exclusivas de cabaret GITANO y vibraciones disco brillantes bajo el cielo de Tulum.
es.name: Gypsy Disco

en.body:
Tu Brunch at Mia Beachclub

This Sunday we’re bringing Tu Brunch to Mía Beach Club, where beach views, good music, and a fun daytime vibe come together for a perfect Sunday. End your week with sunshine, great food, and our warm Tu Brunch community.

A Fresh Chapter of Brunch in Tulum

After an amazing run last season with artists like Chris Luno, Rockin Moroccin, Palais Vert, and many others we’re excited to bring Tu Brunch to different venues across Tulum — each with its own unique character and charm. The goal is simple: keep every brunch fresh, spontaneous, and full of surprises, so no two are ever the same.

What to expect?

Expect a relaxed Sunday atmosphere right by the beach, with music playing throughout the day, plenty of space to dance or unwind, and a friendly crowd that brings the easygoing spirit of Tu Brunch. Mía offers great food and drinks, comfortable beachfront seating, and a beautiful place to enjoy sunshine, music, and good company with no cover and no minimum consumption (except for the front row sunbeds).
en.description: Tu Brunch returns this Sunday at Mía Beach Club with Kaltri, Frändel, Ivo RDGZ and Móiqe. A perfect beach day on a Sunday. Free entry with limited free beds — reserve your spot.
en.name: Tu Brunch /w Kaltri & more

es.body:
Tu Brunch en Mía Beachclub

Este domingo traemos Tu Brunch a Mía Beach Club, donde las vistas a la playa, la buena música y un ambiente diurno divertido se unen para un domingo perfecto. Termina tu semana con sol, buena comida y nuestra cálida comunidad Tu Brunch.

Un nuevo capítulo de Brunch en Tulum

Después de una carrera increíble la temporada pasada con artistas como Chris Luno, Rockin Moroccin, Palais Vert, y muchos otros estamos muy contentos de traer Tu Brunch a diferentes lugares a través de Tulum - cada uno con su propio carácter único y encanto. El objetivo es simple: mantener cada brunch fresco, espontáneo y lleno de sorpresas, por lo que nunca hay dos iguales.

¿Qué le espera?

Disfruta de un ambiente relajado los domingos junto a la playa, con música durante todo el día, mucho espacio para bailar o relajarse y un público amable que transmite el espíritu despreocupado de Tu Brunch. Mía ofrece buena comida y bebida, cómodos asientos en primera línea de playa y un hermoso lugar para disfrutar del sol, la música y la buena compañía sin entrada y sin consumición mínima (excepto para las tumbonas de la primera fila).
es.description: Tu Brunch vuelve este domingo a Mía Beach Club con Kaltri, Frändel, Ivo RDGZ y Móiqe. Un perfecto día de playa en domingo. Entrada gratuita con plazas libres limitadas - reserva tu sitio.
es.name: Tu Brunch /w Kaltri & more

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Ten Ibiza at Vagalume Tulum presents a carefully curated lineup this December, embarking on "A Journey into House Music." ORIOL CALVO, INVITES, POMBOKLAP, and RENÊ each contribute their distinct perspectives to the night, promising a sonic exploration rooted in house music's diverse subgenres. This edition offers a blend of established and emerging talents, reflecting Ibiza's enduring influence on global house music culture.

Ibiza's Tulum Takeover

Ten Ibiza brings a slice of the White Isle's vibrant party scene to the shores of Tulum. While details about the collective behind Ten Ibiza are scarce, their events consistently showcase a commitment to quality house music. The series offers a taste of Ibiza's hedonistic spirit, transported to the unique setting of the Mexican Caribbean.

Beachfront House Music

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the heart of the hotel zone, provides the ideal backdrop for Ten Ibiza's sonic journey. The venue's beachfront location and premium beach club atmosphere create a seamless transition from daytime relaxation to nighttime revelry. Expect a sand-between-your-toes experience as house rhythms pulsate beneath the stars.

Tables & Tickets

Doors open at 7 PM, and the sounds continue until 1 AM. Early bird tickets are available for $605 MXN, offering a more affordable entry to this premium event. Secure your tickets in advance to guarantee access to this showcase of house music at Vagalume Tulum.
en.description: Oriol Calvo, Pomboklap, and Renê guide Ten Ibiza through a house music journey with vibrant energy and irresistible rhythms.
en.name: Ten Ibiza

es.body:
La noche que viene

Ten Ibiza en Vagalume Tulum presenta un cartel cuidadosamente comisariado este diciembre, embarcándose en "Un viaje a la música House" ORIOL CALVO, INVITES, POMBOKLAP, y RENÊ aportan cada uno sus distintas perspectivas a la noche, prometiendo una exploración sonora arraigada en los diversos subgéneros de la música house. Esta edición ofrece una mezcla de talentos consagrados y emergentes, reflejo de la perdurable influencia de Ibiza en la cultura mundial de la música house.

Ibiza's Tulum Takeover

Ten Ibiza lleva un trozo de la vibrante escena festiva de la Isla Blanca a las costas de Tulum. Aunque no se conocen muchos detalles sobre el colectivo que está detrás de Ten Ibiza, sus eventos demuestran un compromiso constante con la música house de calidad. La serie ofrece una muestra del espíritu hedonista de Ibiza, transportado al entorno único del Caribe mexicano.

Música house frente al mar

Vagalume Tulum, situado en el corazón de la zona hotelera, ofrece el telón de fondo ideal para el viaje sonoro de Ten Ibiza. Su ubicación frente a la playa y su ambiente de club de playa de primera crean una transición perfecta de la relajación diurna a la juerga nocturna. Disfruta de la arena entre los dedos de los pies mientras los ritmos house laten bajo las estrellas.

Mesas y entradas

Las puertas se abren a las 19:00 y el sonido continúa hasta la 1:00 de la madrugada. Los boletos anticipados están disponibles por $605 MXN, ofreciendo una entrada más accesible a este evento premium. Asegura tus boletos con anticipación para garantizar el acceso a este escaparate de la música house en Vagalume Tulum.
es.description: Oriol Calvo, Pomboklap y Renê guían a Ten Ibiza a través de un viaje de música house con energía vibrante y ritmos irresistibles.
es.name: Ten Ibiza

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Steve Lawler and Jesse Zotti commandeer the decks for this edition of Pendulum at Vagalume, promising a night steeped in underground house and techno. Steve Lawler, a name synonymous with boundary-pushing sets, brings his signature sound, a blend of genres that keeps the dance floor moving. Jesse Zotti adds his distinct flavor to the mix, complementing Lawler's energy with his own take on contemporary electronic rhythms.

From Residency to Revival

Pendulum's return to Vagalume follows a highly acclaimed residency earlier in 2025, solidifying its place as a key event in Tulum's electronic music calendar. The series represents a curated experience, focusing on established names and rising talents within the house and techno scenes. Pendulum's commitment to delivering a quality musical experience has cultivated a dedicated following within Tulum and beyond.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum, nestled in the Hotel Zone, transforms from a serene beach club by day to a vibrant nightlife destination as the sun sets. The open-air venue, known for its premium atmosphere, allows the rhythms of Pendulum to merge seamlessly with the natural surroundings. Dancing barefoot on the sand, surrounded by the jungle's edge, creates a uniquely Tulum experience.

Secure Your Spot

Doors open at 7:00 PM and the party continues until 1:00 AM, with peak hours expected to be after 9 PM. Early bird tickets are available starting at $605 MXN, with prices increasing as the event date approaches. Adhering to the Tulum-style dress code is encouraged, and advance ticket purchase is recommended to guarantee entry to this sought-after event.
en.description: Steve Lawler & Jesse Zotti ignite Pendulum with signature underground sounds. Expect tribal grooves & energetic rhythms in Tulum's mystic atmosphere.
en.name: Pendulum

es.body:
La noche que viene

Steve Lawler y Jesse Zotti tomarán los platos en esta edición de Pendulum en Vagalume, prometiendo una noche impregnada de house y techno underground. Steve Lawler, un nombre sinónimo de sets que traspasan fronteras, aporta su sonido característico, una mezcla de géneros que mantiene la pista de baile en movimiento. Jesse Zotti añade su toque personal a la mezcla, complementando la energía de Lawler con su propia visión de los ritmos electrónicos contemporáneos.

De la residencia al revival

El regreso de Pendulum a Vagalume se produce después de una aclamada residencia a principios de 2025, consolidando su lugar como un evento clave en el calendario de música electrónica de Tulum. La serie representa una experiencia comisariada, centrada en nombres establecidos y talentos emergentes dentro de las escenas house y techno. El compromiso de Pendulum para ofrecer una experiencia musical de calidad ha cultivado un seguimiento dedicado dentro de Tulum y más allá.

Baile en la arena

Vagalume Tulum, situado en la Zona Hotelera, se transforma de un sereno club de playa durante el día a un vibrante destino nocturno cuando se pone el sol. El local al aire libre, conocido por su ambiente de primera, permite que los ritmos de Péndulo se fundan a la perfección con el entorno natural. Bailar descalzo sobre la arena, rodeado por el borde de la selva, crea una experiencia única en Tulum.

Asegura tu plaza

Las puertas se abren a las 19:00 y la fiesta continúa hasta la 1:00. Se espera que las horas punta sean a partir de las 21:00. Los boletos anticipados están disponibles a partir de $605 MXN, con precios que aumentan a medida que se acerca la fecha del evento. Se recomienda seguir el código de vestimenta de Tulum y comprar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a este codiciado evento.
es.description: Steve Lawler y Jesse Zotti encienden Pendulum con sus sonidos underground característicos. Disfruta de grooves tribales y ritmos enérgicos en la atmósfera mística de Tulum.
es.name: Pendulum

en.body:
Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer & Andru at The New Moon

This edition of The New Moon at Papaya Playa Project features a lineup dedicated to house and melodic sounds, bringing together Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer, and Andru. Portable, known for his deep and rhythmic productions, sets a foundational tone, while Tod Louie and Karl Fraunhofer contribute their distinct approaches to electronic music. Andru completes the bill, ensuring a carefully curated evening designed for the beachfront setting. The selection of these artists aims to create a specific atmosphere for dancing on the Caribbean shore.

Papaya Playa Project's Collaborative Series

Papaya Playa Project, a recognized name in Tulum's hospitality and events scene, presents "The New Moon" in collaboration with Det Gode Selskab. PPP has a history of hosting significant events, including their "Gratitude Season" which featured artists like Monolink and Dixon, and their signature "Full Moon Party" series. This collaboration with Det Gode Selskab underscores PPP's commitment to curating diverse musical experiences within its eco-conscious sanctuary, bringing together different collectives to shape unique nights for the community.

Tulum's Jungle-Meets-Ocean Sanctuary

Papaya Playa Project offers a distinctive venue experience, blending Tulum's natural beauty with a focus on sustainability. Situated along a long stretch of coastline, the event unfolds in a jungle-meets-ocean sanctuary where guests can dance barefoot on pristine Caribbean sand. The setting is designed to harmonize with nature, providing an intimate environment where the ocean breeze carries the music through the palms, enhancing the connection between sound, community, and the natural surroundings.

Entry & Experience Details

Doors for The New Moon open at 6:30 PM, with general admission starting at 7:00 PM, and last entry permitted at 12:50 AM. Attendees can choose between a general admission ticket for the musical journey or enhance their evening with a Mayan Dinner Experience or VIP table packages, which include bottle service or credit for food and drinks. Capacity for the event is limited to maintain the intimacy and energy of the dance floor, making early ticket acquisition advisable. Dress code for the evening is casual, with a dinner-casual option for those opting for the culinary experience.
en.description: Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer, and Andru bring house and melodic sounds to Ppp • the New Moon • Music by Ppp x Det Gode Selskab at Papaya Playa
en.name: The New Moon

es.body:
La noche que viene

Papaya Playa Project da la bienvenida a Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer y Andru para esta edición especial de Ppp x Det Gode Selskab. Te espera un viaje a través de paisajes sonoros que mezclan house y ritmos melódicos, perfectamente adecuados para la costa de Tulum. Portable, conocido por su sonido profundamente texturizado y emotivo, marca el tono, mientras que la energía contagiosa de Tod Louie mantiene la pista de baile en movimiento. Karl Fraunhofer y Andru completan el cartel, garantizando una noche de refinadas selecciones y cálidas líneas de bajo.

Ritual semanal de Tulum

Ppp x Det Gode Selskab se ha convertido en un elemento básico en la vibrante escena de la música electrónica de Tulum, ofreciendo una experiencia cuidadosamente comisariada que mezcla el talento internacional con el ambiente único de la costa caribeña. Esta colaboración entre Papaya Playa Project y Det Gode Selskab asegura una noche centrada en la exploración sónica y la conexión con la comunidad, solidificando su lugar como un evento imprescindible para locales y visitantes por igual. El ciclo da prioridad a la música de calidad y a una pista de baile íntima, fomentando un sentimiento de unidad entre los asistentes.

Ambiente frente al mar

Papaya Playa Project ofrece el escenario perfecto para esta edición de Ppp x Det Gode Selskab, transformando su santuario entre la selva y el océano en un paraíso para los amantes de la música. El diseño al aire libre del lugar permite que la música fluya a la perfección con la brisa marina, mientras que el suelo de arena anima a bailar descalzo bajo las estrellas. La acústica natural del espacio realza los ritmos profundos y las cálidas líneas de bajo, creando una experiencia sonora realmente envolvente.

Asegure su plaza

Esta noche especial frente al mar comienza a las 3 PM el 20 de diciembre, prometiendo horas de house cuidadosamente curado y sonidos melódicos. Los boletos cuestan a partir de $1,100 MXN, y la capacidad es limitada para preservar la intimidad y la energía de la pista de baile. Dada la popularidad tanto de Papaya Playa Project como de la serie Ppp x Det Gode Selskab, es muy recomendable asegurar tus boletos con anticipación.
es.description: Portable, Tod Louie, Karl Fraunhofer y Andru ponen banda sonora a Ppp x Det Gode Selskab con sonidos house y melódicos en la playa de Tulum.
es.name: The New Moon

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Although the specific lineup for this edition of Elysium remains under wraps, the return of Afshin Momadi, fresh from a successful summer season and a Beatport-charting single, sets the tone for a night steeped in melodic house and progressive grooves. Momadi's presence guarantees a journey through soundscapes designed for expansive dance floors, bringing a taste of Ibiza and European festival energy to the heart of Tulum. Expect a carefully curated selection of supporting talent to complement Momadi's signature style.

From Jungle Parties to Institution

Elysium's Tulum residency marks a significant chapter for the event series, solidifying its reputation as a purveyor of high-quality electronic music experiences. After making waves across Europe, the move to the Mexican jungle showcases Elysium's commitment to curating unique atmospheres in iconic locations. The series' focus on blending international talent with the natural beauty of Tulum has resonated with discerning music lovers, establishing Elysium as a must-attend event within the region's thriving scene.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum's beachfront setting provides the perfect backdrop for Elysium's utopian vision. The open-air venue, with its sand floor and unobstructed views of the Caribbean Sea, creates an intimate and immersive environment for dancers. The design of the space encourages a connection between the music, the natural surroundings, and the energy of the crowd, enhancing the overall experience.

Arrive Before Midnight

Elysium at Vagalume Tulum begins at 7:00 PM and continues until 1:00 AM, with peak hours expected after 9:00 PM. Early bird tickets start at $605 MXN, with prices increasing as the event approaches. Given the popularity of both Elysium and Vagalume, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended.
en.description: Elysium welcomes Afshin Momadi to the jungle! Experience his signature sound after massive plays at Tomorrowland, Zamna, and Ushuaia Ibiza.
en.name: Elysium

es.body:
La noche que se avecina

Aunque el line-up específico de esta edición de Elysium permanece en secreto, el regreso de Afshin Momadi, recién salido de una exitosa temporada de verano y con un single de éxito en Beatport, marca el tono de una noche impregnada de house melódico y grooves progresivos. La presencia de Momadi garantiza un viaje a través de paisajes sonoros diseñados para amplias pistas de baile, trayendo un sabor de Ibiza y la energía de los festivales europeos al corazón de Tulum. Se espera una cuidada selección de talentos para complementar el estilo característico de Momadi.

De las fiestas en la jungla a la institución

La residencia de Elysium en Tulum marca un capítulo importante para la serie de eventos, consolidando su reputación como proveedor de experiencias de música electrónica de alta calidad. Tras causar sensación en Europa, el traslado a la jungla mexicana demuestra el compromiso de Elysium con la creación de atmósferas únicas en lugares emblemáticos. El enfoque de la serie en la mezcla de talento internacional con la belleza natural de Tulum ha resonado entre los amantes de la música más exigentes, estableciendo a Elysium como un evento imprescindible dentro de la próspera escena de la región.

Baile en la arena

El entorno de Vagalume Tulum, en primera línea de playa, es el telón de fondo perfecto para la visión utópica de Elysium. El espacio al aire libre, con su suelo de arena y vistas despejadas al mar Caribe, crea un ambiente íntimo y envolvente para los bailarines. El diseño del espacio fomenta la conexión entre la música, el entorno natural y la energía del público, mejorando la experiencia global.

Llegar antes de medianoche

Elysium en Vagalume Tulum comienza a las 7:00 PM y continúa hasta la 1:00 AM, con horas pico esperadas después de las 9:00 PM. Los boletos anticipados comienzan en $605 MXN, con precios que aumentan a medida que se acerca el evento. Dada la popularidad tanto de Elysium como de Vagalume, es muy recomendable conseguir las entradas con antelación.
es.description: Elysium da la bienvenida a Afshin Momadi a la jungla Experimenta su sonido característico tras sus actuaciones masivas en Tomorrowland, Zamna y Ushuaia Ibiza.
es.name: Elysium

en.body:
Joris Voorn & Nic Fanciulli Headline Disorder

This edition of Disorder showcases a meeting of minds, as Joris Voorn and Nic Fanciulli bring their distinct takes on electronic music to Vagalume. Voorn's precision-driven melodic techno, honed on labels like Green and Cocoon, meets Fanciulli's groove-centric house and techno, a sound he has championed on Saved Records for years. This session promises a sophisticated exploration of the deeper shades of house and techno, supported by Sebastian Konrad, Miul, and Negrinm, each adding their own local flavor to the night.

Tulum's Weekly Ritual

Disorder has become a fixture in Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene, known for curating lineups that blend international headliners with local talent. The series has carved out a niche for itself by consistently delivering high-quality music experiences, creating a space for dedicated electronic music fans to connect and dance. Disorder's commitment to showcasing both established and emerging artists has solidified its position as a key player in Tulum's nightlife.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum provides the perfect backdrop for Disorder's immersive soundscapes. The beachfront palapa creates an intimate and energetic atmosphere, where the sounds of rolling basslines and polyrhythmic percussion resonate with the natural acoustics of the space. The sand floor adds a tactile connection to the earth, enhancing the overall sensory experience and fostering a sense of community among the dancers.

Tables & Tickets

Doors open at 1:00 PM, with peak hours expected later in the evening. The dress code is Tulum style, encouraging guests to embrace the bohemian spirit of the venue. Tickets start at $880 MXN, and with a lineup this strong, early purchase is highly recommended to secure your spot on the dancefloor.
en.description: Joris Voorn & Nic Fanciulli at Disorder! Melodic techno from Voorn meets Fanciulli's timeless groove. Sebastian Konrad, Miul & Negrinm support.

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Gypsy Disco at Gitano Jungle promises a night where Modern Mexican dining transitions into a vibrant dance floor experience. Shimmering disco lights reflecting off Gitano's signature disco ball elevate the energy as the night unfolds, creating a unique atmosphere for those seeking an elevated Tulum experience.

Tulum's Weekly Ritual

Gypsy Disco has cemented its place as a signature Friday night event within Tulum's celebrated nightlife. As Gitano Jungle's cornerstone party, it draws a diverse crowd seeking a blend of culinary indulgence and high-energy dance music. The series offers a unique blend of candlelit dinners, smoky mezcal cocktails, and a seamless transition into a world-class DJ set, establishing Gypsy Disco as a must-experience event.

Dining Under the Palms

Gitano Jungle sets the stage for Gypsy Disco with its open-air layout and lush jungle setting. The venue's architecture, complete with a palapa roof and natural wood elements, creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. A dance floor beneath the canopy comes alive as the night progresses, enhanced by shimmering disco lights and the infectious energy of the crowd.

Tables & Tickets

Dinner seatings are available between 6 PM and 11 PM, with tables reserved for the entire evening. Entry to Gypsy Disco begins at 6:00 PM. Tickets start at $1,100 MXN, and reserving for your full party size is recommended to ensure you are seated together. Advanced reservations are highly recommended given the popularity of this Friday night staple.
en.description: DJs ignite Gypsy Disco with shimmering disco lights and exclusive cabaret performances for a high-energy dance floor experience.
en.name: Gypsy Disco

es.body:
La noche que viene

Gypsy Disco en Gitano Jungle promete una noche donde la comida mexicana moderna se transforma en una vibrante experiencia en la pista de baile. Las brillantes luces de discoteca que se reflejan en la característica bola de discoteca de Gitano elevan la energía a medida que se desarrolla la noche, creando un ambiente único para aquellos que buscan una experiencia elevada en Tulum.

Ritual semanal de Tulum

Gypsy Disco ha consolidado su lugar como un evento de firma viernes por la noche dentro de la vida nocturna de Tulum célebre. Como fiesta principal de Gitano Jungle, atrae a una multitud diversa que busca una mezcla de indulgencia culinaria y música de baile de alta energía. La serie ofrece una mezcla única de cenas a la luz de las velas, cócteles de mezcal ahumado, y una transición sin problemas a un set de DJ de clase mundial, estableciendo Gypsy Disco como un evento de experiencia obligada.

Cenas bajo las palmeras

Gitano Jungle prepara el escenario para Gypsy Disco con su disposición al aire libre y su exuberante entorno selvático. La arquitectura del local, con techo de palapa y elementos de madera natural, crea un ambiente cálido y acogedor. Una pista de baile bajo el toldo cobra vida a medida que avanza la noche, realzada por brillantes luces de discoteca y la contagiosa energía del público.

Mesas y entradas

Las cenas están disponibles entre las 18.00 y las 23.00 horas, con mesas reservadas para toda la noche. La entrada a Gypsy Disco comienza a las 6:00 PM. Los boletos cuestan a partir de $1,100 MXN, y se recomienda reservar para su grupo completo para asegurar que se sientan juntos. Se recomienda reservar con antelación, dada la popularidad de este clásico de los viernes por la noche.
es.description: Los DJ encienden la Gypsy Disco con brillantes luces de discoteca y actuaciones de cabaret exclusivas para una experiencia de pista de baile llena de energía.
es.name: Gypsy Disco

en.body:
The Night Ahead

Afshin Momadi brings his signature Elysium showcase to Vagalume Tulum, promising a night immersed in the sounds that have propelled him onto the international stage. This session highlights the sound that earned him recognition as one of Germany's Top 10 Emerging Artists, blending elements of melodic house and techno within the open-air atmosphere of the jungle. While the full lineup remains under wraps, anticipation builds for a curated journey through sound.

From Jungle Parties to Utopia

Elysium, after a summer residency in Spain and Ibiza, lands in Tulum, continuing its evolution as a showcase for forward-thinking electronic music. The series aims to create a utopian atmosphere within the Vagalume setting, drawing on Momadi's experience playing at renowned festivals like Tomorrowland and Zamna. Elysium's Tulum residency represents a fusion of global sounds and Tulum's unique energy, offering a dedicated space for underground electronic music.

Sand Floor Dancing

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the heart of the hotel zone, provides a distinct setting for Elysium. The beach club’s open-air design fosters a connection between the music and the natural surroundings, while the sand floor encourages a free-flowing energy. The venue's beachfront location, combined with its focus on premium sound, creates an immersive experience for both the artists and the audience.

Tables & Tickets

Elysium at Vagalume begins at 7:00 PM and continues until 1:00 AM, offering a condensed but potent dose of electronic music under the Tulum sky. Early bird tickets start at $605 MXN, with prices increasing as the event date approaches. Dress code is Tulum style, and VIP tables with bottle service are available for those seeking an elevated experience, but act fast as tickets are selling quickly.
en.description: Elysium welcomes Afshin Momadi! Fresh from global stages, Afshin brings his signature sound to the jungle. Experience his chart-topping energy.
en.name: Elysium

Gitano Jungle's Enchanting Grand Palais

Tulum New Year's 2026 at Gitano Beach features a lineup designed to usher in the new year with a blend of electronic and live performances. The night's musical journey includes sets from FLIRTY 800, DJ USA, and THE VERSA, promising a dynamic atmosphere on the sand. Complementing the DJ sets, GITANO FLAMENCO will present a live show, adding a distinct cultural dimension to the celebration. This combination of DJs and live entertainment aims to create a celebratory and vibrant environment for dancing under the stars.

The Gitano Group's Vision

The annual New Year's Eve event at Gitano Beach is a key offering from the Gitano Group, an organization known for its venues in Tulum, New York City, Miami, and Dubai. Introduced in 2021 and recently relocated, Gitano Beach embodies the group's commitment to love, happiness, and community. The event draws inspiration from the bohemian coastal scenes of Goa and Ibiza, reflecting the group's broader ethos of creating refined yet spirited experiences. This celebration aligns with Gitano's established presence in offering curated events that blend culinary arts with lively entertainment.

Gitano Beach: A Coastal Sanctuary

Gitano Beach provides an elegant beachfront setting for the New Year's Eve festivities, situated on the exclusive southern side of Tulum's beach, near the Sian Ka'an biosphere reserve. The venue is characterized by its bohemian spirit and serves as a sanctuary of coastal beauty. With soft sands and a tropical ambiance, the space is designed to host lively disco evenings and special events. Its location beside the new Casa Gitano hotel further integrates it into the Gitano Group's network of hospitality experiences.

Guests attending Tulum New Year's 2026 can anticipate a grand celebration that includes a four-course dinner, champagne, and cocktails. The evening is structured around a curated dining experience followed by music and dancing on the beach. Tickets are priced per person, and guests are advised to reserve according to their party size to ensure seating together. For specific inquiries regarding the event, contact can be made via email at tulum@gitano.com.

en.body:
Cloonee

Hailing from the UK, Cloonee has rapidly established himself as a prominent figure within the global tech house scene since his breakthrough year in 2019. Known for his driving, percussive sound, he quickly garnered attention, culminating in his recognition as Beatport’s 8th best-selling tech house artist that year. His career trajectory has been marked by consistent releases on respected international imprints such as Solardo's Sola, Elrow Music, and Big Beat Records, solidifying his position as a producer with a distinct, dancefloor-focused signature.

Four-to-the-Floor Precision

Cloonee's musical style navigates the energetic intersections of tech house, house, and Latin house, characterized by robust four-to-the-floor kicks, infectious basslines, and cleverly sampled vocal hooks. His production techniques prioritize groove and impact, designed to ignite club environments. Notable tracks like "Stephanie," "Sippin' Yak," and "Mi Amor" exemplify his sound, while his 2019 Beatport Tech House #1 "Be Good To Me" showcased his early chart success. With a substantial following of 233,558 Spotify followers, his recent 2025 singles, "Vamos A La Playa," "Will We Ever Wake Up," and "Not Gonna Be Your Boo" (featuring Robin S), continue to explore his signature percussive drive.

Sunset Sessions at Bagatelle Tulum

This performance at Bagatelle Tulum's signature Sunset Sessions promises an afternoon of cutting-edge house beats set against the stunning Caribbean coastline. Cloonee's high-energy tech house sound is perfectly complemented by Bagatelle's sophisticated beach club atmosphere, which blends French Riviera elegance with Tulum's natural magic. The venue's energetic and stylish setting, known for its lively music and vibrant seaside ambiance, provides an ideal backdrop for Cloonee's percussive and groove-laden selections, ensuring a dynamic experience as the sun descends.

Securing Your Bagatelle Access

Doors for this anticipated opening of the 2026 season at Bagatelle Tulum open at 4:00 pm. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to a sophisticated atmosphere where Cloonee's sound will define the essence of Tulum's world-class music culture. Guests are encouraged to adhere to a "Fresh, chic, and effortlessly elegant" dress code, fitting for Tulum's iconic aesthetic. Advanced purchase is highly recommended to secure your spot at this exclusive event.

es.body:
Cloonee

Procedente del Reino Unido, Cloonee se ha establecido rápidamente como una figura prominente dentro de la escena tech house global desde su año de irrupción en 2019. Conocido por su sonido impulsor y percusivo, rápidamente atrajo la atención, culminando con su reconocimiento como el octavo artista tech house más vendido de Beatport ese año. La trayectoria de su carrera ha estado marcada por lanzamientos consistentes en sellos internacionales respetados como Solardo's Sola, Elrow Music y Big Beat Records, solidificando su posición como productor con una firma distintiva y centrada en la pista de baile.

Precisión a cuatro manos

El estilo musical de Cloonee navega por las enérgicas intersecciones del tech house, el house y el latin house, caracterizado por unos potentes golpes de pedal, unas líneas de bajo contagiosas y unos ganchos vocales inteligentemente muestreados. Sus técnicas de producción priorizan el groove y el impacto, diseñadas para encender los ambientes de club. Temas notables como "Stephanie", "Sippin' Yak" y "Mi Amor" ejemplifican su sonido, mientras que su número 1 de Beatport Tech House en 2019 "Be Good To Me" mostró su temprano éxito en las listas. Con un seguimiento sustancial de 233,558 seguidores de Spotify, sus recientes 2025 singles, "Vamos A La Playa", "Will We Ever Wake Up" y "Not Gonna Be Your Boo" (con Robin S), continúan explorando su impulso percusivo característico.

Sesiones al atardecer en Bagatelle Tulum

Esta actuación en las Sunset Sessions de Bagatelle Tulum promete una tarde de ritmos house de vanguardia frente a la impresionante costa caribeña. El ambiente enérgico y elegante del lugar, conocido por su música animada y su vibrante ambiente costero, proporciona un telón de fondo ideal para las selecciones percusivas y cargadas de groove de Cloonee, garantizando una experiencia dinámica mientras desciende el sol.

en.body:
CamelPhat

Liverpool's multi-platinum DJ and production duo, Dave Whelan and Mike Di Scala, known as CamelPhat, have solidified their position at the forefront of global electronic music since their breakthrough hit "Cola" in 2017. The Grammy and Ivor Novello-nominated pair are celebrated for their evolving sound that navigates melodic techno, house, and progressive house territories. Their consistent output and high-charting releases have established them as one of Beatport's biggest-selling artists, maintaining a significant presence on the international club and festival circuit.

Four-to-the-Floor Evolution

CamelPhat's musical style is characterized by driving four-to-the-floor rhythms, deep basslines, and intricate melodic structures that build tension and release on the dancefloor. Their discography showcases a refined production approach, moving from the tech house sensibilities of early tracks like "Cola" to the more expansive, emotive sound explored on albums such as 2023's "Spiritual Milk" and 2022's "Dark Matter." With popular tracks like "Breathe" and "Save Me" contributing to their 530,828 Spotify followers, the duo consistently delivers productions that resonate across various electronic music subgenres.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an energetic late-night set, with CamelPhat expected to deliver their signature blend of melodic techno and progressive house. The state-of-the-art sound system and production at Bonbonniere are ideally suited to amplify their intricate sound design and powerful basslines, creating an immersive experience for attendees. As Tulum's premier nightclub, Bonbonniere's lively dance floor and luxurious ambiance, complete with a retractable roof, will provide a sophisticated yet high-energy backdrop for the duo's extended set.

Entry & Dress Code

CamelPhat will take the decks on Saturday, January 3rd, with doors opening at 10 pm for a night extending till late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to Bonbonniere's exclusive nightlife experience. A formal dress code is strictly enforced to maintain the venue's sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire, including swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts, is not permitted.

es.body:
CamelPhat

El dúo multiplatino de DJ y productores de Liverpool, Dave Whelan y Mike Di Scala, conocidos como CamelPhat, han consolidado su posición a la vanguardia de la música electrónica mundial desde su éxito rompedor "Cola" en 2017. La pareja nominada al Grammy y al Ivor Novello es célebre por su sonido en evolución que navega por los territorios del techno melódico, el house y el progressive house. Su producción constante y sus lanzamientos de gran éxito los han consolidado como uno de los artistas con mayores ventas de Beatport, manteniendo una presencia significativa en el circuito internacional de clubes y festivales.

Evolución Four-to-the-Floor

El estilo musical de CamelPhat se caracteriza por sus ritmos four-to-the-floor, profundas líneas de bajo e intrincadas estructuras melódicas que crean tensión y liberación en la pista de baile. Su discografía muestra un enfoque de producción refinado, pasando de la sensibilidad tech house de los primeros temas como "Cola" al sonido más expansivo y emotivo explorado en álbumes como "Spiritual Milk" de 2023 y "Dark Matter" de 2022 Con temas populares como "Breathe" y "Save Me" que contribuyen a sus 530.828 seguidores en Spotify, el dúo ofrece constantemente producciones que resuenan en varios subgéneros de la música electrónica.

en.body:
Colyn: Melodic Techno's Global Reference

Colyn stands as a prominent figure in the global melodic techno landscape, recognized for crafting intricate soundscapes that blend driving rhythms with evocative melodies. Hailing from a scene that values emotional depth and progressive sound design, Colyn has established a reputation for sets that are both expansive and deeply engaging. As a "global reference" in the genre, Colyn's work is synonymous with the sophisticated, often cinematic, evolution of electronic music, appealing to a discerning audience that seeks both energy and narrative within the dancefloor experience.

Constructing Melodic Narratives

Colyn's musical style navigates the nuanced territories of melodic techno, characterized by its emphasis on rich harmonic progressions layered over robust four-to-the-floor foundations. Production techniques often involve shimmering arpeggios, atmospheric pads, and precisely engineered percussion, creating a sound that is both powerful and ethereal. While specific recent releases for this melodic techno artist are not detailed, the genre itself typically explores themes of introspection and euphoria, building tension and release through carefully orchestrated sonic elements.

An Intense Evening at Vagalume

This performance promises an intense, aesthetic, and vibrant experience at Vagalume, Tulum’s iconic beach club. Colyn's set is expected to guide attendees through a journey of evolving melodic techno, likely commencing with deeper, more atmospheric textures before building into driving, peak-time rhythms. Supporting acts VITE + MIGANOVA RDJ, LUNA & LENTHE, BILAL SANTIAGO B2B BELEBN, and LOEN will set the stage, complementing Colyn's sound with their own contributions to the electronic music spectrum. Vagalume's energetic beach club setting and premium atmosphere, known for its transformation from daytime serenity to nighttime vibrancy, will provide an ideal backdrop for Colyn's expansive sound.

Reservations & Entry

The event commences at 1:00 PM on January 3rd, extending through the night until 1:00 AM. General admission tickets are priced starting at $880 MXN. Given Vagalume's status as Tulum's most popular beach club and its reputation for lively events featuring international DJs, reservations are highly recommended to secure entry and ensure participation in this collaboration between Sinner and GLITCH404.

es.body:
Colyn: referencia mundial del techno melódico

Colyn es una figura prominente en el panorama mundial del techno melódico, reconocido por crear intrincados paisajes sonoros que combinan ritmos enérgicos con melodías evocadoras. Procedente de una escena que valora la profundidad emocional y el diseño de sonido progresivo, Colyn se ha labrado una reputación por sus sets, que son a la vez expansivos y profundamente atractivos. Como "referencia mundial" del género, el trabajo de Colyn es sinónimo de la evolución sofisticada, a menudo cinematográfica, de la música electrónica, y atrae a un público exigente que busca tanto energía como narrativa en la experiencia de la pista de baile.

Construcción de narrativas melódicas

El estilo musical de Colyn navega por los territorios matizados del techno melódico, caracterizado por su énfasis en ricas progresiones armónicas superpuestas sobre robustas bases de cuatro a la pista. Las técnicas de producción a menudo incluyen arpegios brillantes, pads atmosféricos y percusión de ingeniería precisa, creando un sonido que es a la vez poderoso y etéreo. Aunque no se detallan los últimos lanzamientos específicos de este artista de techno melódico, el género en sí suele explorar temas de introspección y euforia, construyendo tensión y liberación a través de elementos sónicos cuidadosamente orquestados.

Una noche intensa en Vagalume

en.body:
Dombresky's Disco Dom Persona

Under his Disco Dom alias, renowned DJ and producer Dombresky channels the vibrant energy of 1970s disco, crafting a distinctive sound that has captivated audiences at major festivals like Coachella and EDC. This enigmatic artist, who has recently embarked on his "Inferno" mini-tour across key US cities including New York and Los Angeles, has established a reputation for electrifying performances that evoke the glamour and hedonism of Studio 54. His career trajectory sees him navigating the intersection of classic disco aesthetics and contemporary house music production, positioning him as a distinctive figure within the global electronic music landscape.

Nu-Disco Grooves & Funky House

Disco Dom's musical style explores the vibrant intersection of disco house, nu disco, and funky house, characterized by its infectious four-to-the-floor grooves and meticulously crafted retro-inspired production. His recent work includes the single "Inferno (No. 3)", released in February 2025, which further cemented his signature sound with its driving basslines and soulful vocal samples. With popular tracks like "Be The One" featuring Yung Bae and "Butter" accumulating significant plays, Disco Dom maintains a dedicated following of 11,830 Spotify followers, reflecting his broad appeal within the genre. His forthcoming single, "The Apex" (PRX006), scheduled for September 2025, continues to build on his reputation for crafting dancefloor-ready anthems that bridge eras.

Sunset Sessions by the Caribbean Sea

This performance at Bagatelle Tulum's Sunset Sessions on January 7, 2026, promises an afternoon where Disco Dom's '70s-inspired house music will perfectly complement the venue's French Riviera elegance. Bagatelle's beach club setting, known for its energetic yet sophisticated atmosphere and stunning views of the Caribbean Sea, provides an ideal backdrop for his upbeat rhythms. Guests can anticipate a progression of funky house and nu-disco grooves, designed to build a vibrant energy as the afternoon transitions into evening, aligning with Bagatelle's reputation for lively music and exclusive events. The open-air environment will allow Disco Dom's sound to resonate across the stylish crowd, enhancing the chic Tulum atmosphere with a blend of glamour and tropical vibes.

Tickets & Afternoon Entry

Doors for Disco Dom's performance at Bagatelle Tulum open at 3:00 pm, initiating an afternoon of house music and sophisticated revelry by the Caribbean Sea. General admission tickets are priced at $550 MXN, offering access to Bagatelle's exclusive beach club atmosphere. Given Bagatelle's reputation as a premier destination in Tulum's hotel zone and its popularity during peak season, securing reservations in advance is highly recommended to ensure entry and avoid disappointment. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a fresh, elegant dress code, aligning with Bagatelle's chic ambiance for this anticipated event.

es.body:
La personalidad Disco Dom de Dombresky

Bajo su alias Disco Dom, el famoso DJ y productor Dombresky canaliza la vibrante energía de la música disco de los años 70, creando un sonido distintivo que ha cautivado al público de grandes festivales como Coachella y EDC. Este enigmático artista, que recientemente se ha embarcado en su minigira "Inferno" por ciudades clave de Estados Unidos como Nueva York y Los Ángeles, se ha labrado una reputación por sus electrizantes actuaciones que evocan el glamour y el hedonismo de Studio 54. La trayectoria de su carrera le ha llevado a navegar por la intersección de la estética clásica de la música disco y la producción contemporánea de música house, posicionándole como una figura distintiva dentro del panorama mundial de la música electrónica.

Nu-Disco Grooves y Funky House

El estilo musical de Disco Dom explora la vibrante intersección entre el disco house, el nu disco y el funky house, caracterizado por sus contagiosos grooves "four-to-the-floor" y su meticulosa producción de inspiración retro. Su trabajo más reciente incluye el single "Inferno (No. 3)", publicado en febrero de 2025, que cimentó aún más su sonido característico con sus líneas de bajo y samples vocales conmovedores. Con temas populares como "Be The One", con Yung Bae, y "Butter", que acumulan un gran número de reproducciones, Disco Dom cuenta con 11.830 seguidores en Spotify, lo que refleja su gran atractivo dentro del género. Su próximo single, "The Apex" (PRX006), previsto para septiembre de 2025, sigue consolidando su reputación de creador de himnos listos para la pista de baile que tienden puentes entre épocas.

Sesiones al atardecer junto al mar Caribe

Esta actuación en las Sunset Sessions de Bagatelle Tulum, el 7 de enero de 2026, promete una tarde en la que la música house inspirada en los años 70 de Disco Dom complementará a la perfección la elegancia de la Riviera Francesa. El ambiente al aire libre permitirá que el sonido de Disco Dom resuene entre la elegante multitud, realzando el ambiente chic de Tulum con una mezcla de glamour y vibraciones tropicales.

Las puertas para la actuación de Disco Dom en Bagatelle Tulum se abren a las 3:00 pm, iniciando una tarde de música house y sofisticada juerga junto al mar Caribe. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $550 MXN, ofreciendo acceso al exclusivo ambiente de club de playa de Bagatelle. Dada la reputación de Bagatelle como un destino de primera clase en la zona hotelera de Tulum y su popularidad durante la temporada alta, es muy recomendable reservar con antelación para asegurar la entrada y evitar decepciones. en.body:
DJ Tennis: Life and Death Visionary

Manfredi Romano, universally known as DJ Tennis, is an Italian DJ, producer, and the visionary behind the influential Life and Death imprint. Originating from a background in punk rock and a career as a professional chef, Romano transitioned to electronic music, quickly establishing himself as a pivotal figure in the global melodic house and psychedelic techno scene. His label, Life and Death, has been instrumental in cultivating a distinct sound, fostering artists who blend intricate melodies with deep, often hypnotic rhythms. DJ Tennis is renowned for his extended, narrative-driven sets, which have graced major international stages from Circoloco in Ibiza to The BPM Festival, solidifying his reputation as a selector with a profound understanding of sonic storytelling.

Eclectic Melodic Journeys

DJ Tennis's musical style navigates a sophisticated and expansive spectrum, characterized by deep, emotive melodies, intricate percussive layers, and a subtle psychedelic edge. He skillfully traverses subgenres ranging from progressive house and cosmic disco to more driving melodic techno, frequently incorporating analog textures, unexpected vocal samples, and live instrumentation into his productions and DJ sets. While specific 2025 releases for DJ Tennis are not detailed, his extensive discography on Life and Death, including seminal tracks like "Divisions (feat. Fink)" and "Chirality," consistently showcases his ability to craft tracks that are both introspective and profoundly effective on the dancefloor. His performances are celebrated for their gradual, immersive build, evolving from atmospheric, sun-drenched openers to more intense, yet always melodically rich, peaks.

Vagalume Sessions: A Tulum Soundscape

This Vagalume Sessions event promises an immersive sonic experience, with DJ Tennis at the helm, expected to deliver an extended journey that will transition seamlessly from the afternoon's deep, organic grooves into more driving melodic techno as the Tulum night unfolds. He will be joined by Eagles & Butterflies and Facundo Mohrr, two artists whose contributions to contemporary melodic electronic music perfectly complement Tennis's sound, ensuring a cohesive and evolving sonic narrative throughout the event. Vagalume Tulum's unique beachfront setting, known for its transition from daytime serenity to nighttime vibrancy, along with its exceptional acoustics and stunning Caribbean views, provides an ideal backdrop for DJ Tennis's ability to craft deeply immersive soundscapes. The lineup is further enriched by local talents Renê, Kevin Ganora, JDMaya, and Monqalamari, bringing an authentic and refined Tulum perspective to the night.

Tickets & Event Logistics

The Vagalume Sessions event is scheduled from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering a full twelve-hour electronic music experience. Early Bird Tickets are available starting at $880 MXN, with prices increasing for subsequent releases. Given Vagalume Tulum's status as a premier beach club and the high caliber of the international lineup, advanced ticket purchase is strongly recommended to secure entry. The event embraces a "Tulum Style" dress code, encouraging attendees to immerse themselves in the local aesthetic. For those seeking an elevated experience, VIP tables with bottle service are available; inquiries can be made via WhatsApp to +52 984 130 1037.

es.body:
DJ Tennis: visionario de Life and Death

Manfredi Romano, universalmente conocido como DJ Tennis, es un DJ, productor y visionario italiano que está detrás del influyente sello Life and Death. De formación punk rock y cocinero profesional, Romano se pasó a la música electrónica y pronto se convirtió en una figura clave en la escena mundial del house melódico y el techno psicodélico. Su sello, Life and Death, ha contribuido decisivamente a cultivar un sonido distinto, fomentando artistas que combinan melodías intrincadas con ritmos profundos, a menudo hipnóticos. DJ Tennis es famoso por sus sets extensos y narrativos, que han adornado los principales escenarios internacionales, desde el Circoloco de Ibiza hasta el BPM Festival, consolidando su reputación como selector con un profundo conocimiento de la narración sónica.

Viajes melódicos eclécticos

El estilo musical de DJ Tennis navega por un espectro sofisticado y expansivo, caracterizado por melodías profundas y emotivas, intrincadas capas de percusión y un sutil toque psicodélico. Recorre con destreza subgéneros que van desde el house progresivo y el disco cósmico hasta el techno melódico más cañero, incorporando con frecuencia texturas analógicas, samples vocales inesperados e instrumentación en directo a sus producciones y sesiones de DJ. Aunque no se detallan los lanzamientos específicos de DJ Tennis en 2025, su extensa discografía en Life and Death, que incluye temas seminales como "Divisions (feat. Fink)" y "Chirality", muestra constantemente su capacidad para crear temas que son a la vez introspectivos y profundamente eficaces en la pista de baile. Sus actuaciones son célebres por su construcción gradual y envolvente, que evoluciona desde aperturas atmosféricas bañadas por el sol hasta picos más intensos, aunque siempre ricos en melodías.

Sesiones Vagalume: Un paisaje sonoro de Tulum

Este evento Vagalume Sessions promete una experiencia sonora envolvente, con DJ Tennis al timón, que se espera que ofrezca un viaje prolongado que pasará sin problemas de los grooves profundos y orgánicos de la tarde a un techno melódico más impulsivo a medida que se desarrolle la noche de Tulum. Le acompañarán Eagles & Butterflies y Facundo Mohrr, dos artistas cuyas contribuciones a la música electrónica melódica contemporánea complementan a la perfección el sonido de Tennis, garantizando una narrativa sónica cohesiva y en evolución durante todo el evento. El entorno único de la playa de Vagalume Tulum, conocido por su transición de la serenidad diurna a la vitalidad nocturna, junto con su excepcional acústica y sus impresionantes vistas del Caribe, ofrece un telón de fondo ideal para la capacidad de DJ Tennis de crear paisajes sonoros profundamente envolventes. El cartel se enriquece con los talentos locales Renê, Kevin Ganora, JDMaya y Monqalamari, que aportan una perspectiva auténtica y refinada de Tulum a la noche.

Los boletos Early Bird están disponibles a partir de $ 880 MXN, con precios que aumentan para los lanzamientos posteriores. The Signature Friday Night

Gypsy Disco transforms Gitano Jungle into a vibrant Friday night destination. This edition features performances by DJs, delivering disco music under the jungle canopy. The atmosphere builds from a candlelit dinner to a lively dance floor, illuminated by shimmering disco lights from the signature disco ball.

A Decade of Gitano's Disco

For over ten years, Gitano Jungle has been a cornerstone of Tulum's vibrant scene, and Gypsy Disco stands as its signature weekly event. This recurring Friday night experience has cultivated a reputation for its disco music focus and its welcoming, LGBTQIA+ friendly atmosphere. It represents a consistent offering from the Gitano Group, which has expanded its bohemian concept from Tulum to international cities.

Under the Tulum Palms

Gitano Jungle, nestled in Tulum's Hotel Zone, provides a distinctive setting for Gypsy Disco. The evening begins with Modern Mexican dinner service beneath the palms, transitioning seamlessly into an energetic club environment within the dedicated Jungle Room. This space, known for its bohemian design, comes alive with disco music and dancing, offering an immersive experience that blends natural surroundings with a lively party atmosphere.

es.body:
La noche de los viernes

Gypsy Disco transforma Gitano Jungle en un vibrante destino para los viernes por la noche. Esta edición cuenta con actuaciones de DJ, que ofrecen música disco bajo el dosel de la selva. El viaje musical se complementa con actuaciones de cabaret exclusivas de GITANO, que añaden una dimensión teatral a la velada. El ambiente va creciendo desde una cena a la luz de las velas hasta una animada pista de baile, iluminada por las brillantes luces de la emblemática bola de discoteca.

Una década de discoteca Gitano

Durante más de diez años, Gitano Jungle ha sido una piedra angular de la vibrante escena de Tulum, y Gypsy Disco se erige como su firma evento semanal. Esta experiencia recurrente los viernes por la noche ha cultivado una reputación por su enfoque en la música disco y su ambiente acogedor, LGBTQIA +. Representa una oferta consistente del Grupo Gitano, que ha expandido su concepto bohemio de Tulum a ciudades internacionales.

Bajo las palmeras de Tulum

Gitano Jungle, situado en la zona hotelera de Tulum, ofrece un marco incomparable para Gypsy Disco. La velada comienza con un servicio de cena mexicana moderna bajo las palmeras, para pasar a continuación a un enérgico ambiente de club en la sala Jungle. Este espacio, conocido por su diseño bohemio, cobra vida con música disco y baile, ofreciendo una experiencia envolvente que combina el entorno natural con un animado ambiente de fiesta.

Detalles de la cena y el baile

Los invitados pueden comenzar su velada cenando entre las 18.00 y las 23.00 horas, con mesas reservadas para toda la noche. Se ofrece servicio de botella para quienes deseen disfrutar de una experiencia mejorada a medida que avanza la fiesta. Los boletos para este evento tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN, y es recomendable reservar para el tamaño completo de la fiesta para asegurar asientos juntos. La propina no está incluida en el precio del boleto.
es.description: Gypsy Disco en GITANO JUNGLE ofrece actuaciones de cabaret y DJs con ritmos discotequeros para una vibrante noche de viernes.
es.name: Gypsy Disco

en.body:
ANCESTRAL SOUL with SON OF SON, SEBASTIAN KONRAD, LEONARDO & CUEVAS

This edition of Tulum's party series, titled 'ANCESTRAL SOUL,' features a curated lineup including SON OF SON, SEBASTIAN KONRAD, LEONARDO, and CUEVAS. These artists are poised to deliver a night of deep electronic music, aligning with Bonbonniere's reputation for showcasing progressive house, techno, and deep house. The collective's selections are expected to weave a narrative that embodies the event's thematic focus, creating an atmosphere of rhythmic depth and soulful exploration on the dance floor.

Bonbonniere Tulum: Luxury Meets Late-Night Dance

Bonbonniere stands as Tulum's definitive late-night destination, strategically located in the Hotel Zone and serving as a central afterparty hub. The venue masterfully blends luxurious VIP table service with an expansive, energetic dance floor, catering to both discerning guests and dedicated electronic music enthusiasts. Its state-of-the-art sound system and production, complemented by a retractable roof that reveals the night sky, are designed to elevate the sonic and visual experience for every event, making it a standout in Tulum's vibrant nightlife landscape.

Entry and Formal Dress Code

The 'ANCESTRAL SOUL' event at Bonbonniere is scheduled for Sunday, January 11th, 2026, with doors opening at 10 pm and continuing late into the morning. Guests are reminded of the strictly enforced formal dress code, which prohibits casual beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts. Adherence to this policy is essential for entry, ensuring the sophisticated ambiance that Bonbonniere is known for, and contributing to the overall premium experience.
en.description: Tulum's ANCESTRAL SOUL session features SON OF SON, SEBASTIAN KONRAD, LEONARDO, and CUEVAS delivering their signature sound at Bonbonniere Tulum.

en.body:
Paco Osuna: Barcelona's Techno Architect

Hailing from Barcelona, Spain, Paco Osuna has been a formidable presence in electronic music since he began DJing in 1994, establishing himself as one of Spain's most respected selectors. His career is defined by a relentless pursuit of driving tech house and minimal techno, a sound he has honed through extensive global touring and a long-standing residency at Ibiza's iconic Amnesia club. Osuna's discography reflects his commitment to the underground, with releases on influential labels such as Plus 8, Shake Records, and Noise Music, solidifying his position as a purveyor of precise, rhythmic club music.

Minimal Techno & Tech House Dynamics

Osuna's musical style navigates the intricate landscapes of minimal techno and tech house, characterized by tightly wound grooves, hypnotic loops, and a focus on percussive precision. His production work, including albums like "Long Play" (2014), "Lemon Juice" (2009), and "Orbeat" (2008), showcases his ability to construct intricate sonic narratives. Beyond his original productions, Osuna is known for impactful remixes such as "Wavy Distance - Paco Osuna Remix" and "Un Poquito - Paco Osuna Remix," which frequently feature in DJ sets worldwide. With over 103,003 Spotify followers, his influence extends across a dedicated global audience.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an extended journey through Paco Osuna's signature sound, commencing at 10 PM and continuing "till late." Attendees can anticipate a meticulously crafted set, evolving from deep, rolling tech house into more driving minimal techno as the night progresses. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and retractable roof, which offers views of the starlit sky, provide an ideal backdrop for Osuna's intricate productions, enhancing the immersive quality of his rhythmic explorations. As Tulum's premier late-night destination, Bonbonniere's energetic dance floor and luxurious ambiance are perfectly suited for an artist of Osuna's caliber.

Entry & Dress Code at Bonbonniere

Entry for Paco Osuna's performance on Monday, January 12th, 2026, begins at 10 PM. Tickets are priced starting at $1,100 MXN. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to ensure a sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire including swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted. Given Osuna's reputation and Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot in Tulum's hotel zone, advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended.
en.description: Paco Osuna, Barcelona-born DJ and Amnesia Ibiza resident, delivers his signature tech house and minimal techno, a Spanish electronic music pioneer.
en.name: Paco Osuna

es.body:
Paco Osuna: el arquitecto del techno de Barcelona

Originario de Barcelona, Paco Osuna ha sido una presencia formidable en la música electrónica desde que comenzó a pinchar en 1994, estableciéndose como uno de los selectores más respetados de España. Su carrera se define por una búsqueda incesante del tech house y el minimal techno, un sonido que ha perfeccionado a través de extensas giras por todo el mundo y una larga residencia en el emblemático club Amnesia de Ibiza. La discografía de Osuna refleja su compromiso con el underground, con lanzamientos en sellos influyentes como Plus 8, Shake Records y Noise Music, consolidando su posición como proveedor de música de club precisa y rítmica.

Dinámica Minimal Techno y Tech House

El estilo musical de Osuna navega por los intrincados paisajes del minimal techno y el tech house, caracterizados por grooves muy apretados, loops hipnóticos y un enfoque en la precisión percusiva. Su trabajo de producción, que incluye álbumes como "Long Play" (2014), "Lemon Juice" (2009) y "Orbeat" (2008), muestra su capacidad para construir intrincadas narrativas sónicas. Más allá de sus producciones originales, Osuna es conocido por remezclas impactantes como "Wavy Distance - Paco Osuna Remix" y "Un Poquito - Paco Osuna Remix", que aparecen con frecuencia en los DJ sets de todo el mundo. Con más de 103.003 seguidores en Spotify, su influencia se extiende a un público mundial muy entregado.

Late Night en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete un extenso viaje a través del sonido característico de Paco Osuna, comenzando a las 10 PM y continuando "hasta tarde" Los asistentes pueden anticipar un conjunto meticulosamente elaborado, evolucionando desde el tech house profundo y ondulante hasta el minimal techno más impulsivo a medida que avanza la noche. El sistema de sonido de última generación de Bonbonniere y su techo retráctil, que ofrece vistas del cielo estrellado, proporcionan un telón de fondo ideal para las intrincadas producciones de Osuna, realzando la calidad envolvente de sus exploraciones rítmicas. Como principal destino nocturno de Tulum, la enérgica pista de baile y el lujoso ambiente de Bonbonniere se adaptan perfectamente a un artista del calibre de Osuna.

Entrada y código de vestimenta en Bonbonniere

La entrada para la actuación de Paco Osuna el lunes 12 de enero de 2026 comienza a las 22:00 horas. Los boletos tienen un precio a partir de $1,100 MXN. Bonbonniere mantiene un estricto código de vestimenta elegante-formal para asegurar una atmósfera sofisticada; no se permite vestimenta playera incluyendo trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y shorts deportivos. Dada la reputación de Osuna y el estatus de Bonbonniere como lugar central de afterparty en la zona hotelera de Tulum, se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de entradas.

en.body:
Ànims Showcase with Lorena, Tim Engelhardt, Yamagucci & Pole Position

The Ànims series returns to Tulum on January 13th, 2026, presenting a curated lineup featuring Lorena, Tim Engelhardt, Yamagucci, and Pole Position. This edition brings together a diverse mix of electronic sounds that define the Ànims label's output. Tim Engelhardt, known for his melodic techno and progressive house sensibilities, joins the roster alongside Lorena, Yamagucci, and Pole Position, each contributing their distinct energy to shape the night's musical progression. The collective aims to deliver a cohesive journey from start to finish, reflecting the label's aesthetic.

The Ànims Label & Its Tulum Connection

Ànims, operating as both a label and an event series, makes its anticipated return to Tulum for this special showcase. The series has established a presence in the region, drawn by what it describes as "one of the most magical places in the world." This event at Vagalume underscores Ànims' commitment to fostering connection through music, presenting artists who align with its evolving sound profile. The label's showcases are designed to share its musical vision within a vibrant setting.

Vagalume Tulum's Beachfront Atmosphere

Vagalume Tulum, a premium beach club in the Hotel Zone, provides the setting for the Ànims showcase. Known for its energetic parties and high-end atmosphere, Vagalume transitions from daytime serenity to nighttime vibrancy. The venue's beachfront location offers stunning views of the Caribbean Sea, creating a distinctive backdrop for electronic music events. Its reputation as a hotspot for international and local DJs ensures an environment conducive to the Ànims experience, blending sophisticated dining with lively musical programming.

Planning Your Ànims Night

The Ànims event at Vagalume Tulum runs from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM on January 13th, 2026. Tickets are available across several tiers, starting with Early Bird at $605 MXN, followed by First Release at $880 MXN, Second Release at $1,210 MXN, and Final Release at $1,540 MXN. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a "Tulum Style" dress code. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking a premium experience, with contact information provided for reservations.

The Rhythms of Lawler and Zotti

This edition of Pendulum features legendary DJ Steve Lawler, who brings his signature underground sound to Vagalume. Known for blurring genre lines, Lawler's sets are characterized by deep, tribal grooves and energetic rhythms that promise a hypnotic journey on the dance floor. Joining him is Jesse Zotti, rounding out a lineup poised to deliver the immersive vibe Pendulum is known for.

Pendulum's Return to Tulum

Pendulum returns to Tulum for a select series of shows, building on its highly acclaimed residency from 2025. This event series, presented by Vagalume, has established itself as a platform for curated electronic music experiences within Tulum's vibrant scene. Each session under the Pendulum banner focuses on creating an atmosphere where the music, dramatic lighting, and natural surroundings converge for a distinct collective experience.

Vagalume's Jungle-Beach Setting

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the Hotel Zone, offers a unique backdrop for Pendulum. As a premium beach club, it transitions from daytime serenity to a lively nighttime hub, drawing a diverse crowd of international visitors and locals. The venue's open-air setting, with its stunning beachfront views and integration with the jungle, enhances the musical journey, allowing the pounding rhythms to sync with the sway of the palms.

Entry and Event Details

The event runs from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering an extended evening of music. Tickets for this Pendulum session start at $605 MXN for Early Bird, progressing through First, Second, and Final Release tiers up to $1,540 MXN. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a "Tulum Style" dress code. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking a more exclusive experience.

en.body:
The Signature Friday Night Experience

Gypsy Disco, Gitano Jungle's signature Friday night experience, features a dynamic lineup of DJs alongside exclusive GITANO cabaret performances. This weekly event transforms the restaurant and club into a vibrant dance floor, with disco music driving the energy under the canopy. The combination of live entertainment and curated DJ sets ensures a captivating atmosphere as the night progresses from dinner to a full-fledged party.

A Decade in Tulum's Heart

Gitano Jungle has been a cornerstone of Tulum's vibrant scene for over ten years, establishing itself as a destination known for its disco and LGBTQIA+ welcoming atmosphere. Gypsy Disco stands as the venue's defining weekly event, embodying the spirit of communal celebration and energetic dance. This consistent Friday night offering has cultivated a loyal following, blending local flavors with an international party sensibility.

Jungle Glamour and Disco Lights

Set within Gitano Jungle, the event unfolds amidst a candlelit Modern Mexican dinner beneath the palms, transitioning seamlessly into a lively club environment. The Jungle Room, dedicated to music and dance, comes alive with shimmering disco lights emanating from its signature disco ball. This unique setting provides an intimate yet expansive space where dining glamour meets an energetic dance floor under the open canopy.

Plan Your Evening

Guests can begin their Gypsy Disco experience with dinner seating available between 6 PM and 11 PM, with tables reserved for the entire night. Bottle service is offered for those seeking an enhanced party experience as the night reaches its peak. Tickets for this event start at $1,100 MXN, and it is recommended to reserve for your full party size to ensure seating together. Gratuity is not included.
en.description: Gypsy Disco's Friday night at GITANO JUNGLE features DJs and cabaret performances with disco music.
en.name: Gypsy Disco

es.body:
La experiencia exclusiva de los viernes por la noche

Gypsy Disco, la experiencia exclusiva de los viernes por la noche de Gitano Jungle, cuenta con un dinámico elenco de DJs y actuaciones de cabaret exclusivas de GITANO. Este evento semanal transforma el restaurante y el club en una vibrante pista de baile, con música disco que impulsa la energía bajo el toldo. La combinación de espectáculos en directo y sesiones de DJ garantiza un ambiente cautivador a medida que la noche pasa de ser una cena a una fiesta en toda regla.

Una década en el corazón de Tulum

Gitano Jungle ha sido una piedra angular de la vibrante escena de Tulum durante más de diez años, estableciéndose como un destino conocido por su discoteca y ambiente acogedor LGBTQIA+. Gypsy Disco se erige como el evento semanal que define el lugar, encarnando el espíritu de celebración comunitaria y baile enérgico. Esta oferta constante de los viernes por la noche ha cultivado un público fiel, mezclando sabores locales con una sensibilidad de fiesta internacional.

Glamour selvático y luces de discoteca

Situado en Gitano Jungle, el evento se desarrolla en medio de una cena mexicana moderna a la luz de las velas bajo las palmeras, pasando sin problemas a un animado ambiente de club. La sala Jungle, dedicada a la música y el baile, cobra vida con las brillantes luces de discoteca que emanan de su característica bola de discoteca. Este entorno único ofrece un espacio íntimo pero amplio donde el glamour de la cena se combina con una enérgica pista de baile bajo el toldo abierto.

Planifique su velada

Los clientes pueden comenzar su experiencia en Gypsy Disco cenando entre las 18.00 y las 23.00 horas, con mesas reservadas para toda la noche. Se ofrece servicio de botella para aquellos que busquen una experiencia de fiesta mejorada a medida que la noche alcanza su punto álgido. Los boletos para este evento cuestan a partir de $1,100 MXN, y se recomienda reservar para su grupo completo para asegurar asientos juntos. La propina no está incluida.

en.body:
Mathew Jonson, Thomas Melchior & Resolute's Curated Lineup

Mathew Jonson and Thomas Melchior headline this edition of The New Moon, joined by Mayell, Tau Car, and Xwnia. This lineup, presented in collaboration with Resolute, promises an intimate night of deep, hypnotic, and timeless electronic music. Attendees can expect warm analog textures, intricate rhythms, and deeply emotional soundscapes, designed for barefoot dancing and introspection on the Caribbean shore.

Papaya Playa Project: A Beachfront Sanctuary

Papaya Playa Project serves as the setting for this gathering, a sustainable sanctuary blending Tulum's natural beauty with eco-conscious hospitality. Located along the coastline, the venue transforms under the New Moon into a space for immersion and connection. Dancing on the sand with the ocean breeze, the atmosphere is crafted for an intimate experience, with capacity limited to preserve this unique ambiance.

Planning Your New Moon Experience

The New Moon - Resolute takes place on January 17, 2026, at Papaya Playa Project in Tulum. Tickets are available starting at $2,365 MXN. Guests can enhance their experience with a Mayan Dinner or by booking one of the available room packages for a complete Tulum escape. Given the limited capacity, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended.

Mathew Jonson, Thomas Melchior y el cartel de Resolute

Mathew Jonson y Thomas Melchior encabezan esta edición de The New Moon, acompañados por Mayell, Tau Car y Xwnia. Este cartel, presentado en colaboración con Resolute, promete una noche íntima de música electrónica profunda, hipnótica y atemporal. Los asistentes pueden esperar texturas analógicas cálidas, ritmos intrincados y paisajes sonoros profundamente emocionales, diseñados para bailar descalzo y la introspección en la orilla del Caribe.

Proyecto Papaya Playa: Un santuario frente al mar

El Proyecto Papaya Playa es el escenario de este encuentro, un santuario sostenible que combina la belleza natural de Tulum con la hospitalidad ecológica. Situado a lo largo de la costa, el lugar se transforma bajo la Luna Nueva en un espacio para la inmersión y la conexión. Bailando sobre la arena con la brisa del océano, el ambiente está diseñado para una experiencia íntima, con capacidad limitada para preservar este ambiente único.

La Luna Nueva - Resolute tendrá lugar el 17 de enero de 2026, en el Proyecto Papaya Playa en Tulum. Los boletos están disponibles a partir de $2,365 MXN. Los huéspedes pueden mejorar su experiencia con una Cena Maya o reservando uno de los paquetes de habitaciones disponibles para una escapada completa a Tulum. Dado el aforo limitado, se recomienda encarecidamente reservar las entradas con antelación.

en.body:
Tabu, Raidho & Renatta Debut at Vagalume

This edition of This. Place, presented by Vagalume, brings a lineup featuring two prominent Polish electronic projects alongside local talent. Tabu, a duo that gained recognition in 2024 with their remix of Bad Bunny’s “Dakiti,” has seen their work featured in playlists by artists such as Keinemusik, BLOND:ISH, and Tiesto. Their recent collaboration with Maesic, “RIPSAW,” has been signed to Kitsuné Musique. Joining them is Raidho, a veteran of the Polish club scene with over two decades of experience, known for his affiliation with the New York-based Sol Selectas label and for sharing stages with notable electronic music figures globally. Completing the bill is Renatta, who contributes the distinct energy of the local Tulum scene, ensuring a blend of international and regional electronic music.

Vagalume's Beachfront Setting

Gypsy Disco, Gitano Jungle's signature Friday night experience, offers a curated evening that transitions from a candlelit dinner to an energetic dance floor.
