Gitano Jungle's Weekly Tradition

As a highlight of Gitano Jungle's offerings, Gypsy Disco has established itself as a consistent Friday night fixture within the venue's decade-long presence in Tulum. The series embodies the bohemian spirit and disco-infused atmosphere that Gitano Jungle is known for, drawing both locals and visitors. It represents a weekly celebration of music, dance, and the distinct cultural vibe that defines Gitano's contribution to Tulum's vibrant scene.

Gitano Jungle, nestled in the heart of Tulum, provides a unique setting for Gypsy Disco. The venue transforms from a Modern Mexican restaurant, where guests dine beneath the palms, into a lively club environment. The Jungle Room, known for its energetic dance floor, comes alive under the natural canopy, creating an intimate space where the atmosphere is enhanced by the surrounding jungle. This setting, combined with artisanal cocktails and local flavors, defines the Gitano experience.

Renaissance makes its anticipated return to the Mayan Riviera in 2026, presented by Vagalume. A Legacy Returns to Tulum

Renaissance, a name deeply embedded in the history of electronic music, brings its renowned event series back to its beautiful home on the Mayan Riviera. Originating in the UK in the early 1990s, Renaissance quickly became a global institution, celebrated for its pioneering compilations and transformative club nights that helped define the progressive house and techno sound. Its presence in Tulum continues a tradition of delivering high-caliber electronic music experiences in visually striking and culturally rich settings.

This setting, with its beachfront views and sophisticated design, perfectly complements the electronic music styles presented by Renaissance.

This. Place Showcases European Talent in Tulum

The latest edition of This. Place brings a curated selection of European electronic music talent to Vagalume Tulum, featuring EWEERSEEN from UNRELEASED RECORDS, SINCZ representing ATLANT RENAISSANCE, and VACOS. This lineup highlights top DJs and producers from Poland and their counterparts from across Europe, promising a session rooted in the melodic and progressive sounds often associated with the region's electronic music scene. Attendees can anticipate a journey through various facets of house and melodic techno, consistent with Vagalume's established musical identity.

From Polish Roots to Global Stages

This. Place, a project originating from Poland, has been a notable presence in the electronic music landscape since its inception in 2019. Known for staging events in distinctive and often unconventional venues, such as historic theaters, museums, and rooftop locations, the series quickly garnered a dedicated following. Its reputation for selling out 90% of its events underscores its appeal and the quality of its curated experiences, establishing it as a significant collective in the international scene.

Vagalume Tulum provides the backdrop for this residency, a premium beach club situated in Tulum's vibrant hotel zone. Its beachfront location offers stunning views of the Caribbean Sea, creating an immersive environment where the sounds of Deep House, Progressive House, and Melodic Techno resonate with the natural beauty of the coast. The venue's design and ambiance are well-suited to hosting events that blend sophisticated electronic music with a vibrant social experience.

en.body:
Mita Gami's Melodic Trajectory

Mita Gami has established himself as a prominent figure within the melodic house and indie dance scenes, known for constructing sets that traverse driving rhythms and evocative synthesizer melodies. His career trajectory has seen him cultivate a distinctive sound, often exploring the intersection of house and techno with intricate layering and atmospheric depth. Collaborations with influential artists like Adam Ten have yielded tracks that have resonated across global dancefloors, solidifying his reputation for crafting compelling electronic music. His consistent presence on esteemed labels such as Diynamic and Crosstown Rebels further underscores his significant standing in the contemporary electronic music landscape.

Recent Crosstown Rebels & Diynamic Output

Mita Gami's musical style is characterized by its fluid movement between indie dance, melodic house, and melodic techno, frequently employing robust basslines, syncopated percussion, and shimmering synth textures. His recent output in 2025 includes the "Secret Places Remix EP," a collaborative effort with Adam Ten released on Diynamic in August, showcasing their combined prowess in crafting emotionally resonant grooves. Further cementing his sound, the "Untouchable EP" and the single "Million Pieces" both arrived on Crosstown Rebels in July and May 2025 respectively, each demonstrating his knack for intricate production and dancefloor-ready appeal. With a dedicated following of over 28,000 Spotify followers, Mita Gami's tracks consistently find their way into curated playlists and DJ sets worldwide, reflecting his broad appeal within the scene.

Sinner's Fourth Season at Vagalume

This performance sees Mita Gami taking the decks for Sinner, the boutique party series entering its fourth season at Vagalume Tulum, renowned for its high-end atmosphere and energetic parties. Expect Mita Gami to navigate through his signature blend of indie dance and melodic techno, building a set that perfectly complements Vagalume's stunning beachfront setting and vibrant energy. The event, conceptualized by DJs and producers VITE and Miganova, promises an evening where their foundational grooves will set the stage for Mita Gami's intricate soundscapes, ensuring a seamless flow of music. Vagalume's premium location, known for its transformation from daytime serenity to nighttime excitement, provides an ideal backdrop for Mita Gami's sophisticated sonic journey, enhanced by the venue's exceptional acoustics.

Planning Your Sinner Night

The Sinner event featuring Mita Gami commences at 3:00 PM on December 27th at Vagalume Tulum, offering an extended experience from late afternoon into the evening. Tickets for this premium beach club affair start at $880 MXN, reflecting the high-end atmosphere and caliber of international talent. Given Vagalume's popularity as Tulum's most iconic beach club and its reputation for memorable events, advanced reservations are highly recommended to secure entry and enjoy the venue's acclaimed Mexican and Caribbean fusion menu.

Summerians, concebido en Ibiza, regresa a Tulum para su quinta temporada consecutiva, estableciendo su presencia como una serie de eventos significativos en el panorama de la música electrónica de la región. La serie ha cautivado al público de todo el mundo, con ediciones celebradas en diversos lugares como Bali, Mykonos, Atenas, Dubai, Nueva York, Miami y Phuket. Su constante regreso a Tulum subraya su atractivo único, ofreciendo un viaje transformador a través de su vibrante esencia de Afro Melodic y Ethnic House, caracterizada por un enfoque antropomórfico de la música y la experiencia.

Con impresionantes vistas al mar Caribe desde la playa, el local cultiva una animada atmósfera que atrae a una mezcla de visitantes internacionales y entusiastas locales. Su diseño al aire libre y el entorno natural realzan el interés de la serie por conectar con la tierra, creando un espacio íntimo donde los sonidos afro-melódicos y étnicos de la casa pueden resonar profundamente en el ambiente selvático.

Asegurar el paso

Este particular encuentro de Summerians, que tendrá lugar el 12 de marzo de 2026, se prolongará desde las 19:00 hasta la 1:00, ofreciendo una extensa velada de música y conexión. Los boletos Early Bird están disponibles a partir de $605 MXN, con precios que aumentan a través de los niveles First, Second y Final Release. Se anima a los asistentes a adoptar el código de vestimenta 'Tulum Style', que refleja el ambiente relajado pero chic del evento. Para aquellos que buscan una experiencia elevada, mesas VIP con servicio de botella también están disponibles, y se recomienda la compra anticipada de entradas para asegurar la entrada.

en.body:
Bora Uzer's Eclectic Journey

Hailing from Turkey, Bora Uzer has cultivated a distinctive presence in the electronic music landscape, initially gaining recognition as a key member of the alternative group Kangroove. His transition to a solo career saw him explore a broader musical spectrum, marked by his debut album and notable collaborations. Uzer's early solo work, including the track "You Are," found its way onto the European compilation "Grillenundchillen," signaling his international reach. Further cementing his diverse artistic connections, he featured as a guest artist on İlhan Erşahin’s "Harikalar Diyarı" album, showcasing his versatility beyond conventional electronic genres.

Organic House and Pop Fusion

Bora Uzer's musical style navigates a compelling intersection of organic house and Turkish pop, constructing sets that blend rhythmic sophistication with melodic accessibility. While his discography includes earlier albums like "B1" (2009) and "Benim Umrumda" (2018), his recent output includes the "Cybernetic Symphony" single, released in May 2025. Tracks such as "Sensiz," "Sammaye," and "Mujer Estrella" are frequently highlighted by his audience, demonstrating his ability to craft memorable compositions.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance by Bora Uzer at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an evening where his signature organic house grooves will unfold within one of Tulum's premier nightlife destinations. Bonbonniere, known as the only nightclub open until late in the Hotel Zone, offers a luxurious ambiance complemented by a state-of-the-art sound system and a retractable roof, enhancing the sonic and visual experience. Uzer's set is expected to leverage these features, building from intricate, percussive rhythms to more expansive, melodic soundscapes, perfectly suited for the venue's energetic dance floor and sophisticated atmosphere. The club's reputation for hosting world-class artists ensures a high-fidelity experience for attendees.

Entry and Dress Code Enforcement

Bora Uzer's performance is scheduled for Thursday, December 25th, starting at 10 PM and continuing till late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to uphold its sophisticated atmosphere. Entry will be refused to individuals not complying with the dress code; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are explicitly prohibited. Given Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot and its premium audience, securing tickets in advance is highly recommended.

es.body:
El ecléctico viaje de Bora Uzer

Procedente de Turquía, Bora Uzer ha cultivado una presencia distintiva en el panorama de la música electrónica, ganando reconocimiento inicialmente como miembro clave del grupo alternativo Kangroove. Su transición a una carrera en solitario le llevó a explorar un espectro musical más amplio, marcado por su álbum de debut y notables colaboraciones. Los primeros trabajos en solitario de Uzer, incluido el tema "You Are", se incluyeron en el recopilatorio europeo "Grillenundchillen", lo que indica su alcance internacional. Para cimentar aún más sus diversas conexiones artísticas, participó como artista invitado en el álbum "Harikalar Diyarı" de İlhan Erşahin, mostrando su versatilidad más allá de los géneros electrónicos convencionales.

House orgánico y fusión pop

El estilo musical de Bora Uzer navega por una atractiva intersección de house orgánico y pop turco, construyendo conjuntos que mezclan sofisticación rítmica con accesibilidad melódica. Si bien su discografía incluye álbumes anteriores como "B1" (2009) y "Benim Umrumda" (2018), su producción reciente incluye el single "Cybernetic Symphony", publicado en mayo de 2025. Temas como "Sensiz", "Sammaye" y "Mujer Estrella" son frecuentemente destacados por su público, demostrando su habilidad para elaborar composiciones memorables.

Esta actuación de Bora Uzer en Bonbonniere Tulum promete una velada en la que se desplegarán sus característicos ritmos house orgánicos en uno de los principales destinos nocturnos de Tulum. Bonbonniere, conocido como el único club nocturno abierto hasta tarde en la Zona Hotelera, ofrece un ambiente de lujo complementado con un sistema de sonido de última generación y un techo retráctil, mejorando la experiencia sonora y visual. Se espera que la actuación de Uzer aproveche estas características, desde ritmos intrincados y percusivos hasta paisajes sonoros más amplios y melódicos, perfectamente adaptados a la enérgica pista de baile y al sofisticado ambiente del local. Se denegará la entrada a las personas que no cumplan el código de vestimenta; se prohíbe explícitamente el uso de atuendos playeros como trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos. en.body:
Dubfire & Nicole Moudaber: Techno Architects

Dubfire, the Iranian-American artist born Ali Shirazinia, from his Grammy-winning Deep Dish progressive house roots to a driving force in techno, establishing his SCI+TEC imprint as a platform for dark, percussive sounds. Alongside him, Lebanese-British DJ and producer Nicole Moudaber has carved her own formidable presence in the global techno scene, known for her relentless energy and the influential MOOD Records label, complemented by her widely syndicated In The MOOD radio show. Both artists have cultivated careers defined by uncompromising techno aesthetics, frequently headlining major festivals and clubs worldwide, solidifying their positions as stalwarts of the genre.

Driving Rhythms and Industrial Textures

The combined musical style of Dubfire and Nicole Moudaber explores the deeper, more industrial facets of techno, characterized by driving four-to-the-floor kicks, intricate percussive layers, and hypnotic, often dark, melodic motifs. Dubfire's solo work, including popular tracks like "CORA DE HIELO," "NIENTIENDO," and "PLAY DOH," often navigates minimal techno structures with a powerful, functional edge, evidenced by his recent 2025 singles "HnC??" (April 25), "HOLLABACKGIRRRRRL??" (April 4), and "Chanel??" (March 3). Moudaber, in turn, injects a raw, tribal energy into her sets, frequently incorporating robust basslines and syncopated rhythms. Their b2b sets are a masterclass in complementary mixing, blending their individual strengths into a cohesive, high-impact sonic journey.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum on January 2nd, 2026, promises an extended journey through the darker spectrum of techno as Dubfire and Nicole Moudaber deliver a highly anticipated back-to-back set. Attendees can expect a dynamic progression from deep, hypnotic grooves to peak-time industrial techno, showcasing their renowned synergy and track selection. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and the unique ambiance of its retractable roof, which opens to the starlit sky, will perfectly complement the artists' expansive soundscapes. No supporting acts are listed for this specific event, indicating a substantial set from the headliners themselves, ensuring the dance floor remains energized until late.

Entry and Dress Code at Bonbonniere

Doors for this event open on Friday, January 2nd, with the performance scheduled to run from 10 PM. Tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN, offering access to Bonbonniere's exclusive nightlife experience. A strictly enforced formal dress code is in effect, prohibiting beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts to maintain the venue's sophisticated atmosphere. Paid valet parking is available, and advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended to secure entry to this premier Tulum event.

es.body:
Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber: Techno Architects

Dubfire, el artista iraní-estadounidense nacido Ali Shirazinia, pasó de sus raíces en el house progresivo Deep Dish, ganador de un Grammy, a convertirse en una fuerza impulsora del techno, estableciendo su sello SCI+TEC como plataforma de sonidos oscuros y percusivos. Junto a él, la DJ y productora libanesa-británica Nicole Moudaber se ha labrado su propia y formidable presencia en la escena mundial del techno, conocida por su implacable energía y el influyente sello MOOD Records, complementado por su programa de radio In The MOOD, ampliamente difundido. Ambas artistas han cultivado carreras definidas por una estética techno sin concesiones, actuando con frecuencia como cabezas de cartel en importantes festivales y clubes de todo el mundo, consolidando sus posiciones como incondicionales del género.

Ritmos contundentes y texturas industriales

El estilo musical combinado de Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber explora las facetas más profundas e industriales del techno, caracterizado por ritmos contundentes, intrincadas capas de percusión y motivos melódicos hipnóticos, a menudo oscuros. El trabajo en solitario de Dubfire, que incluye temas populares como "CORA DE HIELO", "NIENTIENDO" y "PLAY DOH", a menudo navega por estructuras de techno minimalista con un toque potente y funcional, como demuestran sus recientes 2025 singles "HnC??" (25 de abril), "HOLLABACKGIRRRRRL??" (4 de abril) y "Chanel??" (3 de marzo) (3 de marzo). Moudaber, por su parte, inyecta una energía cruda y tribal a sus sets, incorporando con frecuencia robustas líneas de bajo y ritmos sincopados. Sus sesiones b2b son una clase magistral de mezclas complementarias, que combinan sus puntos fuertes individuales en un viaje sonoro cohesivo y de gran impacto.

Tarde en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum, el 2 de enero de 2026, promete un largo viaje a través del espectro más oscuro del techno, ya que Dubfire y Nicole Moudaber ofrecerán un esperado set back-to-back. Los asistentes pueden esperar una progresión dinámica desde grooves profundos e hipnóticos hasta el techno industrial de máxima audiencia, mostrando su reconocida sinergia y selección de temas. El sistema de sonido de última generación de Bonbonniere y el ambiente único de su techo retráctil, que se abre al cielo estrellado, complementarán a la perfección los amplios paisajes sonoros de los artistas. Para este evento en concreto no se han programado actuaciones de apoyo, lo que indica que los cabezas de cartel ofrecerán un set sustancial que garantizará que la pista de baile se mantenga animada hasta tarde.

Entrada y código de vestimenta en Bonbonniere

Las puertas de este evento se abrirán el viernes 2 de enero y el espectáculo comenzará a las 22.00 horas. Los boletos tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN y ofrecen acceso a la exclusiva experiencia nocturna de Bonbonniere. Un estricto código de vestimenta formal está en vigor, prohibiendo atuendos de playa como trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos para mantener el ambiente sofisticado del lugar. Hay servicio de aparcacoches de pago disponible, y se recomienda encarecidamente la compra anticipada de entradas para asegurar la entrada a este evento de primera clase en Tulum.

en.body:
Collecting Dots Presents OMRI, Tom & Collins, and More

This edition of Collecting Dots at Vagalume Tulum features a robust lineup including OMRI, TOM & COLLINS, RAFAEL, DOR DANINO, JAY PARLESTEIN, and MIUL. These artists are set to deliver a diverse range of electronic music, aligning with Vagalume's reputation for showcasing sounds from deep house to melodic techno. The collective aims to craft an extended journey, moving from daytime grooves into a vibrant night, characteristic of Tulum's energetic beach club scene.

Vagalume Tulum's Day-to-Night Transformation

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the heart of Tulum's hotel zone, provides the quintessential beachfront setting for Collecting Dots. Known for its seamless transition from a serene daytime escape to an energetic nighttime hub, the venue offers stunning Caribbean Sea views. Its design fosters an atmosphere where guests can relax on comfortable beach beds by day and immerse themselves in vibrant electronic music as the sun sets, making it a premier spot for music and events.

Secure Your Entry: Tickets and Tulum Style

Entry to Collecting Dots begins with Early Bird tickets priced at $880 MXN, with prices increasing through First, Second, and Last Release tiers up to $1,870 MXN. The event runs for a full twelve hours, from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, allowing for a comprehensive musical experience. Attendees are encouraged to embrace the "Tulum Style" dress code, and VIP tables with bottle service are available for those seeking an elevated experience, with WhatsApp contact provided for reservations.

en.body:
Rico Loop & Goldcap: Guiding The White Oracle

The New Year's 2026 celebration at Ahau Tulum features a carefully structured musical journey, beginning with Rico Loop. His live musical journeys will accompany the chef-driven oceanfront dinner, setting a contemplative tone for the evening. As the night progresses from 10 PM, Goldcap takes over, leading the beach into a sanctuary of music and movement with his signature deep, energetic, and mystical sound, guiding attendees into the first dawn of 2026. This lineup is designed to complement the event's ritualistic theme, moving from ambient beginnings to a more immersive dance experience.

SET Underground & Ahau's Collaborative New Year

This New Year's 2026 marks a significant collaboration as SET Underground and Ahau Tulum unite for the first time to craft this specific New Year's experience. While both entities have a history of hosting notable New Year's events, as evidenced by past editions from SET Underground and Ahau's own white parties, this partnership signifies a fresh approach. Presented alongside David Graziano, this union aims to blend their collective expertise in creating an event shaped by ritual and the unique magic of Tulum's shoreline, aligning with the numerological significance of 2026 as a Year 1.

Ahau Tulum's Moonlit Shoreline

The event unfolds at Ahau Tulum, renowned for its iconic architecture and soulful beachfront setting. Guests will experience a chef-driven dinner directly on the oceanfront, under the stars, with the moonlight reflecting over the Caribbean Sea. From 10 PM, the beach itself transforms into the primary space for music and movement, offering a natural, open-air environment that enhances the event's theme of new beginnings and connection to nature. The venue's design and location are integral to the curated atmosphere of "The White Oracle."

Entering The New Cycle

The evening commences at 8 PM with the oceanfront dinner, with the main musical program led by Goldcap starting at 10 PM and continuing until late. Attendees are encouraged to dress in tribal white attire, reflecting the "White Oracle" theme and the elegance required for the event. Tickets start at $4,840 MXN, with limited capacity ensuring an intimate experience. VIP table service, offering premier viewing and private service, is available by contacting ventasrp@ahaucollection.com. All ticket and table sales are final and non-refundable, though transfer or credit options may be available upon request.
en.description: David Graziano & Set Underground's New Year's 2026 at Ahau Tulum features Rico Loop's live music, then Goldcap delivers deep, organic electronic music
en.name: David Graziano & Set Underground NYE

en.body:
Tu Brunch /w Gledd, The Funk District and Max Luevano

Tu Brunch arrives at Kanan for the very first time, bringing our daytime series to one of Tulum’s most iconic venues. This special Thursday edition marks a new chapter for Tu Brunch, combining music, nature, and a rfun daytime atmosphere.

For our debut at Kanan, we’re welcoming a strong lineup featuring Gledd, The Funk District, and Max Luevano, setting the tone from early afternoon through sunset with groovy, uplifting sounds.

Free Entry (Limited Guestlist)

Entry is free, but the guestlist is limited. We recommend grabbing your spot early to secure entry. A paid ticket option will also be available for those who miss the free guestlist.

Sunbed & Cabana Packages Available

For those looking to upgrade their experience, Sunbed and Cabana packages are available for this event. These packages include Tu Brunch access, 3 hours of free-flow drinks from Kanan’s selected bars, and one complimentary dish from the designated menu. Packages are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

What to Expect

Expect a fun daytime atmosphere with music throughout the day, a social crowd, and the signature Tu Brunch vibe that brings people together. From dancing to enjoying the views and moving between spaces, this edition is about feeling good, staying present, and enjoying the moment.
en.description: Tu Brunch debuts at Kanan on Dec 18 with Gledd, The Funk District and Max Luevano. Expect great music, fun daytime energy and beautiful views. Limited guestlist and open bar packages available.
en.name: Tu Brunch /w Gledd

es.body:
Tu Brunch /w Gledd, The Funk District y Max Luevano

Tu Brunch llega a Kanan por primera vez, llevando nuestra serie diurna a uno de los lugares más emblemáticos de Tulum. Esta edición especial de los jueves marca un nuevo capítulo para Tu Brunch, combinando música, naturaleza y un ambiente diurno divertido.

Para nuestro debut en Kanan, estamos dando la bienvenida a una alineación fuerte con Gledd, The Funk District, y Max Luevano, estableciendo el tono de la tarde hasta el atardecer con sonidos groovy, edificante.

Entrada gratuita (lista de invitados limitada)

La entrada es gratuita, pero la lista de invitados es limitada. Le recomendamos que se haga con una plaza con antelación para asegurarse la entrada. También habrá una opción de entrada de pago para los que no se apunten a la lista de invitados gratuita.

Paquetes de hamacas y cabañas disponibles

Para aquellos que deseen mejorar su experiencia, hay disponibles paquetes de hamacas y cabañas para este evento. Estos paquetes incluyen acceso a Tu Brunch, 3 horas de bebidas gratuitas de los bares seleccionados por Kanan, y un plato de cortesía del menú designado. Los paquetes son limitados y están disponibles por orden de llegada.

Qué esperar

Disfruta de un ambiente diurno divertido, con música durante todo el día, un público sociable y el ambiente característico de Tu Brunch, que une a la gente. Desde bailar hasta disfrutar de las vistas y moverse entre espacios, esta edición es para sentirse bien, estar presente y disfrutar del momento.

en.body:
Ancestral Soul Featuring Andhim, Vxsion, Rami B2B Leonardo, and Ross

The "Ancestral Soul" event, presented as part of the Tulum party series, showcases a lineup of artists known for their distinct electronic music styles. German duo Andhim leads this session, bringing their signature sound to the forefront. Joining them are Vxsion, alongside the collaborative set from Rami B2B Leonardo, and Ross, who will collectively shape the night's musical progression. Expect a journey through various electronic genres, from deep house to more driving progressive sounds, creating a cohesive atmosphere for the Bonbonniere dance floor.

Bonbonniere's Dynamic Nightlife Setting

Bonbonniere Tulum stands as a premier nightlife destination in the Hotel Zone, known for its blend of luxury and an energetic dance floor. As the only nightclub open until late in the area, it has become a central spot for party enthusiasts and afterparties, situated alongside popular venues like Bagatelle and Vagalume. The club features a state-of-the-art sound system and a retractable roof, enhancing the atmosphere by offering views of the starlit sky. This design creates a sophisticated yet lively environment for electronic music events.

Essential Details for Entry

The "Ancestral Soul" event at Bonbonniere Tulum is scheduled for Sunday, January 4th, commencing at 10 pm and running until late. A formal dress code is strictly enforced for all attendees; prohibited attire includes swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts. Bonbonniere operates as a premium nightlife venue, offering an exclusive setting for those seeking a sophisticated electronic music experience.
en.description: ANDHIM headlines ANCESTRAL SOUL's Sunday session at Bonbonniere Tulum, joined by VXSION, RAMI B2B LEONARDO, and ROSS
en.name: Ancestral Soul

es.body:
Ancestral Soul con Andhim, Vxsion, Rami B2B Leonardo y Ross

El evento "Ancestral Soul", presentado como parte de la serie de fiestas de Tulum, presenta una alineación de artistas conocidos por sus distintos estilos de música electrónica. El dúo alemán Andhim encabeza esta sesión, aportando su característico sonido. Junto a ellos estarán Vxsion y el set colaborativo de Rami B2B Leonardo y Ross, que colectivamente darán forma a la progresión musical de la noche. Te espera un viaje a través de varios géneros electrónicos, desde el deep house hasta los sonidos progresivos más impulsivos, creando una atmósfera cohesiva para la pista de baile de Bonbonniere.

El dinámico ambiente nocturno de Bonbonniere

Bonbonniere Tulum se erige como un destino nocturno de primer nivel en la Zona Hotelera, conocido por su mezcla de lujo y una enérgica pista de baile. Al ser la única discoteca abierta hasta tarde en la zona, se ha convertido en un lugar central para los amantes de la fiesta y los afterparties, situado junto a locales populares como Bagatelle y Vagalume. La discoteca cuenta con un sistema de sonido de última generación y un techo retráctil que realza el ambiente ofreciendo vistas del cielo estrellado. Este diseño crea un ambiente sofisticado pero animado para eventos de música electrónica.

Detalles esenciales para la entrada

El evento "Ancestral Soul" en Bonbonniere Tulum está programado para el domingo 4 de enero, a partir de las 22.00 horas y hasta tarde. Se aplica estrictamente un código de vestimenta formal para todos los asistentes; el atuendo prohibido incluye trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos. Bonbonniere opera como un lugar de vida nocturna premium, ofreciendo un ambiente exclusivo para aquellos que buscan una experiencia de música electrónica sofisticada.

en.body:
Disorder Showcases Electronic Talent at Vagalume

Disorder presents a significant lineup for its upcoming session at Vagalume, featuring a blend of established names and regional talent. Headlining the event is Rodriguez Jr, known for his melodic approach to electronic music, alongside Sander Kleinenberg, who brings his extensive experience to the decks. Sam Shure also joins, contributing to the event's progressive and deep house sound profile. Support comes from Renê B2B Miul, Ra, and Dhaf, ensuring a continuous flow of electronic music throughout the day and night.

Vagalume Tulum's Dynamic Beachfront Setting

Vagalume Tulum, situated in the vibrant Hotel Zone, provides the backdrop for Disorder. This premium beach club is recognized for its seamless transition from a serene daytime retreat to an energetic nighttime hub, capturing the essence of Tulum's electronic music scene. With stunning beachfront views of the Caribbean Sea, Vagalume offers an atmosphere where international visitors and locals gather, making it a key destination for events featuring deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno.

Event Essentials and Ticket Information

The Disorder event at Vagalume is scheduled from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering a full day and night of music. Tickets are available in tiers, starting at $550 MXN for Early Bird, progressing to $880 MXN for First Release, $1,210 MXN for Second Release, and $1,540 MXN for Final Release. Attendees are encouraged to adhere to a "Tulum Style" dress code. VIP tables with bottle service are also available, with inquiries directed via WhatsApp for booking.

Disorder presenta un importante cartel para su próxima sesión en Vagalume, con una mezcla de nombres consagrados y talento regional. El cabeza de cartel es Rodriguez Jr, conocido por su enfoque melódico de la música electrónica, junto a Sander Kleinenberg, que aporta su amplia experiencia a los platos. El dinámico entorno frente al mar de Vagalume Tulum

Vagalume Tulum, situado en la vibrante Zona Hotelera, proporciona el telón de fondo para Disorder. Con impresionantes vistas frente al mar Caribe, Vagalume ofrece un ambiente en el que se reúnen visitantes internacionales y locales, lo que lo convierte en un destino clave para eventos de deep house, progressive house y techno melódico.

Los boletos están disponibles por niveles, comenzando en $550 MXN para Early Bird, pasando por $880 MXN para First Release, $1,210 MXN para Second Release y $1,540 MXN para Final Release. Mesas VIP con servicio de botella también están disponibles, con preguntas dirigidas a través de WhatsApp para la reserva.

en.body:
Tristan Van Grant, Mee Kay, Cvazmu & Agorista

This edition of Virgo, presented by Handz of Time, features a lineup curated to embody the series' "earth chapter" theme. Tristan Van Grant, known for his blend of tribal house, driving techno, and organic rhythms, brings a sound shaped by journey and connection, reignited within Tulum's beach-house scene. Mee Kay, a Canadian DJ based in Mexico, contributes a versatile mix of deep-house, organic, Afro-house, and melodic textures, drawing from global influences and performances in Ibiza. Alongside them, Cvazmu and Agorista will guide the dancefloor with sets crafted for intention, balance, and depth, resonating with the land's energy from noon into nightfall.

Handz of Time's Zodiac Journey

Virgo marks the earth chapter in Handz of Time's ambitious 12-sign journey, a series concept that explores different energetic themes through electronic music. This collective aims to shape the dancefloor with detail, intention, and grounded energy, aligning each event with the specific characteristics of a zodiac sign. The "Handz of Time chapter" signifies their ongoing commitment to crafting experiences that resonate with purpose and refinement within the Tulum scene, building a narrative across the astrological calendar.

Mía Tulum's Open-Air Setting

Mía Tulum provides the backdrop for Virgo, offering an open-air environment that complements the event's focus on grounded energy and natural rhythms. As a prominent venue within Tulum's beach-house and tribal scene, its atmosphere is well-suited for extended daytime-into-nighttime sessions. The space allows for a seamless flow of music and movement, enhancing the collective experience as the sun transitions to night and the beats resonate with the land.

Event Details & Entry

Virgo commences on January 8th, running from 12 PM to 11 PM at Mía Tulum, offering a full day of music. Tickets are available starting at $1,012 MXN for those looking to join this chapter of the Handz of Time series. For further information regarding the event, attendees can contact +52 984 156 43 33.
en.description: Tristan Van Grant, Mee Kay, Cvazmu, and Agorista deliver earth-rooted tribal house, techno, and Afro-house for Virgo - Handz of Time at Mía Tulum
en.name: Virgo - Handz of Time

es.body:
Tristan Van Grant, Mee Kay, Cvazmu y Agorista

Esta edición de Virgo, presentada por Handz of Time, cuenta con un cartel que encarna el tema de la serie "Earth Chapter". Tristan Van Grant, conocido por su mezcla de tribal house, driving techno y ritmos orgánicos, aporta un sonido moldeado por el viaje y la conexión, reavivado dentro de la escena beach-house de Tulum. Mee Kay, DJ canadiense afincado en México, contribuye con una versátil mezcla de deep-house, orgánico, afro-house y texturas melódicas, a partir de influencias globales y actuaciones en Ibiza. Junto a ellos, Cvazmu y Agorista guiarán la pista de baile con sets creados para la intención, el equilibrio y la profundidad, resonando con la energía de la tierra desde el mediodía hasta el anochecer.

El viaje zodiacal de Handz of Time

Virgo marca el capítulo terrestre del ambicioso viaje de 12 signos de Handz of Time, un concepto de serie que explora diferentes temas energéticos a través de la música electrónica. Este colectivo pretende dar forma a la pista de baile con detalle, intención y energía aterrizada, alineando cada evento con las características específicas de un signo del zodiaco. El "capítulo Handz of Time" significa su compromiso continuo con la elaboración de experiencias que resuenan con propósito y refinamiento dentro de la escena de Tulum, construyendo una narrativa a través del calendario astrológico.

El entorno al aire libre de Mía Tulum

Mía Tulum proporciona el telón de fondo para Virgo, ofreciendo un entorno al aire libre que complementa el enfoque del evento en la energía de la tierra y los ritmos naturales. Como lugar destacado dentro de la escena tribal y de casas de playa de Tulum, su atmósfera es idónea para sesiones prolongadas de día a noche. El espacio permite un flujo perfecto de música y movimiento, mejorando la experiencia colectiva a medida que el sol se convierte en noche y los ritmos resuenan con la tierra.

Detalles del evento y acceso

Virgo comienza el 8 de enero, de 12 PM a 11 PM en Mía Tulum, ofreciendo un día completo de música. Los boletos están disponibles a partir de $1,012 MXN para aquellos que buscan unirse a este capítulo de la serie Handz of Time. Para mayor información sobre el evento, los asistentes pueden comunicarse al +52 984 156 43 33.

en.body:
Damian Lazarus

Damian Lazarus, a UK-born DJ, producer, and A&R, has been a pivotal figure in electronic music for over two decades. His career began significantly as Head of A&R for City Rockers, where he signed influential acts before founding his own imprint, Crosstown Rebels, in 2003. This label became a cornerstone for a distinctive sound blending deep house, techno, and an ethereal, often psychedelic aesthetic. Beyond his DJ sets, Lazarus has also explored live performance with his band, Damian Lazarus & The Ancient Moons, releasing albums like "Smoke the Monster Out" and "Message from the Other Side," showcasing a broader musical vision.

Shamanic Rhythms & Ethereal Soundscapes

Lazarus's musical style navigates a spectrum of deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno, characterized by its hypnotic grooves, intricate percussion, and often mystical vocal samples. His productions frequently explore extended sonic journeys, building tension and release through layers of analog warmth and subtle, evolving melodies. His recent album, "Magickal," released in January 2025, exemplifies this approach, featuring tracks that traverse introspective soundscapes and driving, four-to-the-floor rhythms. Further expanding this body of work, the "Magickal Remixed" album is slated for release in October 2025. Tracks like "Into The Sun" and "Don't Be Afraid"

Wednesday Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises a deep dive into Lazarus's expansive sonic universe, unfolding within the venue's luxurious yet energetic nightclub setting. Attendees can expect a typical Lazarus set to progress from atmospheric, percussive warm-ups into more driving, melodic techno and progressive house as the night deepens. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and production, complemented by its retractable roof that opens to the starlit sky, are ideally suited to enhance the intricate layers and immersive qualities of his sound. The event is scheduled for Wednesday, January 15th, extending late into the morning, ensuring ample time for a comprehensive musical journey.

Entry & Attire Guidelines

Access to this exclusive event at Bonbonniere Tulum begins with tickets priced at $1,100 MXN. Doors open at 10 pm, with the night expected to build towards peak hours after midnight, continuing until late. Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code to preserve its sophisticated atmosphere; beach attire, including caps, shorts, sandals, sports shirts, and swimwear, is not permitted. Given the venue's popularity and the caliber of the artist, purchasing tickets in advance is highly recommended to secure entry.
en.description: Damian Lazarus, Crosstown Rebels founder and influential City Rockers A&R, presents his signature deep, melodic house and techno music.
en.name: Damian Lazarus

es.body:
Damian Lazarus

Damian Lazarus, DJ, productor y A&R nacido en el Reino Unido, ha sido una figura fundamental en la música electrónica durante más de dos décadas. Su carrera comenzó como Jefe de A&R de City Rockers, donde firmó influyentes proyectos antes de fundar su propio sello, Crosstown Rebels, en 2003. Este sello se convirtió en la piedra angular de un sonido distintivo que combina deep house, techno y una estética etérea, a menudo psicodélica. Más allá de sus sesiones como DJ, Lazarus también ha explorado las actuaciones en directo con su banda, Damian Lazarus & The Ancient Moons, y ha publicado álbumes como "Smoke the Monster Out" y "Message from the Other Side", en los que muestra una visión musical más amplia.

Ritmos chamánicos y paisajes sonoros etéreos

El estilo musical de Lazarus navega por un espectro de deep house, progressive house y techno melódico, caracterizado por sus grooves hipnóticos, percusión intrincada y muestras vocales a menudo místicas. Sus producciones exploran con frecuencia viajes sónicos prolongados, creando tensión y liberación a través de capas de calidez analógica y melodías sutiles y cambiantes. Su reciente álbum, "Magickal", publicado en enero de 2025, ejemplifica este enfoque, con temas que atraviesan paisajes sonoros introspectivos y ritmos contundentes. El álbum "Magickal Remixed", que amplía esta línea de trabajo, saldrá a la venta en octubre de 2025. Temas como "Into The Sun" y "Don't Be Afraid"

Miércoles por la noche en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete una inmersión profunda en el universo sónico expansivo de Lazarus, que se desarrollará en el lujoso y enérgico ambiente nocturno del local. Los asistentes pueden esperar que un set típico de Lazarus progrese desde un calentamiento atmosférico y percusivo a un techno y house progresivo más impulsivo y melódico a medida que la noche se hace más profunda. El sistema de sonido y la producción de vanguardia de Bonbonniere, complementados por su techo retráctil que se abre al cielo estrellado, son ideales para realzar las intrincadas capas y las cualidades envolventes de su sonido. El evento está programado para el miércoles 15 de enero y se prolongará hasta altas horas de la madrugada, lo que garantiza tiempo suficiente para un viaje musical completo.

Normas de acceso y vestimenta

El acceso a este evento exclusivo en Bonbonniere Tulum comienza con boletos a un precio de $1,100 MXN. Las puertas se abren a las 10 pm, y se espera que la noche llegue a su punto máximo después de la medianoche, continuando hasta tarde. Bonbonniere mantiene un estricto código de vestimenta elegante-formal para preservar su ambiente sofisticado; no se permite la vestimenta de playa, incluyendo gorras, pantalones cortos, sandalias, camisetas deportivas y trajes de baño. Dada la popularidad del lugar y el calibre de los artistas, se recomienda encarecidamente comprar las entradas con antelación para asegurarse la entrada.

Sainte Vie's Live Performance at Set Underground

This edition of Set Underground at Mia Tulum features a live performance by Sainte Vie, the acclaimed electronic music producer, sound engineer, and label owner Pablo Piña. Known for his melodic techno sound, Sainte Vie integrates various electronic and world music elements to craft energetic and deeply emotional sets. His extensive global touring, including appearances at major festivals like Burning Man, Coachella, and Fusion Festival, highlights his significant presence in the electronic music landscape. Attendees can anticipate a dynamic live experience showcasing his original productions and remixes, reflecting his journey from a rock band leader to a prominent figure in the melodic techno scene.

The Venue: Mia Tulum

The Set Underground series unfolds at Mia Tulum, providing the setting for this electronic music gathering. Located in Tulum, the venue hosts events that contribute to the region's reputation as a destination for immersive musical experiences.

Essential Event Information

Doors for Set Underground open at 6 PM on Saturday, January 17th, with the event continuing until 1 AM, welcoming guests aged 18 and over. For those seeking an elevated experience, VIP private tables and concierge services are available. It is important to note that all ticket and table sales are final and non-refundable, a policy clearly communicated and agreed upon at the time of purchase.

Conocido por su sonido techno melódico, Sainte Vie integra varios elementos de música electrónica y del mundo para crear sets enérgicos y profundamente emocionales. Sus extensas giras por todo el mundo, incluidas sus apariciones en grandes festivales como Burning Man, Coachella y Fusion Festival, ponen de relieve su importante presencia en el panorama de la música electrónica. Los asistentes podrán disfrutar de una dinámica experiencia en directo en la que se mostrarán sus producciones originales y remezclas, reflejo de su trayectoria desde líder de una banda de rock hasta figura prominente en la escena del techno melódico.

en.body:
Tu Brunch at Tulumania

Every Sunday in January, Tu Brunch takes over Tulumania Beach Club for a daytime series built around music, energy, and good vibes. Expect beach views, sunshine, and a lively atmosphere that turns your Sunday into something worth looking forward to.

Tickets & Guestlist

A limited number of free guestlist spots will be available for each Sunday.
Once the free guestlist is full, tickets will be available for 299 MXN, offering an affordable option compared to most events in Tulum while keeping the experience accessible to everyone.

Sunbed / Table Reservations

For guests who prefer a more comfortable setup, sunbed tables will be available at Tulumania. These are ideal for groups who want a dedicated space to enjoy the day, order drinks, and stay close to the music. Sunbeds are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, so early arrival is recommended.

Sunbeds are offered with a minimum consumption of 1,500 MXN per person. To confirm a reservation, a 20% deposit is required in advance, with the remaining balance paid at the end of your visit. Service charge is not included.

What to expect

Expect a high-energy Sunday by the beach, with music playing throughout the day, space to dance, connect, and enjoy the moment, and a crowd that comes ready for good vibes. Tulumania offers great food and drinks, comfortable beachfront areas, and the perfect setting to enjoy sunshine, music, and the Tu Brunch atmosphere from day into sunset.

es.body:
Tu Brunch en Tulumania

Todos los domingos de enero, Tu Brunch se apodera de Tulumania Beach Club para una serie diurna construida en torno a la música, la energía y las buenas vibraciones. Te esperan vistas a la playa, sol y un ambiente animado que convertirá tu domingo en algo digno de esperar.

Esta edición de enero se basa en la sorpresa y el descubrimiento. En lugar de alineaciones anunciadas, cada domingo habrá un invitado especial. Venga por curiosidad, quédese por la música y deje que la experiencia se desarrolle.

Serie de Invitados Especiales

Cada domingo habrá un invitado especial y una actuación en directo, que se anunciarán el mismo día del evento. Sin spoilers: venga, viva la experiencia y disfrute de la sorpresa.

Entradas y lista de invitados

Cada domingo habrá un número limitado de plazas gratuitas en la lista de invitados.
Una vez que la lista de invitados gratuitos se llene, los boletos estarán disponibles por 299 MXN, ofreciendo una opción asequible en comparación con la mayoría de los eventos en Tulum, manteniendo la experiencia accesible para todos.

Cama solar / Reservas de mesa

Para los huéspedes que prefieren una configuración más cómoda, mesas tumbonas estarán disponibles en Tulumania. Son ideales para grupos que quieren un espacio dedicado para disfrutar del día, pedir bebidas y estar cerca de la música. Las tumbonas son limitadas y se asignan por orden de llegada, por lo que se recomienda llegar pronto.

Las tumbonas se ofrecen con un consumo mínimo de 1.500 MXN por persona. Para confirmar una reserva, se requiere un depósito del 20% por adelantado, y el resto se paga al final de la visita. El cargo por servicio no está incluido.

Lo que te espera

Espera un domingo lleno de energía junto a la playa, con música durante todo el día, espacio para bailar, conectar y disfrutar del momento, y una multitud que viene preparada para las buenas vibraciones. Tulumania ofrece buena comida y bebida, cómodas zonas frente a la playa y el entorno perfecto para disfrutar del sol, la música y el ambiente de Tu Brunch desde el día hasta el atardecer.

en.body:
Bontan's House Music Ascent

Bontan has established himself as a significant force within the global house music landscape, recognized for his impactful productions and dynamic DJ sets. Hailing from the UK, his career trajectory is marked by a consistent output of high-charting releases, earning him the Best Newcomer award at the DJ Awards. Bontan's sound, deeply rooted in the underground house scene, has found a home on esteemed labels such as Hot Creations, 20/20 Vision, Elrow Music, and Circus Recordings, solidifying his position as a Beatport best-selling artist.

Rhythmic Explorations in House

Bontan's musical style navigates the vibrant territories of afro house, tech house, tribal house, and latin house, characterized by driving rhythms and infectious grooves. His productions often feature robust four-to-the-floor kicks, intricate percussion, and soulful vocal samples, creating a sound designed for peak-time dancefloors. Recent releases from 2025 include the singles "La Candelaria" (July 2025), "Too Much" (August 2025), and "That's Right" (October 2025), showcasing his continued evolution on various imprints. With over 26,000 Spotify followers, popular tracks like "This Is My Life - Bontan Remix" and "Wile Out (feat. Surya Sen)" highlight his ability to craft widely appealing yet credible club anthems.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an extended journey through Bontan's diverse house sound, from the percussive depths of afro house to the driving energy of tech house. The venue's state-of-the-art sound system and production, coupled with its retractable roof, will enhance Bontan's rhythmic selections, creating an immersive experience under the starlit sky. Bonbonniere's reputation as Tulum's premier late-night destination, known for hosting world-class artists, provides an ideal backdrop for Bontan's energetic and sophisticated style, ensuring the dance floor remains vibrant until the early hours.

Entry & Dress Code Enforcement

Doors for this event at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with Bontan expected to command the decks until late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Attendees should note that a formal dress code is strictly enforced to maintain the venue's luxurious ambiance; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted. Given Bonbonniere's status as a central afterparty spot in Tulum's bustling hotel zone, early arrival is advisable to secure entry and fully experience the night.
en.description: Bontan, a Beatport best-selling artist and DJ Awards Best Newcomer, delivers his acclaimed afro, tech, tribal, and latin house music, with releases on Hot Creations and Circus Recordings
en.name: Bontan

es.body:
El ascenso de Bontan en la música house

Bontan se ha consolidado como una fuerza significativa dentro del panorama mundial de la música house, reconocido por sus impactantes producciones y sus dinámicos DJ sets. Procedente del Reino Unido, la trayectoria de su carrera está marcada por una producción constante de lanzamientos de gran éxito, que le han valido el premio al Mejor Artista Revelación en los DJ Awards. El sonido de Bontan, profundamente arraigado en la escena house underground, ha encontrado un hogar en sellos tan estimados como Hot Creations, 20/20 Vision, Elrow Music y Circus Recordings, consolidando su posición como artista superventas de Beatport.

Exploraciones rítmicas en el house

El estilo musical de Bontan navega por los vibrantes territorios del afro house, el tech house, el tribal house y el latin house, caracterizado por ritmos enérgicos y grooves contagiosos. Sus producciones se caracterizan a menudo por sus potentes bombos, su intrincada percusión y sus conmovedores samples vocales, creando un sonido diseñado para las pistas de baile más concurridas. Los últimos lanzamientos de 2025 incluyen los sencillos "La Candelaria" (julio de 2025), "Too Much" (agosto de 2025) y "That's Right" (octubre de 2025), que muestran su continua evolución en varios sellos. Con más de 26.000 seguidores en Spotify, temas tan populares como "This Is My Life - Bontan Remix" y "Wile Out (feat. Surya Sen)" ponen de manifiesto su capacidad para crear himnos de club atractivos y creíbles.

Late Night en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete un largo viaje a través del variado sonido house de Bontan, desde las profundidades percusivas del afro house hasta la energía impulsora del tech house. El sistema de sonido y la producción de vanguardia del local, junto con su techo retráctil, realzarán las selecciones rítmicas de Bontan, creando una experiencia envolvente bajo el cielo estrellado. La reputación de Bonbonniere como principal destino nocturno de Tulum, conocido por acoger a artistas de talla mundial, proporciona un telón de fondo ideal para el estilo enérgico y sofisticado de Bontan, garantizando que la pista de baile se mantenga vibrante hasta altas horas de la madrugada.

Entrada y código de vestimenta

Las puertas para este evento en Bonbonniere Tulum se abren a las 10 PM, y se espera que Bontan comande los platos hasta tarde. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN. Los asistentes deben tener en cuenta que se aplica estrictamente un código de vestimenta formal para mantener el ambiente de lujo del lugar; no se permiten atuendos de playa como trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos. Dado el estatus de Bonbonniere como un lugar central de afterparty en la bulliciosa zona hotelera de Tulum, se recomienda llegar temprano para asegurar la entrada y disfrutar plenamente de la noche.

en.body:
Tom & Collins

Hailing from Mexico City, the duo Tom & Collins, comprised of Juan Pablo Escudero and Jorge Corral, has solidified their position within the global electronic music landscape. They made a significant impact by entering the Top 100 DJs chart in 2024, showcasing their blend of deep house and deep tech with a pop-friendly sensibility. Their career trajectory is marked by millions of Spotify plays and notable remix work for artists such as TOKiMONST, establishing them as one of Mexico's most prominent electronic acts.

Latin House & Tech-Infused Grooves

Tom & Collins navigate a sound spectrum encompassing latin house, techengue, tribal house, and tech house, characterized by infectious rhythms and accessible melodic structures. Their production style often blends the driving energy of tech house with the vibrant influences of Latin American sounds, creating tracks optimized for dancefloor engagement. Recent releases from 2025 include the singles "Days Go By (Extended Mix)," "Days Go By," and "Disco Muziq," which further explore their signature sound. With a dedicated following of over 56,601 Spotify followers, popular tracks like "Animal," "Ando High," and "Se Va (feat. Cumbiafrica)" exemplify their ability to craft widely appealing electronic music.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an energetic journey through Tom & Collins' diverse sound palette, likely progressing from deep, groovy openers to more driving tech house as the night unfolds. Bonbonniere, situated in the bustling Hotel Zone, is Tulum's premier late-night destination, known for its state-of-the-art sound system and a retractable roof that enhances the open-air experience. The venue's luxurious yet energetic dance floor, a central afterparty spot neighboring Bagatelle and Vagalume, provides an ideal setting for the duo's dynamic sets, ensuring a sophisticated atmosphere for electronic music enthusiasts.

Entry & Dress Code Essentials

The event at Bonbonniere Tulum on Thursday, January 15th, will open its doors at 10 pm and continue till late. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Attendees are reminded that Bonbonniere maintains a strictly enforced formal dress code to preserve its elegant ambiance; swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted. es.body:
Tom & Collins

Procedente de Ciudad de México, el dúo Tom & Collins, formado por Juan Pablo Escudero y Jorge Corral, ha consolidado su posición en el panorama mundial de la música electrónica. Causaron un gran impacto al entrar en la lista Top 100 DJs en 2024, mostrando su mezcla de deep house y deep tech con una sensibilidad pop. Su trayectoria profesional está marcada por millones de reproducciones en Spotify y notables trabajos de remezcla para artistas como TOKiMONST, estableciéndolos como uno de los actos electrónicos más prominentes de México.

Latin House y Tech-Infused Grooves

Tom & Collins navegan por un espectro sonoro que abarca el latin house, el techengue, el tribal house y el tech house, caracterizado por ritmos contagiosos y estructuras melódicas accesibles. Su estilo de producción a menudo combina la energía del tech house con las vibrantes influencias de los sonidos latinoamericanos, creando temas optimizados para la pista de baile. Los últimos lanzamientos de 2025 incluyen los singles "Days Go By (Extended Mix)", "Days Go By" y "Disco Muziq", que exploran aún más su sonido característico. Con más de 56.601 seguidores en Spotify, canciones populares como "Animal", "Ando High" y "Se Va (feat. Cumbiafrica)" demuestran su capacidad para crear música electrónica muy atractiva.

Late Night en Bonbonniere Tulum

Esta actuación en Bonbonniere Tulum promete un viaje enérgico a través de la variada paleta sonora de Tom & Collins, que probablemente progresará desde los temas de apertura más profundos y groovy hasta el tech house más cañero a medida que transcurra la noche. Bonbonniere, situado en la animada Zona Hotelera, es el principal destino nocturno de Tulum, conocido por su sistema de sonido de última generación y un techo retráctil que mejora la experiencia al aire libre. La lujosa pero enérgica pista de baile del local, un punto central de afterparty vecino de Bagatelle y Vagalume, ofrece un escenario ideal para los dinámicos sets del dúo, garantizando un ambiente sofisticado para los entusiastas de la música electrónica.

Entrada y código de vestimenta

El evento en Bonbonniere Tulum el jueves 15 de enero abrirá sus puertas a las 10 pm y continuará hasta tarde. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,100 MXN. Se recuerda a los asistentes que Bonbonniere mantiene un estricto código de vestimenta formal para preservar su ambiente elegante; trajes de baño, gorras, sandalias y pantalones cortos deportivos no están permitidos. Bonbonniere es el único club nocturno que abre hasta tarde en Tulum, por lo que se recomienda asegurar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a esta codiciada experiencia.

en.body:
Sparrow's Rhythmic Identity

Sparrow has established a significant presence within the global electronic music landscape, recognized for his intricate blend of afro house, latin house, afro tech, and tribal house. His sound constructs a narrative through percussion-driven grooves and evocative melodies, resonating with a diverse audience. With a discography that includes albums like 2023's *Réciprocité* and *Réciprocité Remixed*, alongside 2021's *Seven Seas*, Sparrow demonstrates a consistent output that explores the deeper, more soulful dimensions of house music. His career trajectory is marked by a commitment to rhythmic complexity and a sound that bridges traditional influences with contemporary electronic production.

Crafting Afro-Latin Soundscapes

Sparrow's musical style is characterized by its polyrhythmic foundation, often incorporating organic percussion and warm basslines that define the afro house and tribal house subgenres. Tracks such as "Lady (Hear Me Tonight) - Remix," "Champion," and "Dream" exemplify his ability to craft infectious grooves that maintain both dancefloor energy and melodic depth. While specific production techniques are not widely detailed, the warmth and texture in his releases suggest a meticulous approach to sound design, often leaning into analog-inspired textures. With over 32,506 Spotify followers, Sparrow's work consistently reaches a dedicated listenership drawn to his distinctive fusion of global rhythms.

An Evening of Global Grooves at Bonbonniere

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises an immersive journey through Sparrow's signature sound, likely progressing from deep, percussive afro house into more energetic latin house and afro tech selections as the night unfolds. Supporting acts Ape Drums and Bensy will set the stage, building the atmosphere before Sparrow takes control. Bonbonniere's state-of-the-art sound system and its unique retractable roof, which offers views of the starlit sky, are ideally suited to Sparrow's expansive, rhythm-focused productions, enhancing the communal dance experience in this luxurious yet energetic setting.

Essential Information for the Night

Doors for this event at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with the night expected to continue until late, making it a prime afterparty destination in the Hotel Zone. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Attendees should note the strictly enforced elegant-formal dress code; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, or sport shorts will not be permitted. Advanced ticket purchase is highly recommended to secure entry and avoid potential increases at the door.

en.body:
Ayybo

Southern California's Ayybo, born Aaron Bonnema, has rapidly established himself as a prominent figure in the house music landscape, known for his high-energy tech-house productions and dynamic DJ sets. Transitioning from a background as a drummer and school DJ, Ayybo has cultivated a sound that skillfully blends hip-hop, bass, and house influences, earning him a dedicated following. His career trajectory was significantly boosted by viral hits like "Hypnosis," which garnered widespread attention and even led to an official remix by Pitbull, solidifying his position in the electronic music scene.

High-Energy Tech-House & Recent Works

Ayybo's musical style navigates the energetic realms of tech house and house, characterized by driving rhythms and infectious grooves that often incorporate vocal hooks and robust basslines. His production techniques lean into creating immediate dancefloor impact, drawing from his diverse influences to construct tracks that are both technically proficient and widely appealing. Demonstrating his prolific output, recent releases from 2025 include the "Rizz (Millero Remix)" single, "4 Ya Mind" single, and his remix of "Nothing Wrong (AYYBO Remix)," all showcasing his evolving sound. With popular tracks like "RIZZ," "HYPNOSIS," and "DRENCH," Ayybo commands a significant presence, evidenced by his 123,727 Spotify followers.

Late Night at Bonbonniere Tulum

This performance at Bonbonniere Tulum promises a high-octane set, with Ayybo expected to deliver his signature blend of high-energy tech-house that keeps the dancefloor engaged until late. Bonbonniere, renowned as Tulum's premier late-night destination, offers a luxurious yet lively atmosphere perfectly suited for Ayybo's driving sound, with its state-of-the-art sound system and retractable roof enhancing the experience. As a central afterparty spot in the Hotel Zone, the venue's energetic ambiance and focus on world-class electronic artists will complement Ayybo's style, ensuring a night of continuous movement.

Entry & Dress Code

Doors for Ayybo's performance at Bonbonniere Tulum open at 10 PM, with the event continuing until late into the morning. General admission tickets are priced at $1,100 MXN. Guests should note that Bonbonniere strictly enforces an elegant-formal dress code to maintain its sophisticated atmosphere. Entry will be refused for non-compliance; beach attire such as swimming suits, caps, sandals, and sport shorts are not permitted.

en.body:
Sasha: Charting Emotional Narratives

Sasha, the acclaimed singer-songwriter from Boston, Massachusetts, has established a significant presence in the indie-pop and alternative pop landscape. Known for her introspective lyrics and raw emotional honesty, she crafts melodic narratives that resonate deeply with listeners. Before launching her successful performing career, Sasha gained recognition as a songwriter for various prominent artists, solidifying her reputation for poignant storytelling. With a substantial following of over 1.7 million on Spotify, her distinct voice and candid approach have garnered a dedicated global audience.

Introspective Pop Soundscapes

Sasha's musical style navigates melancholic pop melodies, often featuring a blend of acoustic instrumentation and subtle electronic textures. Her production creates an intimate yet expansive sound, serving as a backdrop for her vulnerable and candid lyrical themes. Her 2024 album, "Me Again," released on May 17, 2024, continued her exploration of personal introspection, building on the success of previous albums like 2022's "I Blame The World" and 2020's "Only Child." Tracks such as "Dancing With Your Ghost," "Older," and "Hero" exemplify her ability to craft emotionally resonant pop anthems.

Sasha's Tulum Session at Vagalume

For this Vagalume Sessions event, Sasha is set to deliver a unique performance within Tulum's vibrant electronic music scene. While Vagalume Tulum is renowned for its energetic deep house, progressive house, and melodic techno events, Sasha's appearance suggests a special live vocal set, potentially incorporating electronic reinterpretations of her acclaimed tracks. The evening will also feature sets from supporting artists Hardt Antoine, Neo Human, and Nadi Cabbad, who will contribute to the event's "beats, rhythms, and shared experiences" atmosphere. Vagalume's premium beachfront setting, known for its lively energy and high-end ambiance, offers a distinctive backdrop for Sasha's introspective pop to intertwine with the club's typical electronic pulse.

Event Details & Ticketing

VAGALUME SESSIONS PRESENTS: SASHA is scheduled from 1:00 PM to 1:00 AM, offering a full day and night of music and connection. Early Bird Tickets are available starting at $605 MXN, with prices increasing through subsequent releases. The dress code is "TULUM STYLE," encouraging a relaxed yet chic aesthetic fitting for the premium beach club environment. VIP tables with bottle service are also available for those seeking an elevated experience, with inquiries directed via WhatsApp. Securing tickets in advance is highly recommended for this electronic extravaganza at Vagalume Tulum.

en.body:
Gypsy Disco's Signature Friday Night

Gypsy Disco presents its signature Friday night experience, featuring performances by world-class DJs who set the tone for the evening. Alongside the musical selections, exclusive GITANO cabaret performances add a unique theatrical element to the night. This recurring event cultivates an atmosphere where guests transition from a candlelit dinner to dancing beneath the shimmering disco lights and the iconic disco ball.

A Decade of Tulum's Friday Night Tradition

Gypsy Disco stands as the signature Friday night experience at Gitano Jungle, a venue that has been a cornerstone of Tulum's scene for over ten years. As a key offering from the Gitano Group, which extends its presence to locations like NYC and Dubai, the series reflects the brand's commitment to a bohemian and inclusive atmosphere. Every Friday, Gypsy Disco transforms the Gitano Jungle space from a dining destination into an energetic dance floor, maintaining its reputation as a weekly highlight for the community.

Gitano Jungle's Enchanting Canopy

Gitano Jungle provides the backdrop for Gypsy Disco, situated in the heart of Tulum's Hotel Zone. The venue offers a candlelit Modern Mexican dinner experience beneath the palms, transitioning into an energetic dance floor as the night unfolds. This setting, characterized by its bohemian vibe and natural canopy, becomes alive with shimmering disco lights, creating an atmosphere where the jungle environment enhances the festive energy of the event.

Dinner, Dancing & Reservations

Entry to Gypsy Disco is priced at $1,100 MXN. Dinner seating is offered between 6 PM and 11 PM, with tables reserved for the duration of the night. Guests are encouraged to make reservations for their complete party to ensure they are seated together. For those seeking an enhanced experience, bottle service is available as the evening's energy builds.
en.description: Gypsy Disco's signature Friday night at GITANO JUNGLE features world-class DJs and exclusive GITANO cabaret performances, delivering disco music.
en.name: Gypsy Disco

es.body:
La noche de los viernes de Gypsy Disco

Gypsy Disco presenta su emblemática experiencia de los viernes por la noche, con actuaciones de DJs de talla mundial que marcan el tono de la velada. Junto a las selecciones musicales, las actuaciones exclusivas del cabaret GITANO añaden un elemento teatral único a la noche. Este evento recurrente cultiva una atmósfera en la que los invitados pasan de una cena a la luz de las velas a bailar bajo las brillantes luces de la discoteca y la icónica bola de discoteca.

Una década de tradición en la noche de los viernes de Tulum

Gypsy Disco se erige como la firma de la experiencia de la noche del viernes en Gitano Jungle, un lugar que ha sido una piedra angular de la escena de Tulum durante más de diez años. Como oferta clave del Grupo Gitano, que extiende su presencia a lugares como Nueva York y Dubai, la serie refleja el compromiso de la marca con un ambiente bohemio e inclusivo. Cada viernes, Gypsy Disco transforma el espacio de Gitano Jungle de un destino gastronómico en una enérgica pista de baile, manteniendo su reputación como un evento semanal destacado para la comunidad.

El encantador dosel de Gitano Jungle

Gitano Jungle es el telón de fondo de Gypsy Disco, situado en el corazón de la zona hotelera de Tulum. El local ofrece una experiencia de cena mexicana moderna a la luz de las velas bajo las palmeras, que se transforma en una enérgica pista de baile a medida que avanza la noche. Este entorno, caracterizado por su ambiente bohemio y su dosel natural, cobra vida con las brillantes luces de discoteca, creando una atmósfera en la que el ambiente selvático realza la energía festiva del evento.

Cena, baile y reservas

La entrada a Gypsy Disco tiene un precio de $1,100 MXN. La cena se ofrece entre las 18:00 y las 23:00 horas, con mesas reservadas durante toda la noche. Se recomienda a los invitados que reserven su grupo completo para asegurarse de que se sientan juntos. Para aquellos que buscan una experiencia mejorada, el servicio de botella está disponible a medida que aumenta la energía de la noche.

en.body:
Never Dull

San Diego native Never Dull has cultivated a distinct presence in electronic music since 2017, channeling his Latin American heritage and Californian upbringing into an energizing, groovy sound. Known for a prolific output that includes over 100 official tracks, his discography spans original productions, disco edits, and remixes. Never Dull's approach is centered on sharing positive vibes, establishing him as a consistent purveyor of feel-good dance music for audiences globally.

Funk-Infused House Aesthetics

Never Dull's musical style navigates through disco house, funky house, jazz house, nu disco, and lo-fi house, characterized by a vibrant, rhythm-driven aesthetic. His production techniques often involve sampling and re-contextualizing classic disco and funk elements, creating tracks like "Deep Down - Never Dull's In My Mind Edit," "Saxyness," and "The Time Is Now." The artist's latest single, "BIG DISCO ENERGY," released in December 2025, further exemplifies his commitment to upbeat, dancefloor-focused productions. With 64,610 Spotify followers, Never Dull maintains a significant reach within the contemporary house scene.

Full Moon Rhythms at Papaya Playa

This performance at Papaya Playa Project's Full Moon Celebration on March 7th promises an evening of Never Dull's signature energizing grooves, perfectly complementing Tulum's beachfront atmosphere. Expect a set that progressively builds from soulful, disco-infused rhythms to more driving house selections, designed to keep the dancefloor moving under the moonlight. The natural beauty and eco-conscious spirit of Papaya Playa Project, with its open-air setting and focus on soulful sounds, provide an ideal backdrop for Never Dull's positive and vibrant musical delivery. The lineup also features additional artists, with "MORE TBA" indicating further announcements to enhance the night's sonic journey.

Planning Your Tulum Escape

The Full Moon Celebration at Papaya Playa Project is scheduled for Saturday, March 7th, commencing at 18:00. General admission tickets are priced at $1,430 MXN. Guests can enhance their evening with a Mayan Dinner Experience or opt for room packages, offering a comprehensive anniversary weekend escape. Given Papaya Playa Project's reputation as an upscale destination and its history of hosting significant events, securing tickets in advance is advisable to ensure entry to this celestial night of beats.
en.description: San Diego's Never Dull mixes Latin American heritage with Californian vibes, delivering energizing disco, funky, and nu-disco house music, supported by DJs like Disclosure.
en.name: Never Dull

es.body:
Never Dull

Never Dull, nativo de San Diego, ha cultivado una presencia distintiva en la música electrónica desde 2017, canalizando su herencia latinoamericana y su crianza californiana en un sonido energizante y groovy. Conocido por una prolífica producción que incluye más de 100 pistas oficiales, su discografía abarca producciones originales, ediciones disco y remezclas. El enfoque de Never Dull se centra en compartir vibraciones positivas, lo que le ha convertido en un proveedor constante de música de baile que hace sentir bien al público de todo el mundo.

Estética house con toques funk

El estilo musical de Never Dull navega entre el disco house, el funky house, el jazz house, el nu disco y el lo-fi house, caracterizado por una estética vibrante y rítmica. Sus técnicas de producción a menudo implican el muestreo y la recontextualización de elementos disco y funk clásicos, creando temas como "Deep Down - Never Dull's In My Mind Edit", "Saxyness" y "The Time Is Now" El último single del artista, "BIG DISCO ENERGY", publicado en diciembre de 2025, ejemplifica aún más su compromiso con las producciones optimistas y centradas en la pista de baile. Con 64.610 seguidores en Spotify, Never Dull mantiene un alcance significativo dentro de la escena house contemporánea.

Ritmos de luna llena en Papaya Playa

Esta actuación en Papaya Playa Project's Full Moon Celebration el 7 de marzo promete una noche de los ritmos energéticos característicos de Never Dull, que complementan perfectamente el ambiente frente a la playa de Tulum. Se espera un set que va progresivamente de ritmos soul y disco a selecciones house más movidas, diseñadas para mantener la pista de baile en movimiento bajo la luz de la luna. La belleza natural y el espíritu ecológico de Papaya Playa Project, con su entorno al aire libre y su enfoque en los sonidos soulful, proporcionan un telón de fondo ideal para la entrega musical positiva y vibrante de Never Dull. El cartel también cuenta con artistas adicionales, con "MORE TBA" indicando más anuncios para mejorar el viaje sonoro de la noche.

Planea tu escapada a Tulum

La celebración de la luna llena en Papaya Playa Project está programada para el sábado 7 de marzo, a partir de las 18:00 horas. Los boletos de admisión general tienen un precio de $1,430 MXN. Los huéspedes pueden mejorar su velada con una Experiencia de Cena Maya u optar por paquetes de habitaciones, ofreciendo una escapada completa de fin de semana de aniversario. Dada la reputación de Papaya Playa Project como destino de lujo y su historial como anfitrión de eventos importantes, es aconsejable asegurar los boletos con anticipación para garantizar la entrada a esta noche celestial de ritmos.

Tenga en cuenta que la lista de invitados gratuitos es limitada y la entrada es por orden de llegada. La inscripción en la lista de invitados no garantiza la entrada. Una vez que la lista de invitados esté completa, los boletos pagados estarán disponibles por 250 MXN en línea y 299 MXN en la puerta.

Paquetes de Barra Libre y Menú

Para los invitados que quieran disfrutar de Tu Brunch de una manera más cómoda y elevada, los paquetes de Tumbona y Cabaña estarán disponibles en Kanan durante el evento.

Estas experiencias incluyen acceso al evento, tumbona/cabana, 3 horas de barra libre de bebidas de las barras seleccionadas de Kanan y un plato de cortesía del menú de comida designado. La disponibilidad es limitada, y los paquetes se ofrecen por orden de llegada. Le recomendamos que reserve su opción preferida con antelación.

Qué puede esperar

Disfrute de un divertido ambiente dominical junto a la playa, con música durante todo el día, mucho espacio para bailar o relajarse, y un público amable que transmite el espíritu despreocupado de Tu Brunch. Kanan ofrece buena comida y bebida, cómodos asientos frente a la playa y un hermoso lugar para disfrutar del sol, la música y la buena compañía.

Política de cancelación

Todas las compras y ventas son no reembolsables y definitivas. Al comprar una entrada, un paquete o hacer una donación, usted acepta los riesgos de circunstancias imprevistas como la cancelación del evento debido a fenómenos naturales, normativas gubernamentales o cambios personales en las circunstancias. No se efectuarán reembolsos por ningún motivo.

Asunción de riesgos y exención de responsabilidad

Al asistir a Tu Brunch, usted reconoce que la participación puede implicar la exposición potencial a riesgos para la salud, incluyendo pero no limitado a las enfermedades transmisibles como COVID-19. Aunque se han aplicado medidas preventivas, no podemos garantizar su seguridad. Al asistir al evento, usted asume voluntariamente todos los riesgos relacionados con la enfermedad o lesión y la liberación de Tulum Biblia, Kanan y el personal asociado de cualquier responsabilidad. Su participación es bajo su propio riesgo.
